// ============================================================
// analyzer.fl - 에러 심층 분석 모듈 (Phase 2)
// Claude 응답 구조화 + 에러 우선순위 + 연관 파일 추적
// ============================================================

// 분석 결과 (Claude JSON 응답 파싱)
struct AnalysisResult {
  root_cause: string,       // 근본 원인 (1-2문장)
  fix_strategy: string,     // 수정 전략
  fix_type: string,         // "line_change" | "block_change" | "refactor" | "logic_fix"
  affected_lines: array,    // 영향받는 줄 번호 배열
  related_files: array,     // 연관 파일 경로 배열 (추가 컨텍스트 필요)
  confidence: i32,          // 0-100
  severity: string,         // "critical" | "high" | "medium" | "low"
  category: string,         // "type_mismatch" | "null_deref" | "logic_error" | "missing_impl" | ...
  suggestions: array        // 추가 제안 문자열 배열
}

// 멀티-에러 분석 (복수 에러 동시 처리)
struct MultiErrorAnalysis {
  errors: array,           // ParsedError 배열
  primary_error: i32,      // 주요 에러 인덱스 (0부터)
  analysis: array,         // AnalysisResult 배열 (에러별)
  fix_order: array,        // 수정 순서 (줄 번호 기준)
  shared_cause: string,    // 공통 원인 (있으면)
  estimated_hunks: i32     // 예상 패치 헝크 수
}

// ==================== JSON 파싱 ====================

fn parse_analysis_json(json_text: string) -> Result<AnalysisResult, string>
  intent "Claude가 반환한 분석 JSON을 AnalysisResult로 파싱"
  do
    // JSON 블록 추출 (```json ... ``` 또는 직접 {})
    let json = extract_json_block(json_text)

    if str_len(json) == 0
      return Err("JSON 블록을 찾을 수 없습니다")
    end

    let root_cause = json_extract_string(json, "root_cause")
    let fix_strategy = json_extract_string(json, "fix_strategy")
    let fix_type = json_extract_string(json, "fix_type")
    let confidence = json_extract_int(json, "confidence")
    let severity = json_extract_string(json, "severity")
    let category = json_extract_string(json, "category")

    // affected_lines 배열 파싱
    let affected_lines = json_extract_int_array(json, "affected_lines")

    // related_files 배열 파싱
    let related_files = json_extract_str_array(json, "related_files")

    // suggestions 배열 파싱
    let suggestions = json_extract_str_array(json, "suggestions")

    // 기본값 처리
    if fix_type == ""
      fix_type = "line_change"
    end
    if severity == ""
      severity = infer_severity(root_cause)
    end
    if category == ""
      category = infer_category(root_cause, fix_strategy)
    end

    if root_cause == "" && fix_strategy == ""
      return Err("분석 결과가 비어있습니다")
    end

    return Ok(AnalysisResult {
      root_cause: root_cause,
      fix_strategy: fix_strategy,
      fix_type: fix_type,
      affected_lines: affected_lines,
      related_files: related_files,
      confidence: confidence,
      severity: severity,
      category: category,
      suggestions: suggestions
    })
end

fn extract_json_block(text: string) -> string
  intent "텍스트에서 JSON 블록 추출"
  do
    // ```json ... ``` 형식
    if str_contains(text, "```json")
      let after = str_after(text, "```json\n")
      if str_contains(after, "\n```")
        return str_before(after, "\n```")
      end
      return str_before(after, "```")
    end

    // ``` ... ``` 형식 (json 태그 없이)
    if str_contains(text, "```\n{")
      let after = str_after(text, "```\n")
      return str_before(after, "\n```")
    end

    // 직접 { } 찾기
    let brace_start = str_find_char(text, "{")
    if brace_start >= 0
      let from_brace = str_substr(text, brace_start, str_len(text))
      let brace_end = find_matching_brace(from_brace)
      if brace_end > 0
        return str_substr(from_brace, 0, brace_end + 1)
      end
    end

    return ""
end

fn find_matching_brace(text: string) -> i32
  intent "중괄호 매칭 위치 찾기 (중첩 처리)"
  do
    let depth = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(text)
    let in_string = false

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(text, i)

      if in_string
        if ch == "\\"
          i = i + 2  // 이스케이프 문자 스킵
          continue
        end
        if ch == "\""
          in_string = false
        end
      else
        if ch == "\""
          in_string = true
        else if ch == "{"
          depth = depth + 1
        else if ch == "}"
          depth = depth - 1
          if depth == 0
            return i
          end
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return -1
end

// ==================== 에러 분류 ====================

fn infer_severity(root_cause: string) -> string
  intent "근본 원인에서 심각도 추론"
  do
    let lower = str_lowercase(root_cause)

    if str_contains(lower, "null") || str_contains(lower, "panic") ||
       str_contains(lower, "overflow") || str_contains(lower, "undefined behavior")
      return "critical"
    end

    if str_contains(lower, "type") || str_contains(lower, "borrow") ||
       str_contains(lower, "lifetime") || str_contains(lower, "ownership")
      return "high"
    end

    if str_contains(lower, "logic") || str_contains(lower, "wrong") ||
       str_contains(lower, "incorrect") || str_contains(lower, "missing")
      return "medium"
    end

    return "low"
end

fn infer_category(root_cause: string, fix_strategy: string) -> string
  intent "근본 원인에서 에러 카테고리 추론"
  do
    let combined = str_lowercase(root_cause + " " + fix_strategy)

    if str_contains(combined, "type") || str_contains(combined, "mismatch") ||
       str_contains(combined, "cast") || str_contains(combined, "convert")
      return "type_mismatch"
    end

    if str_contains(combined, "null") || str_contains(combined, "none") ||
       str_contains(combined, "option") || str_contains(combined, "unwrap")
      return "null_deref"
    end

    if str_contains(combined, "borrow") || str_contains(combined, "lifetime") ||
       str_contains(combined, "ownership") || str_contains(combined, "move")
      return "ownership_error"
    end

    if str_contains(combined, "logic") || str_contains(combined, "algorithm") ||
       str_contains(combined, "calculation") || str_contains(combined, "arithmetic")
      return "logic_error"
    end

    if str_contains(combined, "missing") || str_contains(combined, "not found") ||
       str_contains(combined, "undefined") || str_contains(combined, "unresolved")
      return "missing_impl"
    end

    if str_contains(combined, "assertion") || str_contains(combined, "expect") ||
       str_contains(combined, "test") || str_contains(combined, "assert")
      return "assertion_failure"
    end

    return "unknown"
end

// ==================== 에러 우선순위 ====================

fn rank_errors(errors: array) -> array
  intent "에러 배열을 심각도 + 수정 가능성으로 정렬"
  do
    // 단순 버블 정렬 (에러 수가 적으므로 충분)
    let ranked = arr_copy(errors)
    let n = arr_len(ranked)
    let i = 0

    while i < n - 1
      let j = 0
      while j < n - i - 1
        let a = arr_get(ranked, j)
        let b = arr_get(ranked, j + 1)

        if error_priority(a) < error_priority(b)
          ranked = arr_swap(ranked, j, j + 1)
        end

        j = j + 1
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    return ranked
end

fn error_priority(err: ParsedError) -> i32
  intent "단일 에러 우선순위 점수 (높을수록 먼저 처리)"
  do
    let score = 0

    // 에러 타입별 기본 점수
    if err.error_type == "compile_error"
      score = 100  // 컴파일 에러 최우선
    else if err.error_type == "type_error"
      score = 90
    else if err.error_type == "panic"
      score = 80  // 런타임 panic
    else if err.error_type == "test_failure"
      score = 60
    else
      score = 40
    end

    // 파일 위치 있으면 +10 (수정 가능성 높음)
    if err.file_path != ""
      score = score + 10
    end

    // 줄 번호 있으면 +5
    if err.line_num > 0
      score = score + 5
    end

    // 테스트 이름 있으면 +5
    if err.test_name != ""
      score = score + 5
    end

    return score
end

// ==================== 멀티-에러 분석 ====================

fn analyze_multi_error(errors: array, cfg: AgentConfig) -> MultiErrorAnalysis
  intent "복수 에러 분석 (의존관계 파악)"
  do
    let ranked = rank_errors(errors)
    let n = arr_len(ranked)

    // 공통 원인 탐지
    let shared_cause = detect_shared_cause(ranked)

    // 수정 순서 결정 (컴파일 에러 먼저, 테스트 실패는 나중)
    let fix_order = build_fix_order(ranked)

    // 예상 헝크 수
    let estimated_hunks = estimate_hunks(ranked)

    return MultiErrorAnalysis {
      errors: ranked,
      primary_error: 0,   // 랭킹 후 첫 번째가 주요 에러
      analysis: [],        // heal_loop에서 Claude 호출 후 채움
      fix_order: fix_order,
      shared_cause: shared_cause,
      estimated_hunks: estimated_hunks
    }
end

fn detect_shared_cause(errors: array) -> string
  intent "에러들의 공통 원인 탐지"
  do
    let n = arr_len(errors)
    if n < 2
      return ""
    end

    // 같은 파일에서 나온 에러들
    let first = arr_get(errors, 0)
    let all_same_file = true
    let i = 1

    while i < n
      let err = arr_get(errors, i)
      if err.file_path != first.file_path
        all_same_file = false
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    if all_same_file && first.file_path != ""
      return "같은 파일에서 " + int_to_str(n) + "개 에러 발생 (" + first.file_path + ")"
    end

    // 같은 에러 타입
    let all_same_type = true
    i = 1
    while i < n
      let err = arr_get(errors, i)
      if err.error_type != first.error_type
        all_same_type = false
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    if all_same_type
      return "동일 타입의 에러 반복: " + first.error_type
    end

    return ""
end

fn build_fix_order(errors: array) -> array
  intent "에러 수정 순서 결정 (줄 번호 역순 - 위에서 수정하면 줄 번호 밀림 방지)"
  do
    let order = []
    let n = arr_len(errors)

    // 컴파일 에러만 먼저 (줄 번호 역순)
    let compile_errors = []
    let other_errors = []
    let i = 0

    while i < n
      let err = arr_get(errors, i)
      if err.error_type == "compile_error" || err.error_type == "type_error"
        compile_errors = arr_push(compile_errors, i)
      else
        other_errors = arr_push(other_errors, i)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    // 컴파일 에러 역순 (줄 번호 큰 것부터)
    let sorted_compile = sort_by_line_desc(compile_errors, errors)
    let j = 0
    while j < arr_len(sorted_compile)
      order = arr_push(order, arr_get(sorted_compile, j))
      j = j + 1
    end

    // 나머지 에러
    j = 0
    while j < arr_len(other_errors)
      order = arr_push(order, arr_get(other_errors, j))
      j = j + 1
    end

    return order
end

fn sort_by_line_desc(indices: array, errors: array) -> array
  intent "에러 인덱스 배열을 줄 번호 내림차순으로 정렬"
  do
    let result = arr_copy(indices)
    let n = arr_len(result)

    let i = 0
    while i < n - 1
      let j = 0
      while j < n - i - 1
        let ia = arr_get(result, j)
        let ib = arr_get(result, j + 1)
        let ea = arr_get(errors, ia)
        let eb = arr_get(errors, ib)

        if ea.line_num < eb.line_num
          result = arr_swap(result, j, j + 1)
        end

        j = j + 1
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    return result
end

fn estimate_hunks(errors: array) -> i32
  intent "예상 패치 헝크 수 추정"
  do
    let n = arr_len(errors)
    if n == 0
      return 0
    end

    let hunks = 0
    let i = 0

    while i < n
      let err = arr_get(errors, i)

      if err.fix_type == "refactor"
        hunks = hunks + 3   // 리팩토링은 여러 헝크
      else if err.fix_type == "block_change"
        hunks = hunks + 2
      else
        hunks = hunks + 1   // 줄 변경은 1 헝크
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return hunks
end

// ==================== 분석 포맷터 ====================

fn format_analysis_for_prompt(analysis: AnalysisResult) -> string
  intent "분석 결과를 패치 생성 프롬프트용으로 포맷"
  do
    let text = "## 에러 분석 결과\n\n"
    text = text + "**근본 원인**: " + analysis.root_cause + "\n\n"
    text = text + "**수정 전략**: " + analysis.fix_strategy + "\n\n"
    text = text + "**수정 유형**: " + analysis.fix_type + "\n"
    text = text + "**심각도**: " + analysis.severity + "\n"
    text = text + "**분류**: " + analysis.category + "\n"
    text = text + "**신뢰도**: " + int_to_str(analysis.confidence) + "/100\n"

    if arr_len(analysis.affected_lines) > 0
      text = text + "\n**영향받는 줄**: "
      let i = 0
      let total = arr_len(analysis.affected_lines)
      while i < total
        if i > 0
          text = text + ", "
        end
        text = text + int_to_str(arr_get(analysis.affected_lines, i))
        i = i + 1
      end
      text = text + "\n"
    end

    if arr_len(analysis.related_files) > 0
      text = text + "\n**연관 파일**:\n"
      let i = 0
      let total = arr_len(analysis.related_files)
      while i < total
        text = text + "- " + arr_get(analysis.related_files, i) + "\n"
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    if arr_len(analysis.suggestions) > 0
      text = text + "\n**추가 제안**:\n"
      let i = 0
      let total = arr_len(analysis.suggestions)
      while i < total
        text = text + "- " + arr_get(analysis.suggestions, i) + "\n"
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    return text
end

fn analysis_to_summary(analysis: AnalysisResult) -> string
  intent "분석 결과 1줄 요약"
  do
    return "[" + analysis.severity + "/" + analysis.category + "] " +
           str_truncate(analysis.root_cause, 80) +
           " (신뢰도 " + int_to_str(analysis.confidence) + "%)"
end

// ==================== 연관 파일 탐색 ====================

fn find_related_files_from_error(error: ParsedError, repo_files: array) -> array
  intent "에러 파일과 연관된 파일 목록 추출"
  do
    let related = []

    if error.file_path == ""
      return related
    end

    // 같은 디렉토리의 파일
    let dir = str_dir_of(error.file_path)
    let n = arr_len(repo_files)
    let i = 0

    while i < n
      let f = arr_get(repo_files, i)

      // 같은 디렉토리
      if str_dir_of(f) == dir && f != error.file_path
        related = arr_push(related, f)
      end

      // 테스트 파일 ↔ 소스 파일 연결
      if is_test_for(f, error.file_path) || is_test_for(error.file_path, f)
        if !arr_contains_str(related, f)
          related = arr_push(related, f)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    // 최대 5개
    if arr_len(related) > 5
      return arr_slice(related, 0, 5)
    end

    return related
end

fn is_test_for(test_file: string, src_file: string) -> bool
  intent "파일이 소스 파일의 테스트인지 확인"
  do
    // Rust: src/lib.rs ↔ src/lib_test.rs 또는 tests/lib.rs
    // Go: math.go ↔ math_test.go
    let src_base = str_file_stem(src_file)
    let test_base = str_file_stem(test_file)

    return test_base == src_base + "_test" ||
           test_base == "test_" + src_base ||
           str_contains(test_file, "/tests/") && str_contains(test_file, src_base)
end

fn str_dir_of(path: string) -> string
  intent "파일 경로에서 디렉토리 추출"
  do
    if str_contains(path, "/")
      return str_before_last(path, "/")
    end
    return "."
end

fn str_file_stem(path: string) -> string
  intent "파일 경로에서 확장자 없는 이름 추출"
  do
    let name = ""
    if str_contains(path, "/")
      name = str_after_last(path, "/")
    else
      name = path
    end

    if str_contains(name, ".")
      return str_before_last(name, ".")
    end

    return name
end

fn str_before_last(s: string, delim: string) -> string
  intent "마지막 구분자 이전 문자열"
  do
    let last_pos = -1
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    let dlen = str_len(delim)

    while i <= len - dlen
      if str_substr(s, i, i + dlen) == delim
        last_pos = i
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    if last_pos < 0
      return s
    end

    return str_substr(s, 0, last_pos)
end

fn str_after_last(s: string, delim: string) -> string
  intent "마지막 구분자 이후 문자열"
  do
    let last_pos = -1
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    let dlen = str_len(delim)

    while i <= len - dlen
      if str_substr(s, i, i + dlen) == delim
        last_pos = i
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    if last_pos < 0
      return s
    end

    return str_substr(s, last_pos + dlen, len)
end

fn str_find_char(s: string, ch: string) -> i32
  intent "문자 첫 번째 위치 찾기"
  do
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      if str_char(s, i) == ch
        return i
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn arr_contains_str(arr: array, s: string) -> bool
  do
    let n = arr_len(arr)
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if arr_get(arr, i) == s
        return true
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return false
end

fn arr_copy(arr: array) -> array
  do
    let result = []
    let n = arr_len(arr)
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      result = arr_push(result, arr_get(arr, i))
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn arr_swap(arr: array, i: i32, j: i32) -> array
  do
    let a = arr_get(arr, i)
    let b = arr_get(arr, j)
    let result = arr_copy(arr)
    result = arr_set(result, i, b)
    result = arr_set(result, j, a)
    return result
end

fn arr_slice(arr: array, start: i32, end_idx: i32) -> array
  do
    let result = []
    let i = start
    while i < end_idx && i < arr_len(arr)
      result = arr_push(result, arr_get(arr, i))
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

// ==================== JSON 배열 파싱 ====================

fn json_extract_int_array(json: string, key: string) -> array
  intent "JSON 정수 배열 추출: \"key\": [1, 2, 3]"
  do
    let result = []
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    if !str_contains(json, search)
      return result
    end

    let after = str_after(json, search)
    let trimmed = str_trim(after)

    if str_char(trimmed, 0) != "["
      return result
    end

    let inner = str_between(trimmed, "[", "]")
    let parts = str_split_by_comma(inner)
    let n = arr_len(parts)
    let i = 0

    while i < n
      let part = str_trim(arr_get(parts, i))
      let num = parse_int_from_str(part)
      if num > 0 || part == "0"
        result = arr_push(result, num)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    return result
end

fn json_extract_str_array(json: string, key: string) -> array
  intent "JSON 문자열 배열 추출: \"key\": [\"a\", \"b\"]"
  do
    let result = []
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    if !str_contains(json, search)
      return result
    end

    let after = str_after(json, search)
    let trimmed = str_trim(after)

    if str_char(trimmed, 0) != "["
      return result
    end

    // 배열 내용 추출
    let i = 1
    let len = str_len(trimmed)
    let current = ""
    let in_str = false

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(trimmed, i)

      if in_str
        if ch == "\\"
          i = i + 1
          if i < len
            current = current + str_char(trimmed, i)
          end
        else if ch == "\""
          result = arr_push(result, current)
          current = ""
          in_str = false
        else
          current = current + ch
        end
      else
        if ch == "\""
          in_str = true
        else if ch == "]"
          break
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return result
end

fn str_split_by_comma(s: string) -> array
  intent "쉼표로 문자열 분할 (문자열 내 쉼표 제외)"
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let depth = 0
    let in_str = false
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)

      if in_str
        if ch == "\\"
          current = current + ch
          i = i + 1
          if i < len
            current = current + str_char(s, i)
          end
        else if ch == "\""
          in_str = false
          current = current + ch
        else
          current = current + ch
        end
      else
        if ch == "\""
          in_str = true
          current = current + ch
        else if ch == "{"
          depth = depth + 1
          current = current + ch
        else if ch == "}"
          depth = depth - 1
          current = current + ch
        else if ch == "," && depth == 0
          result = arr_push(result, current)
          current = ""
        else
          current = current + ch
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    if str_len(str_trim(current)) > 0
      result = arr_push(result, current)
    end

    return result
end

// ==================== 공통 헬퍼 ====================

fn json_extract_string(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    if str_contains(json, search)
      let after = str_after(json, search)
      let result = ""
      let i = 0
      let len = str_len(after)
      while i < len
        let ch = str_char(after, i)
        if ch == "\\"
          i = i + 1
          if i < len
            let next = str_char(after, i)
            if next == "n" result = result + "\n"
            else if next == "t" result = result + "\t"
            else result = result + next
          end
        else if ch == "\""
          return result
        else
          result = result + ch
        end
        i = i + 1
      end
    end
    return ""
end

fn json_extract_int(json: string, key: string) -> i32
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    if str_contains(json, search)
      let after = str_trim(str_after(json, search))
      let result = ""
      let i = 0
      let len = str_len(after)
      while i < len
        let ch = str_char(after, i)
        if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
           ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
          result = result + ch
        else
          break
        end
        i = i + 1
      end
      return parse_int_from_str(result)
    end
    return 0
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn str_truncate(s: string, max_len: i32) -> string
  do
    if str_len(s) <= max_len return s
    return str_substr(s, 0, max_len - 3) + "..."
end

// ============================================================
// verifier.fl - 패치 검증 강화 (Phase 2)
// 문법 체크 + 회귀 탐지 + Claude 검증 + 커버리지 추적
// ============================================================

struct VerifyConfig {
  lang: string,
  repo_path: string,
  timeout_sec: i32,
  require_all_tests_pass: bool,   // true: 모든 테스트 통과 필수
  allow_new_failures: bool,       // false: 새로운 실패 허용 안 함
  min_confidence: i32             // 최소 패치 신뢰도 (0-100)
}

struct VerifyResult {
  passed: bool,
  stage: string,           // 어느 단계에서 통과/실패
  syntax_ok: bool,
  tests_before: TestRunResult,
  tests_after: TestRunResult,
  new_failures: array,     // 새로 생긴 실패한 테스트 이름
  fixed_tests: array,      // 수정된 테스트 이름
  regression_detected: bool,
  claude_verdict: bool,    // Claude의 패치 검증 결과
  claude_confidence: i32,
  coverage_delta: i32,     // 커버리지 변화 (-/+)
  details: string
}

struct CoverageReport {
  total_lines: i32,
  covered_lines: i32,
  percentage: i32,         // 0-100
  uncovered_files: array
}

// ==================== 메인 검증 파이프라인 ====================

fn verify_patch(
  original_content: string,
  patched_content: string,
  error: ParsedError,
  cfg: VerifyConfig,
  api_key: string,
  model: string
) -> VerifyResult
  intent "패치 검증 전체 파이프라인 실행"
  do
    print("[Verify] 패치 검증 시작...")

    // ─── Stage 1: 문법 검사 ─────────────────────────────
    print("[Verify] Stage 1: 문법 검사")
    let syntax_result = verify_syntax(patched_content, error.file_path, cfg.lang, cfg.repo_path)

    if !syntax_result.ok
      print("[Verify] ❌ 문법 오류: " + syntax_result.error_msg)
      return VerifyResult {
        passed: false,
        stage: "syntax",
        syntax_ok: false,
        tests_before: empty_test_result(),
        tests_after: empty_test_result(),
        new_failures: [],
        fixed_tests: [],
        regression_detected: false,
        claude_verdict: false,
        claude_confidence: 0,
        coverage_delta: 0,
        details: "문법 오류: " + syntax_result.error_msg
      }
    end

    print("[Verify] ✅ 문법 검사 통과")

    // ─── Stage 2: 패치 전 테스트 스냅샷 ──────────────────
    print("[Verify] Stage 2: 패치 전 테스트 기준선")
    let test_cfg_before = TestRunConfig {
      repo_path: cfg.repo_path + "-before",
      lang: cfg.lang,
      test_filter: error.test_name,
      timeout_sec: cfg.timeout_sec,
      env_vars: []
    }

    let tests_before = run_tests(test_cfg_before)
    print("[Verify] 패치 전: " + int_to_str(tests_before.tests_passed) + "/" +
          int_to_str(tests_before.tests_total) + " 통과")

    // ─── Stage 3: 패치 후 테스트 실행 ────────────────────
    print("[Verify] Stage 3: 패치 후 테스트")
    let test_cfg_after = TestRunConfig {
      repo_path: cfg.repo_path,
      lang: cfg.lang,
      test_filter: "",   // 전체 테스트
      timeout_sec: cfg.timeout_sec,
      env_vars: []
    }

    let tests_after = run_tests(test_cfg_after)
    print("[Verify] 패치 후: " + int_to_str(tests_after.tests_passed) + "/" +
          int_to_str(tests_after.tests_total) + " 통과")

    // ─── Stage 4: 회귀 분석 ──────────────────────────────
    print("[Verify] Stage 4: 회귀 분석")
    let regression = analyze_regression(tests_before, tests_after)

    if regression.regression_detected
      print("[Verify] ⚠️  회귀 감지: " + int_to_str(arr_len(regression.new_failures)) + "개 새 실패")
      if !cfg.allow_new_failures
        return VerifyResult {
          passed: false,
          stage: "regression",
          syntax_ok: true,
          tests_before: tests_before,
          tests_after: tests_after,
          new_failures: regression.new_failures,
          fixed_tests: regression.fixed_tests,
          regression_detected: true,
          claude_verdict: false,
          claude_confidence: 0,
          coverage_delta: 0,
          details: "회귀 감지: " + format_failed_list(regression.new_failures)
        }
      end
    end

    // ─── Stage 5: Claude 패치 검증 ───────────────────────
    print("[Verify] Stage 5: Claude 패치 검증")
    let claude_result = claude_verify_patch(api_key, model, original_content, patched_content, error)

    let claude_ok = false
    let claude_confidence = 0
    let claude_issues = []

    if claude_result.success
      let verdict = parse_verify_json(claude_result.content)
      claude_ok = verdict.is_correct
      claude_confidence = verdict.confidence
      claude_issues = verdict.potential_issues

      print("[Verify] Claude 판정: " + (if claude_ok "✅ 올바름" else "❌ 문제있음") +
            " (신뢰도: " + int_to_str(claude_confidence) + "%)")
    else
      print("[Verify] Claude 검증 실패 (스킵): " + claude_result.error_msg)
      claude_ok = true    // API 실패 시 통과로 처리
      claude_confidence = 50
    end

    // ─── Stage 6: 최종 판정 ──────────────────────────────
    let target_test_fixed = is_target_test_fixed(error.test_name, tests_before, tests_after)
    let overall_ok = syntax_result.ok &&
                     !regression.regression_detected &&
                     (tests_after.passed || target_test_fixed)

    if cfg.min_confidence > 0 && claude_confidence < cfg.min_confidence
      overall_ok = false
    end

    let stage = "passed"
    if !overall_ok
      if !syntax_result.ok
        stage = "syntax"
      else if regression.regression_detected
        stage = "regression"
      else if !tests_after.passed
        stage = "tests_failed"
      else
        stage = "low_confidence"
      end
    end

    let details = build_verify_details(
      syntax_result.ok, tests_before, tests_after, regression, claude_ok, claude_confidence, claude_issues
    )

    return VerifyResult {
      passed: overall_ok,
      stage: stage,
      syntax_ok: syntax_result.ok,
      tests_before: tests_before,
      tests_after: tests_after,
      new_failures: regression.new_failures,
      fixed_tests: regression.fixed_tests,
      regression_detected: regression.regression_detected,
      claude_verdict: claude_ok,
      claude_confidence: claude_confidence,
      coverage_delta: 0,   // Phase 3에서 구현
      details: details
    }
end

// ==================== 문법 검사 ====================

struct SyntaxResult {
  ok: bool,
  error_msg: string,
  errors_count: i32
}

fn verify_syntax(content: string, file_path: string, lang: string, repo_path: string) -> SyntaxResult
  intent "언어별 문법 검사"
  do
    if lang == "rust"
      return verify_rust_syntax(content, file_path, repo_path)
    end

    if lang == "go"
      return verify_go_syntax(content, file_path, repo_path)
    end

    if lang == "python"
      return verify_python_syntax(content, file_path)
    end

    if lang == "freelang"
      return verify_fl_syntax(content, file_path, repo_path)
    end

    // 알 수 없는 언어: 통과
    return SyntaxResult { ok: true, error_msg: "", errors_count: 0 }
end

// ==================== 회귀 분석 ====================

struct RegressionResult {
  regression_detected: bool,
  new_failures: array,    // 새로 생긴 실패 테스트
  fixed_tests: array,     // 수정된 테스트
  net_change: i32         // 양수: 개선, 음수: 악화
}

fn analyze_regression(before: TestRunResult, after: TestRunResult) -> RegressionResult
  intent "테스트 결과 비교 - 회귀 감지"
  do
    let new_failures = []
    let fixed_tests = []

    // 새로 생긴 실패: after에는 있지만 before에는 없는 실패
    let n_after = arr_len(after.failed_tests)
    let i = 0
    while i < n_after
      let test = arr_get(after.failed_tests, i)
      if !arr_contains_str(before.failed_tests, test)
        new_failures = arr_push(new_failures, test)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    // 수정된 테스트: before에는 있지만 after에는 없는 실패
    let n_before = arr_len(before.failed_tests)
    i = 0
    while i < n_before
      let test = arr_get(before.failed_tests, i)
      if !arr_contains_str(after.failed_tests, test)
        fixed_tests = arr_push(fixed_tests, test)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    let net_change = arr_len(fixed_tests) - arr_len(new_failures)
    let regression = arr_len(new_failures) > 0

    return RegressionResult {
      regression_detected: regression,
      new_failures: new_failures,
      fixed_tests: fixed_tests,
      net_change: net_change
    }
end

fn is_target_test_fixed(test_name: string, before: TestRunResult, after: TestRunResult) -> bool
  intent "대상 테스트가 수정되었는지 확인"
  do
    if test_name == ""
      // 테스트 이름 없으면 전체 통과 여부로 판단
      return after.passed
    end

    // before에서 실패했고 after에서 성공
    let was_failing = arr_contains_str(before.failed_tests, test_name)
    let now_passing = !arr_contains_str(after.failed_tests, test_name)

    return was_failing && now_passing
end

// ==================== Claude 검증 응답 파싱 ====================

struct ClaudeVerdict {
  is_correct: bool,
  reason: string,
  confidence: i32,
  potential_issues: array
}

fn parse_verify_json(json_text: string) -> ClaudeVerdict
  intent "Claude 검증 JSON 응답 파싱"
  do
    let json = extract_json_block(json_text)

    if str_len(json) == 0
      // JSON 없으면 텍스트에서 판단
      let lower = str_lowercase(json_text)
      let is_correct = str_contains(lower, "correct") ||
                       str_contains(lower, "올바") ||
                       str_contains(lower, "수정됨")
      return ClaudeVerdict {
        is_correct: is_correct,
        reason: str_truncate(json_text, 200),
        confidence: 50,
        potential_issues: []
      }
    end

    let is_correct = false
    let is_correct_str = json_extract_string(json, "is_correct")
    if is_correct_str == "true" || is_correct_str == "True"
      is_correct = true
    end
    // bool 직접 파싱
    if str_contains(json, "\"is_correct\": true") || str_contains(json, "\"is_correct\":true")
      is_correct = true
    end

    let reason = json_extract_string(json, "reason")
    let confidence = json_extract_int(json, "confidence")
    let issues = json_extract_str_array(json, "potential_issues")

    return ClaudeVerdict {
      is_correct: is_correct,
      reason: reason,
      confidence: confidence,
      potential_issues: issues
    }
end

fn extract_json_block(text: string) -> string
  do
    if str_contains(text, "```json")
      let after = str_after(text, "```json\n")
      if str_contains(after, "\n```")
        return str_before(after, "\n```")
      end
    end

    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(text)
    while i < len
      if str_char(text, i) == "{"
        let from = str_substr(text, i, len)
        let end_pos = find_matching_brace(from)
        if end_pos > 0
          return str_substr(from, 0, end_pos + 1)
        end
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    return ""
end

fn find_matching_brace(text: string) -> i32
  do
    let depth = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(text)
    let in_str = false

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(text, i)
      if in_str
        if ch == "\\" i = i + 2 continue
        if ch == "\"" in_str = false
      else
        if ch == "\"" in_str = true
        else if ch == "{" depth = depth + 1
        else if ch == "}"
          depth = depth - 1
          if depth == 0 return i
        end
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

// ==================== 결과 포맷터 ====================

fn format_verify_result(result: VerifyResult) -> string
  intent "검증 결과 요약 문자열 생성"
  do
    let icon = if result.passed "✅" else "❌"
    let text = icon + " 패치 검증 " + (if result.passed "통과" else "실패") +
               " [" + result.stage + "]\n"

    text = text + "  문법: " + (if result.syntax_ok "✅" else "❌") + "\n"
    text = text + "  테스트: " +
           int_to_str(result.tests_after.tests_passed) + "/" +
           int_to_str(result.tests_after.tests_total) + " 통과\n"

    if arr_len(result.fixed_tests) > 0
      text = text + "  수정됨: " + format_test_list(result.fixed_tests) + "\n"
    end

    if arr_len(result.new_failures) > 0
      text = text + "  새 실패: " + format_failed_list(result.new_failures) + "\n"
    end

    text = text + "  Claude: " + (if result.claude_verdict "✅ 올바름" else "⚠️  의심") +
           " (" + int_to_str(result.claude_confidence) + "%)\n"

    return text
end

fn build_verify_details(
  syntax_ok: bool,
  before: TestRunResult,
  after: TestRunResult,
  regression: RegressionResult,
  claude_ok: bool,
  claude_confidence: i32,
  claude_issues: array
) -> string
  intent "상세 검증 결과 텍스트 생성"
  do
    let text = ""

    // 테스트 변화
    let passed_delta = after.tests_passed - before.tests_passed
    let sign = if passed_delta >= 0 "+" else ""
    text = text + "테스트 변화: " + sign + int_to_str(passed_delta) +
           " (" + int_to_str(before.tests_passed) + " → " + int_to_str(after.tests_passed) + ")\n"

    // 회귀
    if arr_len(regression.new_failures) > 0
      text = text + "새 실패: " + format_failed_list(regression.new_failures) + "\n"
    end
    if arr_len(regression.fixed_tests) > 0
      text = text + "수정됨: " + format_test_list(regression.fixed_tests) + "\n"
    end

    // Claude 판단
    text = text + "Claude 검증: " + int_to_str(claude_confidence) + "% 신뢰도\n"

    if arr_len(claude_issues) > 0
      text = text + "잠재적 문제:\n"
      let i = 0
      let n = arr_len(claude_issues)
      while i < n
        text = text + "  - " + arr_get(claude_issues, i) + "\n"
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    return text
end

fn format_test_list(tests: array) -> string
  do
    let n = arr_len(tests)
    if n == 0 return "(없음)"
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if i > 0 result = result + ", "
      result = result + arr_get(tests, i)
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn format_failed_list(tests: array) -> string
  do
    let n = arr_len(tests)
    if n == 0 return "(없음)"
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if i > 0 result = result + ", "
      result = result + arr_get(tests, i)

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn extract_first_error(output: string) -> string
  do
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let n = arr_len(lines)
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
      if str_contains(line, "error")
        return str_truncate(str_trim(line), 120)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return str_truncate(output, 120)
end

fn count_occurrences(s: string, pattern: string) -> i32
  do
    let count = 0
    let pos = 0
    let plen = str_len(pattern)
    let slen = str_len(s)

    while pos <= slen - plen
      if str_substr(s, pos, pos + plen) == pattern
        count = count + 1
        pos = pos + plen
      else
        pos = pos + 1
      end
    end

    return count
end

fn arr_contains_str(arr: array, s: string) -> bool
  do
    let n = arr_len(arr)
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if arr_get(arr, i) == s return true
      i = i + 1
    end
    return false
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

fn json_extract_string(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    if str_contains(json, search)
      let after = str_after(json, search)
      let result = ""
      let i = 0
      let len = str_len(after)
      while i < len
        let ch = str_char(after, i)
        if ch == "\\" i = i + 1
        else if ch == "\"" return result
        else result = result + ch
        i = i + 1
      end
    end
    return ""
end

fn json_extract_int(json: string, key: string) -> i32
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    if str_contains(json, search)
      let after = str_trim(str_after(json, search))
      let result = ""
      let i = 0
      let len = str_len(after)
      while i < len
        let ch = str_char(after, i)
        if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
           ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
          result = result + ch
        else break
        i = i + 1
      end
      return parse_int_from_str(result)
    end
    return 0
end

fn json_extract_str_array(json: string, key: string) -> array
  do
    let result = []
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    if !str_contains(json, search) return result

    let after = str_trim(str_after(json, search))
    if str_len(after) == 0 || str_char(after, 0) != "[" return result

    let i = 1
    let len = str_len(after)
    let current = ""
    let in_str = false

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(after, i)
      if in_str
        if ch == "\\" i = i + 1
        else if ch == "\""
          result = arr_push(result, current)
          current = ""
          in_str = false
        else current = current + ch
      else
        if ch == "\"" in_str = true
        else if ch == "]" break
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    return result
end

fn str_truncate(s: string, max_len: i32) -> string
  do
    if str_len(s) <= max_len return s
    return str_substr(s, 0, max_len - 3) + "..."
end

// 문법 체크 + 회귀 탐지 + Claude 검증 + 커버리지 추적
// ============================================================

struct VerifyConfig {
  lang: string,
  repo_path: string,
  timeout_sec: i32,
  require_all_tests_pass: bool,   // true: 모든 테스트 통과 필수
  allow_new_failures: bool,       // false: 새로운 실패 허용 안 함
  min_confidence: i32             // 최소 패치 신뢰도 (0-100)
}

struct VerifyResult {
  passed: bool,
  stage: string,           // 어느 단계에서 통과/실패
  syntax_ok: bool,
  tests_before: TestRunResult,
  tests_after: TestRunResult,
  new_failures: array,     // 새로 생긴 실패한 테스트 이름
  fixed_tests: array,      // 수정된 테스트 이름
  regression_detected: bool,
  claude_verdict: bool,    // Claude의 패치 검증 결과
  claude_confidence: i32,
  coverage_delta: i32,     // 커버리지 변화 (-/+)
  details: string
}

struct CoverageReport {
  total_lines: i32,
  covered_lines: i32,
  percentage: i32,         // 0-100
  uncovered_files: array
}

// ==================== 메인 검증 파이프라인 ====================

fn verify_patch(
  original_content: string,
  patched_content: string,
  error: ParsedError,
  cfg: VerifyConfig,
  api_key: string,
  model: string
) -> VerifyResult
  intent "패치 검증 전체 파이프라인 실행"
  do
    print("[Verify] 패치 검증 시작...")

    // ─── Stage 1: 문법 검사 ─────────────────────────────
    print("[Verify] Stage 1: 문법 검사")
    let syntax_result = verify_syntax(patched_content, error.file_path, cfg.lang, cfg.repo_path)

    if !syntax_result.ok
      print("[Verify] ❌ 문법 오류: " + syntax_result.error_msg)
      return VerifyResult {
        passed: false,
        stage: "syntax",
        syntax_ok: false,
        tests_before: empty_test_result(),
        tests_after: empty_test_result(),
        new_failures: [],
        fixed_tests: [],
        regression_detected: false,
        claude_verdict: false,
        claude_confidence: 0,
        coverage_delta: 0,
        details: "문법 오류: " + syntax_result.error_msg
      }
    end

    print("[Verify] ✅ 문법 검사 통과")

    // ─── Stage 2: 패치 전 테스트 스냅샷 ──────────────────
    print("[Verify] Stage 2: 패치 전 테스트 기준선")
    let test_cfg_before = TestRunConfig {
      repo_path: cfg.repo_path + "-before",
      lang: cfg.lang,
      test_filter: error.test_name,
      timeout_sec: cfg.timeout_sec,
      env_vars: []
    }

    let tests_before = run_tests(test_cfg_before)
    print("[Verify] 패치 전: " + int_to_str(tests_before.tests_passed) + "/" +
          int_to_str(tests_before.tests_total) + " 통과")

    // ─── Stage 3: 패치 후 테스트 실행 ────────────────────
    print("[Verify] Stage 3: 패치 후 테스트")
    let test_cfg_after = TestRunConfig {
      repo_path: cfg.repo_path,
      lang: cfg.lang,
      test_filter: "",   // 전체 테스트
      timeout_sec: cfg.timeout_sec,
      env_vars: []
    }

    let tests_after = run_tests(test_cfg_after)
    print("[Verify] 패치 후: " + int_to_str(tests_after.tests_passed) + "/" +
          int_to_str(tests_after.tests_total) + " 통과")

    // ─── Stage 4: 회귀 분석 ──────────────────────────────
    print("[Verify] Stage 4: 회귀 분석")
    let regression = analyze_regression(tests_before, tests_after)

    if regression.regression_detected
      print("[Verify] ⚠️  회귀 감지: " + int_to_str(arr_len(regression.new_failures)) + "개 새 실패")
      if !cfg.allow_new_failures
        return VerifyResult {
          passed: false,
          stage: "regression",
          syntax_ok: true,
          tests_before: tests_before,
          tests_after: tests_after,
          new_failures: regression.new_failures,
          fixed_tests: regression.fixed_tests,
          regression_detected: true,
          claude_verdict: false,
          claude_confidence: 0,
          coverage_delta: 0,
          details: "회귀 감지: " + format_failed_list(regression.new_failures)
        }
      end
    end

    // ─── Stage 5: Claude 패치 검증 ───────────────────────
    print("[Verify] Stage 5: Claude 패치 검증")
    let claude_result = claude_verify_patch(api_key, model, original_content, patched_content, error)

    let claude_ok = false
    let claude_confidence = 0
    let claude_issues = []

    if claude_result.success
      let verdict = parse_verify_json(claude_result.content)
      claude_ok = verdict.is_correct
      claude_confidence = verdict.confidence
      claude_issues = verdict.potential_issues

      print("[Verify] Claude 판정: " + (if claude_ok "✅ 올바름" else "❌ 문제있음") +
            " (신뢰도: " + int_to_str(claude_confidence) + "%)")
    else
      print("[Verify] Claude 검증 실패 (스킵): " + claude_result.error_msg)
      claude_ok = true    // API 실패 시 통과로 처리
      claude_confidence = 50
    end

    // ─── Stage 6: 최종 판정 ──────────────────────────────
    let target_test_fixed = is_target_test_fixed(error.test_name, tests_before, tests_after)
    let overall_ok = syntax_result.ok &&
                     !regression.regression_detected &&
                     (tests_after.passed || target_test_fixed)

    if cfg.min_confidence > 0 && claude_confidence < cfg.min_confidence
      overall_ok = false
    end

    let stage = "passed"
    if !overall_ok
      if !syntax_result.ok
        stage = "syntax"
      else if regression.regression_detected
        stage = "regression"
      else if !tests_after.passed
        stage = "tests_failed"
      else
        stage = "low_confidence"
      end
    end

    let details = build_verify_details(
      syntax_result.ok, tests_before, tests_after, regression, claude_ok, claude_confidence, claude_issues
    )

    return VerifyResult {
      passed: overall_ok,
      stage: stage,
      syntax_ok: syntax_result.ok,
      tests_before: tests_before,
      tests_after: tests_after,
      new_failures: regression.new_failures,
      fixed_tests: regression.fixed_tests,
      regression_detected: regression.regression_detected,
      claude_verdict: claude_ok,
      claude_confidence: claude_confidence,
      coverage_delta: 0,   // Phase 3에서 구현
      details: details
    }
end

// ==================== 문법 검사 ====================

struct SyntaxResult {
  ok: bool,
  error_msg: string,
  errors_count: i32
}

fn verify_syntax(content: string, file_path: string, lang: string, repo_path: string) -> SyntaxResult
  intent "언어별 문법 검사"
  do
    if lang == "rust"
      return verify_rust_syntax(content, file_path, repo_path)
    end

    if lang == "go"
      return verify_go_syntax(content, file_path, repo_path)
    end

    if lang == "python"
      return verify_python_syntax(content, file_path)
    end

    if lang == "freelang"
      return verify_fl_syntax(content, file_path, repo_path)
    end

    // 알 수 없는 언어: 통과
    return SyntaxResult { ok: true, error_msg: "", errors_count: 0 }
end

fn verify_rust_syntax(content: string, file_path: string, repo_path: string) -> SyntaxResult
  intent "rustc --emit=metadata로 문법 검사"
  do
    // 임시 파일에 쓰기
    let tmp_file = "/tmp/heal_syntax_" + int_to_str(now_unix()) + ".rs"
    match file_write(tmp_file, content)
      Err(e) => return SyntaxResult { ok: false, error_msg: "파일 쓰기 실패: " + e, errors_count: 1 }
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // rustc 문법 검사 (타입 체크는 cargo에서)
    let cmd = "rustc --edition 2021 --crate-type lib '" + tmp_file + "' --emit=metadata 2>&1 || true"
    let output = ""
    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(out) => output = out
      Err(e) => output = e
    end

    // 임시 파일 정리
    exec("rm -f '" + tmp_file + "' >/dev/null 2>&1")

    // 에러 카운트
    let error_count = count_occurrences(output, "error[")
    let has_syntax_error = str_contains(output, "error:") && error_count > 0

    if has_syntax_error
      return SyntaxResult {
        ok: false,
        error_msg: extract_first_error(output),
        errors_count: error_count
      }
    end

    return SyntaxResult { ok: true, error_msg: "", errors_count: 0 }
end

fn verify_go_syntax(content: string, file_path: string, repo_path: string) -> SyntaxResult
  intent "gofmt로 Go 문법 검사"
  do
    let tmp_file = "/tmp/heal_syntax_" + int_to_str(now_unix()) + ".go"
    match file_write(tmp_file, content)
      Err(e) => return SyntaxResult { ok: false, error_msg: "파일 쓰기 실패: " + e, errors_count: 1 }
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // gofmt -e: 파싱 에러 감지
    let cmd = "gofmt -e '" + tmp_file + "' >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?"
    let exit_code = 0
    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(out) => exit_code = parse_int_from_str(str_trim(out))
      Err(_) => {}
    end

    exec("rm -f '" + tmp_file + "' >/dev/null 2>&1")

    if exit_code != 0
      return SyntaxResult { ok: false, error_msg: "Go 문법 오류", errors_count: 1 }
    end

    return SyntaxResult { ok: true, error_msg: "", errors_count: 0 }
end

fn verify_python_syntax(content: string, file_path: string) -> SyntaxResult
  intent "python -m py_compile로 문법 검사"
  do
    let tmp_file = "/tmp/heal_syntax_" + int_to_str(now_unix()) + ".py"
    match file_write(tmp_file, content)
      Err(e) => return SyntaxResult { ok: false, error_msg: "파일 쓰기 실패: " + e, errors_count: 1 }
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    let cmd = "python3 -m py_compile '" + tmp_file + "' 2>&1; echo \"EXIT:$?\""
    let output = ""
    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(out) => output = out
      Err(e) => output = e
    end

    exec("rm -f '" + tmp_file + "' >/dev/null 2>&1")

    let exit_code = 0
    if str_contains(output, "EXIT:")
      exit_code = parse_int_from_str(str_trim(str_after(output, "EXIT:")))
    end

    if exit_code != 0
      let error_line = str_before(output, "\nEXIT:")
      return SyntaxResult { ok: false, error_msg: str_trim(error_line), errors_count: 1 }
    end

    return SyntaxResult { ok: true, error_msg: "", errors_count: 0 }
end

fn verify_fl_syntax(content: string, file_path: string, repo_path: string) -> SyntaxResult
  intent "FreeLang 문법 검사"
  do
    let tmp_file = "/tmp/heal_syntax_" + int_to_str(now_unix()) + ".fl"
    match file_write(tmp_file, content)
      Err(e) => return SyntaxResult { ok: false, error_msg: "파일 쓰기 실패: " + e, errors_count: 1 }
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    let cmd = "fl check '" + tmp_file + "' 2>&1; echo \"EXIT:$?\""
    let output = ""
    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(out) => output = out
      Err(_) => {
        // fl check가 없으면 통과
        exec("rm -f '" + tmp_file + "' >/dev/null 2>&1")
        return SyntaxResult { ok: true, error_msg: "", errors_count: 0 }
      }
    end

    exec("rm -f '" + tmp_file + "' >/dev/null 2>&1")

    let exit_code = 0
    if str_contains(output, "EXIT:")
      exit_code = parse_int_from_str(str_trim(str_after(output, "EXIT:")))
    end

    if exit_code != 0
      return SyntaxResult { ok: false, error_msg: extract_first_error(output), errors_count: 1 }
    end

    return SyntaxResult { ok: true, error_msg: "", errors_count: 0 }
end

// ==================== 회귀 분석 ====================

struct RegressionResult {
  regression_detected: bool,
  new_failures: array,    // 새로 생긴 실패 테스트
  fixed_tests: array,     // 수정된 테스트
  net_change: i32         // 양수: 개선, 음수: 악화
}

fn analyze_regression(before: TestRunResult, after: TestRunResult) -> RegressionResult
  intent "테스트 결과 비교 - 회귀 감지"
  do
    let new_failures = []
    let fixed_tests = []

    // 새로 생긴 실패: after에는 있지만 before에는 없는 실패
    let n_after = arr_len(after.failed_tests)
    let i = 0
    while i < n_after
      let test = arr_get(after.failed_tests, i)
      if !arr_contains_str(before.failed_tests, test)
        new_failures = arr_push(new_failures, test)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    // 수정된 테스트: before에는 있지만 after에는 없는 실패
    let n_before = arr_len(before.failed_tests)
    i = 0
    while i < n_before
      let test = arr_get(before.failed_tests, i)
      if !arr_contains_str(after.failed_tests, test)
        fixed_tests = arr_push(fixed_tests, test)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    let net_change = arr_len(fixed_tests) - arr_len(new_failures)
    let regression = arr_len(new_failures) > 0

    return RegressionResult {
      regression_detected: regression,
      new_failures: new_failures,
      fixed_tests: fixed_tests,
      net_change: net_change
    }
end

fn is_target_test_fixed(test_name: string, before: TestRunResult, after: TestRunResult) -> bool
  intent "대상 테스트가 수정되었는지 확인"
  do
    if test_name == ""
      // 테스트 이름 없으면 전체 통과 여부로 판단
      return after.passed
    end

    // before에서 실패했고 after에서 성공
    let was_failing = arr_contains_str(before.failed_tests, test_name)
    let now_passing = !arr_contains_str(after.failed_tests, test_name)

    return was_failing && now_passing
end

// ==================== Claude 검증 응답 파싱 ====================

struct ClaudeVerdict {
  is_correct: bool,
  reason: string,
  confidence: i32,
  potential_issues: array
}

fn parse_verify_json(json_text: string) -> ClaudeVerdict
  intent "Claude 검증 JSON 응답 파싱"
  do
    let json = extract_json_block(json_text)

    if str_len(json) == 0
      // JSON 없으면 텍스트에서 판단
      let lower = str_lowercase(json_text)
      let is_correct = str_contains(lower, "correct") ||
                       str_contains(lower, "올바") ||
                       str_contains(lower, "수정됨")
      return ClaudeVerdict {
        is_correct: is_correct,
        reason: str_truncate(json_text, 200),
        confidence: 50,
        potential_issues: []
      }
    end

    let is_correct = false
    let is_correct_str = json_extract_string(json, "is_correct")
    if is_correct_str == "true" || is_correct_str == "True"
      is_correct = true
    end
    // bool 직접 파싱
    if str_contains(json, "\"is_correct\": true") || str_contains(json, "\"is_correct\":true")
      is_correct = true
    end

    let reason = json_extract_string(json, "reason")
    let confidence = json_extract_int(json, "confidence")
    let issues = json_extract_str_array(json, "potential_issues")

    return ClaudeVerdict {
      is_correct: is_correct,
      reason: reason,
      confidence: confidence,
      potential_issues: issues
    }
end

fn extract_json_block(text: string) -> string
  do
    if str_contains(text, "```json")
      let after = str_after(text, "```json\n")
      if str_contains(after, "\n```")
        return str_before(after, "\n```")
      end
    end

    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(text)
    while i < len
      if str_char(text, i) == "{"
        let from = str_substr(text, i, len)
        let end_pos = find_matching_brace(from)
        if end_pos > 0
          return str_substr(from, 0, end_pos + 1)
        end
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    return ""
end

fn find_matching_brace(text: string) -> i32
  do
    let depth = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(text)
    let in_str = false

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(text, i)
      if in_str
        if ch == "\\" i = i + 2 continue
        if ch == "\"" in_str = false
      else
        if ch == "\"" in_str = true
        else if ch == "{" depth = depth + 1
        else if ch == "}"
          depth = depth - 1
          if depth == 0 return i
        end
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

// ==================== 커버리지 ====================

fn run_coverage(cfg: VerifyConfig) -> CoverageReport
  intent "코드 커버리지 측정"
  do
    if cfg.lang == "rust"
      return run_rust_coverage(cfg.repo_path)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "go"
      return run_go_coverage(cfg.repo_path)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "python"
      return run_python_coverage(cfg.repo_path)
    end

    return CoverageReport { total_lines: 0, covered_lines: 0, percentage: 0, uncovered_files: [] }
end

fn run_rust_coverage(repo_path: string) -> CoverageReport
  intent "Rust 커버리지 (cargo tarpaulin 또는 llvm-cov)"
  do
    // cargo llvm-cov 시도 (설치된 경우)
    let cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && " +
              "cargo llvm-cov --summary-only 2>&1 | grep 'TOTAL' || echo 'NO_COVERAGE'"

    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(output) => {
        if str_contains(output, "NO_COVERAGE")
          return CoverageReport { total_lines: 0, covered_lines: 0, percentage: 0, uncovered_files: [] }
        end
        return parse_rust_coverage_output(output)
      }
      Err(_) => return CoverageReport { total_lines: 0, covered_lines: 0, percentage: 0, uncovered_files: [] }
    end
end

fn run_go_coverage(repo_path: string) -> CoverageReport
  intent "Go 커버리지 (go test -cover)"
  do
    let cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && " +
              "go test -cover ./... 2>&1 | grep 'coverage:' || echo 'NO_COVERAGE'"

    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(output) => {
        if str_contains(output, "NO_COVERAGE")
          return CoverageReport { total_lines: 0, covered_lines: 0, percentage: 0, uncovered_files: [] }
        end
        return parse_go_coverage_output(output)
      }
      Err(_) => return CoverageReport { total_lines: 0, covered_lines: 0, percentage: 0, uncovered_files: [] }
    end
end

fn run_python_coverage(repo_path: string) -> CoverageReport
  intent "Python 커버리지 (pytest --cov)"
  do
    let cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && " +
              "python3 -m pytest --cov=. --cov-report=term-missing 2>&1 | tail -5 || echo 'NO_COVERAGE'"

    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(output) => {
        if str_contains(output, "NO_COVERAGE")
          return CoverageReport { total_lines: 0, covered_lines: 0, percentage: 0, uncovered_files: [] }
        end
        return parse_python_coverage_output(output)
      }
      Err(_) => return CoverageReport { total_lines: 0, covered_lines: 0, percentage: 0, uncovered_files: [] }
    end
end

fn parse_rust_coverage_output(output: string) -> CoverageReport
  intent "cargo llvm-cov 출력 파싱"
  do
    // "TOTAL         1234     1000    81.17%"
    let percentage = 0
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let n = arr_len(lines)
    let i = 0

    while i < n
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
      if str_contains(line, "TOTAL") && str_contains(line, "%")
        let pct_str = str_before(str_after_last(str_trim(line), " "), "%")
        percentage = parse_int_from_str(pct_str)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    return CoverageReport {
      total_lines: 0,
      covered_lines: 0,
      percentage: percentage,
      uncovered_files: []
    }
end

fn parse_go_coverage_output(output: string) -> CoverageReport
  intent "go test -cover 출력 파싱"
  do
    // "coverage: 81.2% of statements"
    let percentage = 0

    if str_contains(output, "coverage:")
      let after = str_after(output, "coverage: ")
      let pct_str = str_before(after, "%")
      // 소수점 앞부분만
      percentage = parse_int_from_str(str_before(pct_str, "."))
    end

    return CoverageReport {
      total_lines: 0,
      covered_lines: 0,
      percentage: percentage,
      uncovered_files: []
    }
end

fn parse_python_coverage_output(output: string) -> CoverageReport
  intent "pytest --cov 출력 파싱"
  do
    // "TOTAL    1234    200    84%"
    let percentage = 0
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let n = arr_len(lines)
    let i = 0

    while i < n
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
      if str_starts_with(str_trim(line), "TOTAL") && str_contains(line, "%")
        let pct_str = str_before(str_after_last(str_trim(line), " "), "%")
        percentage = parse_int_from_str(pct_str)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    return CoverageReport {
      total_lines: 0,
      covered_lines: 0,
      percentage: percentage,
      uncovered_files: []
    }
end

// ==================== 결과 포맷터 ====================

fn format_verify_result(result: VerifyResult) -> string
  intent "검증 결과 요약 문자열 생성"
  do
    let icon = if result.passed "✅" else "❌"
    let text = icon + " 패치 검증 " + (if result.passed "통과" else "실패") +
               " [" + result.stage + "]\n"

    text = text + "  문법: " + (if result.syntax_ok "✅" else "❌") + "\n"
    text = text + "  테스트: " +
           int_to_str(result.tests_after.tests_passed) + "/" +
           int_to_str(result.tests_after.tests_total) + " 통과\n"

    if arr_len(result.fixed_tests) > 0
      text = text + "  수정됨: " + format_test_list(result.fixed_tests) + "\n"
    end

    if arr_len(result.new_failures) > 0
      text = text + "  새 실패: " + format_failed_list(result.new_failures) + "\n"
    end

    text = text + "  Claude: " + (if result.claude_verdict "✅ 올바름" else "⚠️  의심") +
           " (" + int_to_str(result.claude_confidence) + "%)\n"

    return text
end

fn build_verify_details(
  syntax_ok: bool,
  before: TestRunResult,
  after: TestRunResult,
  regression: RegressionResult,
  claude_ok: bool,
  claude_confidence: i32,
  claude_issues: array
) -> string
  intent "상세 검증 결과 텍스트 생성"
  do
    let text = ""

    // 테스트 변화
    let passed_delta = after.tests_passed - before.tests_passed
    let sign = if passed_delta >= 0 "+" else ""
    text = text + "테스트 변화: " + sign + int_to_str(passed_delta) +
           " (" + int_to_str(before.tests_passed) + " → " + int_to_str(after.tests_passed) + ")\n"

    // 회귀
    if arr_len(regression.new_failures) > 0
      text = text + "새 실패: " + format_failed_list(regression.new_failures) + "\n"
    end
    if arr_len(regression.fixed_tests) > 0
      text = text + "수정됨: " + format_test_list(regression.fixed_tests) + "\n"
    end

    // Claude 판단
    text = text + "Claude 검증: " + int_to_str(claude_confidence) + "% 신뢰도\n"

    if arr_len(claude_issues) > 0
      text = text + "잠재적 문제:\n"
      let i = 0
      let n = arr_len(claude_issues)
      while i < n
        text = text + "  - " + arr_get(claude_issues, i) + "\n"
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    return text
end

fn format_test_list(tests: array) -> string
  do
    let n = arr_len(tests)
    if n == 0 return "(없음)"
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if i > 0 result = result + ", "
      result = result + arr_get(tests, i)
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn format_failed_list(tests: array) -> string
  do
    let n = arr_len(tests)
    if n == 0 return "(없음)"
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if i > 0 result = result + ", "
      result = result + arr_get(tests, i)
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn empty_test_result() -> TestRunResult
  do
    return TestRunResult {
      passed: false,
      exit_code: -1,
      stdout: "",
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: 0,
      tests_total: 0,
      tests_passed: 0,
      tests_failed: 0,
      failed_tests: []
    }
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn extract_first_error(output: string) -> string
  do
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let n = arr_len(lines)
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
      if str_contains(line, "error")
        return str_truncate(str_trim(line), 120)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return str_truncate(output, 120)
end

fn count_occurrences(s: string, pattern: string) -> i32
  do
    let count = 0
    let pos = 0
    let plen = str_len(pattern)
    let slen = str_len(s)

    while pos <= slen - plen
      if str_substr(s, pos, pos + plen) == pattern
        count = count + 1
        pos = pos + plen
      else
        pos = pos + 1
      end
    end

    return count
end

fn arr_contains_str(arr: array, s: string) -> bool
  do
    let n = arr_len(arr)
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if arr_get(arr, i) == s return true
      i = i + 1
    end
    return false
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

fn json_extract_string(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    if str_contains(json, search)
      let after = str_after(json, search)
      let result = ""
      let i = 0
      let len = str_len(after)
      while i < len
        let ch = str_char(after, i)
        if ch == "\\" i = i + 1
        else if ch == "\"" return result
        else result = result + ch
        i = i + 1
      end
    end
    return ""
end

fn json_extract_int(json: string, key: string) -> i32
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    if str_contains(json, search)
      let after = str_trim(str_after(json, search))
      let result = ""
      let i = 0
      let len = str_len(after)
      while i < len
        let ch = str_char(after, i)
        if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
           ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
          result = result + ch
        else break
        i = i + 1
      end
      return parse_int_from_str(result)
    end
    return 0
end

fn json_extract_str_array(json: string, key: string) -> array
  do
    let result = []
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    if !str_contains(json, search) return result

    let after = str_trim(str_after(json, search))
    if str_len(after) == 0 || str_char(after, 0) != "[" return result

    let i = 1
    let len = str_len(after)
    let current = ""
    let in_str = false

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(after, i)
      if in_str
        if ch == "\\" i = i + 1
        else if ch == "\""
          result = arr_push(result, current)
          current = ""
          in_str = false
        else current = current + ch
      else
        if ch == "\"" in_str = true
        else if ch == "]" break
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    return result
end

fn str_truncate(s: string, max_len: i32) -> string
  do
    if str_len(s) <= max_len return s
    return str_substr(s, 0, max_len - 3) + "..."
end

// ============================================================
// retry_strategy.fl - 재시도 전략 엔진 (Phase 2)
// 시도 번호에 따른 동적 전략 조정
// 실패 원인 학습 → 다음 시도 최적화
// ============================================================

struct RetryStrategy {
  attempt: i32,
  approach: string,         // "minimal" | "contextual" | "aggressive" | "refactor"
  context_radius: i32,      // 패치 컨텍스트 줄 수
  temperature: i32,         // Claude 온도 (100배 정수)
  include_related: bool,    // 연관 파일 포함
  expand_scope: bool,       // 수정 범위 확장
  prompt_additions: string, // 추가 프롬프트 지시사항
  reason: string            // 이 전략을 선택한 이유
}

struct FailureMemory {
  failed_patches: array,    // 실패한 diff 텍스트
  failed_reasons: array,    // 실패 이유 배열
  tried_approaches: array,  // 시도한 approach 배열
  last_verify_result: string // 마지막 검증 결과
}

// ==================== 전략 선택 ====================

fn get_retry_strategy(attempt: i32, prev_failure: string, error: ParsedError, memory: FailureMemory) -> RetryStrategy
  intent "시도 번호와 이전 실패 원인으로 최적 전략 선택"
  do
    if attempt == 1
      return strategy_minimal(error)
    end

    if attempt == 2
      return strategy_contextual(error, prev_failure, memory)
    end

    if attempt == 3
      return strategy_aggressive(error, prev_failure, memory)
    end

    // 4회 이상: 최후 수단
    return strategy_refactor(error, memory)
end

fn strategy_minimal(error: ParsedError) -> RetryStrategy
  intent "1차 시도: 최소한의 변경으로 수정"
  do
    return RetryStrategy {
      attempt: 1,
      approach: "minimal",
      context_radius: 5,
      temperature: 10,     // 0.1 - 결정적
      include_related: false,
      expand_scope: false,
      prompt_additions: "가능한 최소한의 변경만 하세요. 1-3줄 이내 수정 권장.",
      reason: "1차 시도: 최소 변경"
    }
end

fn strategy_contextual(error: ParsedError, prev_failure: string, memory: FailureMemory) -> RetryStrategy
  intent "2차 시도: 더 많은 컨텍스트 포함"
  do
    let additions = "이전 시도가 실패했습니다. 더 넓은 컨텍스트를 고려하세요.\n"

    // 이전 실패 이유 분석
    if str_contains(prev_failure, "syntax")
      additions = additions + "주의: 이전 패치에 문법 오류가 있었습니다. 문법을 꼼꼼히 확인하세요.\n"
    end

    if str_contains(prev_failure, "regression")
      additions = additions + "주의: 이전 패치가 다른 테스트를 깨뜨렸습니다. 부작용 없이 수정하세요.\n"
    end

    if str_contains(prev_failure, "context")
      additions = additions + "주의: 컨텍스트 불일치가 있었습니다. 정확한 줄 번호를 확인하세요.\n"
    end

    return RetryStrategy {
      attempt: 2,
      approach: "contextual",
      context_radius: 15,   // 더 넓은 컨텍스트
      temperature: 20,      // 약간 더 창의적
      include_related: true,
      expand_scope: false,
      prompt_additions: additions,
      reason: "2차 시도: 컨텍스트 확장"
    }
end

fn strategy_aggressive(error: ParsedError, prev_failure: string, memory: FailureMemory) -> RetryStrategy
  intent "3차 시도: 더 적극적인 수정 (블록/함수 단위)"
  do
    let additions = "이전 2번의 시도가 실패했습니다.\n"
    additions = additions + "더 근본적인 수정이 필요할 수 있습니다.\n"

    if error.error_type == "type_mismatch" || error.error_type == "type_error"
      additions = additions + "타입 변환이나 캐스팅을 추가하는 것을 고려하세요.\n"
      additions = additions + "또는 반환 타입 자체를 변경하는 것을 검토하세요.\n"
    end

    if error.error_type == "logic_error" || str_contains(prev_failure, "assertion")
      additions = additions + "로직 전체를 검토하고, 알고리즘 자체를 수정하세요.\n"
      additions = additions + "단순한 값 변경이 아닌 흐름 수정이 필요할 수 있습니다.\n"
    end

    if error.error_type == "ownership_error" || str_contains(error.error_msg, "borrow")
      additions = additions + "소유권 패턴을 바꿔보세요: Clone, Rc, Arc 또는 참조 변경\n"
    end

    // 실패한 접근법 피하기
    let tried = memory.tried_approaches
    if arr_contains_str(tried, "line_change")
      additions = additions + "이전 줄 단위 수정 대신 블록 단위로 수정하세요.\n"
    end

    return RetryStrategy {
      attempt: 3,
      approach: "aggressive",
      context_radius: 30,   // 함수 전체 컨텍스트
      temperature: 40,      // 더 창의적
      include_related: true,
      expand_scope: true,
      prompt_additions: additions,
      reason: "3차 시도: 적극적 수정"
    }
end

fn strategy_refactor(error: ParsedError, memory: FailureMemory) -> RetryStrategy
  intent "최후 수단: 함수/모듈 수준 리팩토링"
  do
    let additions = "이전 모든 시도가 실패했습니다. 마지막 시도입니다.\n"
    additions = additions + "함수나 구조체 자체를 재설계하는 것을 고려하세요.\n"
    additions = additions + "에러의 근본 원인을 제거하는 큰 그림의 수정이 필요합니다.\n"
    additions = additions + "코드 스타일이나 기존 패턴을 완전히 따를 필요가 없습니다.\n"
    additions = additions + "동작의 정확성을 최우선으로 하세요.\n"

    return RetryStrategy {
      attempt: arr_len(memory.tried_approaches) + 1,
      approach: "refactor",
      context_radius: 50,
      temperature: 60,
      include_related: true,
      expand_scope: true,
      prompt_additions: additions,
      reason: "최후 수단: 리팩토링"
    }
end

// ==================== 프롬프트 강화 ====================

fn enhance_analyze_prompt(base_prompt: string, strategy: RetryStrategy, memory: FailureMemory) -> string
  intent "재시도 전략으로 분석 프롬프트 강화"
  do
    let enhanced = base_prompt

    if strategy.attempt > 1
      enhanced = enhanced + "\n\n## 이전 시도 실패 정보\n"

      // 이전 실패 패치들
      let n_failed = arr_len(memory.failed_patches)
      if n_failed > 0
        enhanced = enhanced + "### 실패한 패치들\n"
        let i = 0
        while i < n_failed
          enhanced = enhanced + "**실패 " + int_to_str(i + 1) + "** (이유: " +
                     arr_get(memory.failed_reasons, i) + "):\n"
          enhanced = enhanced + "```diff\n" + arr_get(memory.failed_patches, i) + "\n```\n"
          i = i + 1
        end
      end

      enhanced = enhanced + "\n## 이번 시도 지침\n"
      enhanced = enhanced + strategy.prompt_additions
    end

    return enhanced
end

fn enhance_patch_prompt(base_prompt: string, strategy: RetryStrategy, memory: FailureMemory, related_code: string) -> string
  intent "재시도 전략으로 패치 생성 프롬프트 강화"
  do
    let enhanced = base_prompt

    // 연관 코드 추가
    if strategy.include_related && str_len(related_code) > 0
      enhanced = enhanced + "\n\n## 연관 코드 (참고)\n"
      enhanced = enhanced + "```\n" + str_truncate(related_code, 2000) + "\n```\n"
    end

    // 전략별 추가 지시
    enhanced = enhanced + "\n## 중요 지침\n"
    enhanced = enhanced + strategy.prompt_additions

    // 이전 실패 패치 회피
    if arr_len(memory.failed_patches) > 0
      enhanced = enhanced + "\n## 반드시 피해야 할 패치\n"
      enhanced = enhanced + "다음 패치들은 이미 실패했습니다. 다른 접근을 취하세요:\n"
      let i = 0
      let n = arr_len(memory.failed_patches)
      while i < n
        enhanced = enhanced + "```diff\n" + arr_get(memory.failed_patches, i) + "\n```\n"
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    // 마지막 검증 결과
    if memory.last_verify_result != ""
      enhanced = enhanced + "\n## 마지막 검증 실패 원인\n"
      enhanced = enhanced + memory.last_verify_result + "\n"
    end

    return enhanced
end

// ==================== 메모리 업데이트 ====================

fn memory_add_failure(memory: FailureMemory, diff: string, reason: string, approach: string) -> FailureMemory
  intent "실패한 패치를 메모리에 추가"
  do
    return FailureMemory {
      failed_patches: arr_push(memory.failed_patches, diff),
      failed_reasons: arr_push(memory.failed_reasons, reason),
      tried_approaches: arr_push(memory.tried_approaches, approach),
      last_verify_result: reason
    }
end

fn memory_init() -> FailureMemory
  intent "빈 실패 메모리 초기화"
  do
    return FailureMemory {
      failed_patches: [],
      failed_reasons: [],
      tried_approaches: [],
      last_verify_result: ""
    }
end

fn failure_reason_from_verify(verify: VerifyResult) -> string
  intent "검증 결과에서 실패 이유 추출"
  do
    if !verify.syntax_ok
      return "syntax: " + verify.details
    end

    if verify.regression_detected
      return "regression: 새 실패=" + format_list(verify.new_failures)
    end

    if !verify.tests_after.passed
      let count = int_to_str(verify.tests_after.tests_failed)
      return "tests_failed: " + count + "개 실패"
    end

    if !verify.claude_verdict
      return "claude_rejected: 신뢰도=" + int_to_str(verify.claude_confidence)
    end

    return "unknown: " + str_truncate(verify.details, 100)
end

fn format_list(arr: array) -> string
  do
    let n = arr_len(arr)
    if n == 0 return "(empty)"
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if i > 0 result = result + ","
      result = result + arr_get(arr, i)
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

// ==================== 전략 리포트 ====================

fn strategy_report(strategy: RetryStrategy) -> string
  intent "전략 요약 문자열"
  do
    return "시도 " + int_to_str(strategy.attempt) +
           " | 전략: " + strategy.approach +
           " | 컨텍스트: " + int_to_str(strategy.context_radius) + "줄" +
           " | 온도: " + float_str(strategy.temperature) +
           " | " + strategy.reason
end

fn float_str(val_x100: i32) -> string
  do
    let int_part = val_x100 / 100
    let dec_part = val_x100 % 100
    let dec_str = ""
    if dec_part < 10
      dec_str = "0" + int_to_str(dec_part)
    else
      dec_str = int_to_str(dec_part)
    end
    return int_to_str(int_part) + "." + dec_str
end

// ==================== 컨텍스트 확장 ====================

fn expand_context_for_strategy(
  file_content: string,
  error: ParsedError,
  strategy: RetryStrategy
) -> string
  intent "전략에 따라 파일 컨텍스트 확장"
  do
    if error.line_num <= 0
      return file_content  // 줄 번호 없으면 전체 반환
    end

    let lines = str_split_lines(file_content)
    let total = arr_len(lines)
    let radius = strategy.context_radius

    let start = error.line_num - 1 - radius  // 0-indexed
    if start < 0 start = 0

    let end_idx = error.line_num - 1 + radius
    if end_idx >= total end_idx = total - 1

    // 함수 경계까지 확장 (aggressive/refactor)
    if strategy.expand_scope
      start = find_function_start(lines, error.line_num - 1)
      end_idx = find_function_end(lines, error.line_num - 1)
    end

    let result = ""
    let i = start

    while i <= end_idx
      let line_num_str = pad_left(int_to_str(i + 1), 4)
      let marker = "  "
      if i == error.line_num - 1
        marker = "→ "
      end
      result = result + line_num_str + marker + arr_get(lines, i) + "\n"
      i = i + 1
    end

    return result
end

fn find_function_start(lines: array, from_line: i32) -> i32
  intent "from_line에서 위로 탐색해 함수 시작 줄 찾기"
  do
    let i = from_line

    while i > 0
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
      let trimmed = str_trim(line)

      // 함수 선언 패턴
      if str_starts_with(trimmed, "fn ") ||
         str_starts_with(trimmed, "pub fn ") ||
         str_starts_with(trimmed, "func ") ||
         str_starts_with(trimmed, "def ") ||
         str_starts_with(trimmed, "async fn ")
        return i
      end

      // 빈 줄 + 함수 선언 패턴 (다음 블록의 시작)
      if str_len(trimmed) == 0 && i < from_line - 5
        return i + 1
      end

      i = i - 1
    end

    return 0
end

fn find_function_end(lines: array, from_line: i32) -> i32
  intent "from_line에서 아래로 탐색해 함수 끝 줄 찾기"
  do
    let total = arr_len(lines)
    let i = from_line
    let brace_depth = 0
    let found_open = false

    while i < total
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
      let j = 0
      let llen = str_len(line)

      while j < llen
        let ch = str_char(line, j)
        if ch == "{"
          brace_depth = brace_depth + 1
          found_open = true
        else if ch == "}"
          brace_depth = brace_depth - 1
          if found_open && brace_depth == 0
            return i
          end
        end
        j = j + 1
      end

      // FreeLang "end" 키워드
      if str_trim(line) == "end"
        return i
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return total - 1

fn pad_left(s: string, width: i32) -> string
  intent "왼쪽 공백 패딩"
  do

    let neg = false
    if num < 0

    while num > 0

      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10

    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
