// ============================================================
// retry_strategy.fl - 재시도 전략 엔진 (Phase 2)
// 시도 번호에 따른 동적 전략 조정
// 실패 원인 학습 → 다음 시도 최적화
// ============================================================

struct RetryStrategy {
  attempt: i32,
  approach: string,         // "minimal" | "contextual" | "aggressive" | "refactor"
  context_radius: i32,      // 패치 컨텍스트 줄 수
  temperature: i32,         // Claude 온도 (100배 정수)
  include_related: bool,    // 연관 파일 포함
  expand_scope: bool,       // 수정 범위 확장
  prompt_additions: string, // 추가 프롬프트 지시사항
  reason: string            // 이 전략을 선택한 이유
}

struct FailureMemory {
  failed_patches: array,    // 실패한 diff 텍스트
  failed_reasons: array,    // 실패 이유 배열
  tried_approaches: array,  // 시도한 approach 배열
  last_verify_result: string // 마지막 검증 결과
}

// ==================== 전략 선택 ====================

fn get_retry_strategy(attempt: i32, prev_failure: string, error: ParsedError, memory: FailureMemory) -> RetryStrategy
  intent "시도 번호와 이전 실패 원인으로 최적 전략 선택"
  do
    if attempt == 1
      return strategy_minimal(error)
    end

    if attempt == 2
      return strategy_contextual(error, prev_failure, memory)
    end

    if attempt == 3
      return strategy_aggressive(error, prev_failure, memory)
    end

    // 4회 이상: 최후 수단
    return strategy_refactor(error, memory)
end

fn strategy_minimal(error: ParsedError) -> RetryStrategy
  intent "1차 시도: 최소한의 변경으로 수정"
  do
    return RetryStrategy {
      attempt: 1,
      approach: "minimal",
      context_radius: 5,
      temperature: 10,     // 0.1 - 결정적
      include_related: false,
      expand_scope: false,
      prompt_additions: "가능한 최소한의 변경만 하세요. 1-3줄 이내 수정 권장.",
      reason: "1차 시도: 최소 변경"
    }
end

fn strategy_contextual(error: ParsedError, prev_failure: string, memory: FailureMemory) -> RetryStrategy
  intent "2차 시도: 더 많은 컨텍스트 포함"
  do
    let additions = "이전 시도가 실패했습니다. 더 넓은 컨텍스트를 고려하세요.\n"

    // 이전 실패 이유 분석
    if str_contains(prev_failure, "syntax")
      additions = additions + "주의: 이전 패치에 문법 오류가 있었습니다. 문법을 꼼꼼히 확인하세요.\n"
    end

    if str_contains(prev_failure, "regression")
      additions = additions + "주의: 이전 패치가 다른 테스트를 깨뜨렸습니다. 부작용 없이 수정하세요.\n"
    end

    if str_contains(prev_failure, "context")
      additions = additions + "주의: 컨텍스트 불일치가 있었습니다. 정확한 줄 번호를 확인하세요.\n"
    end

    return RetryStrategy {
      attempt: 2,
      approach: "contextual",
      context_radius: 15,   // 더 넓은 컨텍스트
      temperature: 20,      // 약간 더 창의적
      include_related: true,
      expand_scope: false,
      prompt_additions: additions,
      reason: "2차 시도: 컨텍스트 확장"
    }
end

fn strategy_aggressive(error: ParsedError, prev_failure: string, memory: FailureMemory) -> RetryStrategy
  intent "3차 시도: 더 적극적인 수정 (블록/함수 단위)"
  do
    let additions = "이전 2번의 시도가 실패했습니다.\n"
    additions = additions + "더 근본적인 수정이 필요할 수 있습니다.\n"

    if error.error_type == "type_mismatch" || error.error_type == "type_error"
      additions = additions + "타입 변환이나 캐스팅을 추가하는 것을 고려하세요.\n"
      additions = additions + "또는 반환 타입 자체를 변경하는 것을 검토하세요.\n"
    end

    if error.error_type == "logic_error" || str_contains(prev_failure, "assertion")
      additions = additions + "로직 전체를 검토하고, 알고리즘 자체를 수정하세요.\n"
      additions = additions + "단순한 값 변경이 아닌 흐름 수정이 필요할 수 있습니다.\n"
    end

    if error.error_type == "ownership_error" || str_contains(error.error_msg, "borrow")
      additions = additions + "소유권 패턴을 바꿔보세요: Clone, Rc, Arc 또는 참조 변경\n"
    end

    // 실패한 접근법 피하기
    let tried = memory.tried_approaches
    if arr_contains_str(tried, "line_change")
      additions = additions + "이전 줄 단위 수정 대신 블록 단위로 수정하세요.\n"
    end

    return RetryStrategy {
      attempt: 3,
      approach: "aggressive",
      context_radius: 30,   // 함수 전체 컨텍스트
      temperature: 40,      // 더 창의적
      include_related: true,
      expand_scope: true,
      prompt_additions: additions,
      reason: "3차 시도: 적극적 수정"
    }
end

fn strategy_refactor(error: ParsedError, memory: FailureMemory) -> RetryStrategy
  intent "최후 수단: 함수/모듈 수준 리팩토링"
  do
    let additions = "이전 모든 시도가 실패했습니다. 마지막 시도입니다.\n"
    additions = additions + "함수나 구조체 자체를 재설계하는 것을 고려하세요.\n"
    additions = additions + "에러의 근본 원인을 제거하는 큰 그림의 수정이 필요합니다.\n"
    additions = additions + "코드 스타일이나 기존 패턴을 완전히 따를 필요가 없습니다.\n"
    additions = additions + "동작의 정확성을 최우선으로 하세요.\n"

    return RetryStrategy {
      attempt: arr_len(memory.tried_approaches) + 1,
      approach: "refactor",
      context_radius: 50,
      temperature: 60,
      include_related: true,
      expand_scope: true,
      prompt_additions: additions,
      reason: "최후 수단: 리팩토링"
    }
end

// ==================== 프롬프트 강화 ====================

fn enhance_analyze_prompt(base_prompt: string, strategy: RetryStrategy, memory: FailureMemory) -> string
  intent "재시도 전략으로 분석 프롬프트 강화"
  do
    let enhanced = base_prompt

    if strategy.attempt > 1
      enhanced = enhanced + "\n\n## 이전 시도 실패 정보\n"

      // 이전 실패 패치들
      let n_failed = arr_len(memory.failed_patches)
      if n_failed > 0
        enhanced = enhanced + "### 실패한 패치들\n"
        let i = 0
        while i < n_failed
          enhanced = enhanced + "**실패 " + int_to_str(i + 1) + "** (이유: " +
                     arr_get(memory.failed_reasons, i) + "):\n"
          enhanced = enhanced + "```diff\n" + arr_get(memory.failed_patches, i) + "\n```\n"
          i = i + 1
        end
      end

      enhanced = enhanced + "\n## 이번 시도 지침\n"
      enhanced = enhanced + strategy.prompt_additions
    end

    return enhanced
end

fn enhance_patch_prompt(base_prompt: string, strategy: RetryStrategy, memory: FailureMemory, related_code: string) -> string
  intent "재시도 전략으로 패치 생성 프롬프트 강화"
  do
    let enhanced = base_prompt

    // 연관 코드 추가
    if strategy.include_related && str_len(related_code) > 0
      enhanced = enhanced + "\n\n## 연관 코드 (참고)\n"
      enhanced = enhanced + "```\n" + str_truncate(related_code, 2000) + "\n```\n"
    end

    // 전략별 추가 지시
    enhanced = enhanced + "\n## 중요 지침\n"
    enhanced = enhanced + strategy.prompt_additions

    // 이전 실패 패치 회피
    if arr_len(memory.failed_patches) > 0
      enhanced = enhanced + "\n## 반드시 피해야 할 패치\n"
      enhanced = enhanced + "다음 패치들은 이미 실패했습니다. 다른 접근을 취하세요:\n"
      let i = 0
      let n = arr_len(memory.failed_patches)
      while i < n
        enhanced = enhanced + "```diff\n" + arr_get(memory.failed_patches, i) + "\n```\n"
        i = i + 1
      end
    end

    // 마지막 검증 결과
    if memory.last_verify_result != ""
      enhanced = enhanced + "\n## 마지막 검증 실패 원인\n"
      enhanced = enhanced + memory.last_verify_result + "\n"
    end

    return enhanced
end

// ==================== 메모리 업데이트 ====================

fn memory_add_failure(memory: FailureMemory, diff: string, reason: string, approach: string) -> FailureMemory
  intent "실패한 패치를 메모리에 추가"
  do
    return FailureMemory {
      failed_patches: arr_push(memory.failed_patches, diff),
      failed_reasons: arr_push(memory.failed_reasons, reason),
      tried_approaches: arr_push(memory.tried_approaches, approach),
      last_verify_result: reason
    }
end

fn memory_init() -> FailureMemory
  intent "빈 실패 메모리 초기화"
  do
    return FailureMemory {
      failed_patches: [],
      failed_reasons: [],
      tried_approaches: [],
      last_verify_result: ""
    }
end

fn failure_reason_from_verify(verify: VerifyResult) -> string
  intent "검증 결과에서 실패 이유 추출"
  do
    if !verify.syntax_ok
      return "syntax: " + verify.details
    end

    if verify.regression_detected
      return "regression: 새 실패=" + format_list(verify.new_failures)
    end

    if !verify.tests_after.passed
      let count = int_to_str(verify.tests_after.tests_failed)
      return "tests_failed: " + count + "개 실패"
    end

    if !verify.claude_verdict
      return "claude_rejected: 신뢰도=" + int_to_str(verify.claude_confidence)
    end

    return "unknown: " + str_truncate(verify.details, 100)
end

fn format_list(arr: array) -> string
  do
    let n = arr_len(arr)
    if n == 0 return "(empty)"
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if i > 0 result = result + ","
      result = result + arr_get(arr, i)
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

// ==================== 전략 리포트 ====================

fn strategy_report(strategy: RetryStrategy) -> string
  intent "전략 요약 문자열"
  do
    return "시도 " + int_to_str(strategy.attempt) +
           " | 전략: " + strategy.approach +
           " | 컨텍스트: " + int_to_str(strategy.context_radius) + "줄" +
           " | 온도: " + float_str(strategy.temperature) +
           " | " + strategy.reason
end

fn float_str(val_x100: i32) -> string
  do
    let int_part = val_x100 / 100
    let dec_part = val_x100 % 100
    let dec_str = ""
    if dec_part < 10
      dec_str = "0" + int_to_str(dec_part)
    else
      dec_str = int_to_str(dec_part)
    end
    return int_to_str(int_part) + "." + dec_str
end

// ==================== 컨텍스트 확장 ====================

fn expand_context_for_strategy(
  file_content: string,
  error: ParsedError,
  strategy: RetryStrategy
) -> string
  intent "전략에 따라 파일 컨텍스트 확장"
  do
    if error.line_num <= 0
      return file_content  // 줄 번호 없으면 전체 반환
    end

    let lines = str_split_lines(file_content)
    let total = arr_len(lines)
    let radius = strategy.context_radius

    let start = error.line_num - 1 - radius  // 0-indexed
    if start < 0 start = 0

    let end_idx = error.line_num - 1 + radius
    if end_idx >= total end_idx = total - 1

    // 함수 경계까지 확장 (aggressive/refactor)
    if strategy.expand_scope
      start = find_function_start(lines, error.line_num - 1)
      end_idx = find_function_end(lines, error.line_num - 1)
    end

    let result = ""
    let i = start

    while i <= end_idx
      let line_num_str = pad_left(int_to_str(i + 1), 4)
      let marker = "  "
      if i == error.line_num - 1
        marker = "→ "
      end
      result = result + line_num_str + marker + arr_get(lines, i) + "\n"
      i = i + 1
    end

    return result
end

fn find_function_start(lines: array, from_line: i32) -> i32
  intent "from_line에서 위로 탐색해 함수 시작 줄 찾기"
  do
    let i = from_line

    while i > 0
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
      let trimmed = str_trim(line)

      // 함수 선언 패턴
      if str_starts_with(trimmed, "fn ") ||
         str_starts_with(trimmed, "pub fn ") ||
         str_starts_with(trimmed, "func ") ||
         str_starts_with(trimmed, "def ") ||
         str_starts_with(trimmed, "async fn ")
        return i
      end

      // 빈 줄 + 함수 선언 패턴 (다음 블록의 시작)
      if str_len(trimmed) == 0 && i < from_line - 5
        return i + 1
      end

      i = i - 1
    end

    return 0
end

fn find_function_end(lines: array, from_line: i32) -> i32
  intent "from_line에서 아래로 탐색해 함수 끝 줄 찾기"
  do
    let total = arr_len(lines)
    let i = from_line
    let brace_depth = 0
    let found_open = false

    while i < total
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
      let j = 0
      let llen = str_len(line)

      while j < llen
        let ch = str_char(line, j)
        if ch == "{"
          brace_depth = brace_depth + 1
          found_open = true
        else if ch == "}"
          brace_depth = brace_depth - 1
          if found_open && brace_depth == 0
            return i
          end
        end
        j = j + 1
      end

      // FreeLang "end" 키워드
      if str_trim(line) == "end"
        return i
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return total - 1
end

fn pad_left(s: string, width: i32) -> string
  intent "왼쪽 공백 패딩"
  do
    let len = str_len(s)
    let result = s
    while str_len(result) < width
      result = " " + result
    end
    return result
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn arr_contains_str(arr: array, s: string) -> bool
  do
    let n = arr_len(arr)
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if arr_get(arr, i) == s return true
      i = i + 1
    end
    return false
end

fn arr_push_str(arr: array, s: string) -> array
  do
    return arr_push(arr, s)
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn str_truncate(s: string, max_len: i32) -> string

// ============================================================
// test_runner.fl - 테스트 실행 & 결과 검증
// exec() 기반 - 외부 라이브러리 없음
// ============================================================

struct TestRunConfig {
  repo_path: string,     // 로컬 클론 경로
  lang: string,          // "rust" | "go" | "freelang"
  test_filter: string,   // 특정 테스트만 실행 (빈 문자열이면 전체)
  timeout_sec: i32,
  env_vars: array        // 추가 환경 변수
}

struct TestRunResult {
  passed: bool,
  exit_code: i32,
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  duration_ms: i32,
  tests_total: i32,
  tests_passed: i32,
  tests_failed: i32,
  failed_tests: array    // 실패한 테스트 이름 배열
}

// ==================== 메인 실행 ====================

fn run_tests(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 실행 및 결과 파싱"
  do
    let cmd = build_test_command(cfg)
    let start_time = now_ms()

    let output = exec_with_timeout(cmd, cfg.repo_path, cfg.timeout_sec)
    let duration = now_ms() - start_time

    match output
      Ok(out) => {
        return parse_test_output(out.stdout, out.stderr, out.exit_code, cfg.lang, duration)
      }
      Err(e) => {
        return TestRunResult {
          passed: false,
          exit_code: -1,
          stdout: "",
          stderr: "실행 실패: " + e,
          duration_ms: duration,
          tests_total: 0,
          tests_passed: 0,
          tests_failed: 0,
          failed_tests: []
        }
      }
    end
end

fn build_test_command(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "언어별 테스트 명령어 생성"
  do
    if cfg.lang == "rust"
      return build_rust_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "go"
      return build_go_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "freelang"
      return build_fl_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    // 기본: Makefile 있으면 make test
    return "make test 2>&1"
end

fn build_rust_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Rust 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "cargo test"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_go_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Go 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "go test ./..."

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -run " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    cmd = cmd + " -v 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_fl_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "fl test"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " --filter " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

// ==================== 출력 파싱 ====================

fn parse_test_output(stdout: string, stderr: string, exit_code: i32, lang: string, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 출력 파싱 (언어별)"
  do
    let combined = stdout + stderr

    if lang == "rust"
      return parse_rust_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    if lang == "go"
      return parse_go_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    if lang == "freelang"
      return parse_fl_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    // 기본: exit code만 확인
    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: stdout,
      stderr: stderr,
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: 0,
      tests_passed: 0,
      tests_failed: 0,
      failed_tests: []
    }
end

fn parse_rust_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "cargo test 출력 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out"
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // 결과 요약 줄 파싱
      if str_starts_with(line, "test result:")
        passed = parse_rust_count(line, " passed")
        failed = parse_rust_count(line, " failed")
        total = passed + failed
      end

      // 실패한 테스트 목록: "FAILED tests::test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "FAILED ")
        let test_name = str_after(line, "FAILED ")
        failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, str_trim(test_name))
      end

      // "test tests::test_name ... FAILED"
      if str_ends_with(str_trim(line), "FAILED") && str_starts_with(line, "test ")
        let test_name = str_between(line, "test ", " ...")
        if test_name != ""
          failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, test_name)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_rust_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32
  intent "Rust 요약 줄에서 특정 카운트 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; ..."
    if str_contains(line, label)
      let before_label = str_before(line, label)
      let parts = str_split_by_space(before_label)
      let last_part = arr_last_str(parts)
      return parse_int_from_str(last_part)
    end
    return 0
end

fn parse_go_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "go test -v 출력 파싱"
  do
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // "--- PASS: TestName (0.01s)"
      if str_starts_with(line, "--- PASS:")
        passed = passed + 1
        total = total + 1
      end

      // "--- FAIL: TestName (0.01s)"
      if str_starts_with(line, "--- FAIL:")
        failed = failed + 1
        total = total + 1
        let test_name = str_between(line, "--- FAIL: ", " (")
        if test_name != ""
          failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, test_name)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_fl_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 출력 파싱"
  do
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // "PASS: test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "PASS: ")
        passed = passed + 1
        total = total + 1
      end

      // "FAIL: test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "FAIL: ")
        failed = failed + 1
        total = total + 1
        let test_name = str_after(line, "FAIL: ")
        failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, str_trim(test_name))
      end

      // "Tests: 10 passed, 2 failed"
      if str_contains(line, "Tests:") && str_contains(line, "passed")
        total = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "passed") + parse_fl_summary_count(line, "failed")
        passed = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "passed")
        failed = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "failed")
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_fl_summary_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32
  intent "FreeLang 요약 줄에서 카운트 파싱"
  do
    if str_contains(line, label)
      let before = str_before(line, label)
      let trimmed = str_trim(before)
      // 마지막 공백 이후 숫자
      if str_contains(trimmed, " ")
        let last = str_after_last(trimmed, " ")
        return parse_int_from_str(last)
      end
      return parse_int_from_str(trimmed)
    end
    return 0
end

// ==================== 저장소 클론/업데이트 ====================

fn clone_repo(gogs_url: string, owner: string, repo: string, branch: string, target_path: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "저장소 클론"
  do
    let clone_url = gogs_url + "/" + owner + "/" + repo + ".git"
    let cmd = "git clone --depth=1 --branch " + branch +
              " '" + clone_url + "' '" + target_path + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("클론 실패: " + e)
    end
end

fn checkout_patch_branch(repo_path: string, branch: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "패치 브랜치 체크아웃"
  do
    let cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git checkout -b '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("체크아웃 실패: " + e)
    end
end

fn write_patched_file(repo_path: string, file_path: string, content: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "패치된 파일 로컬에 쓰기"
  do
    let full_path = repo_path + "/" + file_path
    let result = file_write(full_path, content)
    return result
end

fn commit_and_push(repo_path: string, branch: string, message: string, gogs_url: string, token: string) -> Result<string, string>
  intent "변경사항 커밋 + 원격 Push"
  do
    // 1. git add
    let add_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git add -A 2>&1"
    match exec(add_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git add 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 2. git commit
    let commit_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && " +
                     "git -c user.email='heal-agent@freelang.dev' " +
                     "-c user.name='Self-Healing Agent' " +
                     "commit -m '" + shell_escape_single(message) + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(commit_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git commit 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 3. SHA 가져오기
    let sha_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git rev-parse HEAD 2>&1"
    let sha = ""
    match exec(sha_cmd)
      Ok(s) => sha = str_trim(s)
      Err(_) => sha = "unknown"
    end

    // 4. git push
    let push_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git push origin '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(push_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git push 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    return Ok(sha)
end

// ==================== exec 헬퍼 ====================

struct ExecOutput {
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  exit_code: i32
}

fn exec_with_timeout(cmd: string, work_dir: string, timeout_sec: i32) -> Result<ExecOutput, string>
  intent "타임아웃 있는 명령 실행"
  do
    // timeout 명령으로 래핑
    let full_cmd = "cd '" + work_dir + "' && " +
                   "timeout " + int_to_str(timeout_sec) +
                   " sh -c '" + shell_escape_single(cmd) + "' 2>&1; echo \"EXIT:$?\""

    match exec(full_cmd)
      Ok(output) => {
        // "EXIT:0" 패턴으로 exit code 추출
        let exit_code = 0
        if str_contains(output, "EXIT:")
          let exit_str = str_after(output, "EXIT:")
          exit_code = parse_int_from_str(str_trim(exit_str))
        end

        let clean_output = str_before(output, "\nEXIT:")

        return Ok(ExecOutput {
          stdout: clean_output,
          stderr: "",
          exit_code: exit_code
        })
      }
      Err(e) => return Err(e)
    end
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn arr_last_str(arr: array) -> string
  intent "배열의 마지막 문자열 요소"
  do
    let total = arr_len(arr)
    if total == 0
      return ""
    end
    return arr_get(arr, total - 1)
end

fn str_split_by_space(s: string) -> array
  intent "공백으로 문자열 분할"
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t"
        if str_len(current) > 0
          result = arr_push(result, current)
          current = ""
        end
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    if str_len(current) > 0
      result = arr_push(result, current)
    end

    return result
end

fn shell_escape_single(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "'"
        result = result + "'\\''"
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

  intent "언어별 테스트 명령어 생성"
  do
    if cfg.lang == "rust"
      return build_rust_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "freelang"
      return build_fl_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "python"
      return build_python_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "node" || cfg.lang == "javascript" || cfg.lang == "typescript"
      return build_node_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    // 기본: Makefile 있으면 make test
    return "make test 2>&1"

fn build_rust_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Rust 테스트 명령어 (커버리지/병렬 옵션 포함)"
  do
    if cfg.with_coverage
      // cargo llvm-cov 사용 (설치 필요)
      let cmd = "cargo llvm-cov"
      if cfg.test_filter != ""
        cmd = cmd + " --test " + cfg.test_filter
      end
      cmd = cmd + " --summary-only 2>&1"
      return cmd
    end

    let cmd = "cargo test"

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -- --test-threads=4"
    end

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " -- --nocapture"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_go_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Go 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "go test ./..."

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -run " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.with_coverage
      cmd = cmd + " -coverprofile=coverage.out"
    end

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -parallel 4"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " -v 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_fl_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "fl test"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " --filter " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " --verbose"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_python_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Python pytest 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "python3 -m pytest"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -k '" + cfg.test_filter + "'"
    end

    if cfg.with_coverage
      cmd = cmd + " --cov=. --cov-report=term-missing"
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " -v"
    end

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -n auto"  // pytest-xdist 필요
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_node_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Node.js 테스트 명령어 (Jest/Vitest 자동 감지)"
  do
    // package.json에서 테스트 스크립트 감지
    let use_jest = file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/jest.config.js") ||
                   file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/jest.config.ts")
    let use_vitest = file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/vitest.config.ts") ||
                     file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/vitest.config.js")

    let runner = "npm test"

    if use_jest
      runner = "npx jest"
      if cfg.test_filter != ""
        runner = runner + " --testNamePattern='" + cfg.test_filter + "'"
      end
      if cfg.with_coverage
        runner = runner + " --coverage"
      end
    else if use_vitest
      runner = "npx vitest run"
      if cfg.test_filter != ""
        runner = runner + " -t '" + cfg.test_filter + "'"
      end
    end

    return runner + " 2>&1"
end

// ============================================================
// test_runner.fl - 테스트 실행 & 결과 검증 (Phase 2 강화)
// exec() 기반 - 외부 라이브러리 없음
// 추가: Python(pytest), 커버리지, 병렬 테스트, 상세 실패 리포트
// ============================================================

struct TestRunConfig {
  repo_path: string,     // 로컬 클론 경로
  lang: string,          // "rust" | "go" | "freelang" | "python"
  test_filter: string,   // 특정 테스트만 실행 (빈 문자열이면 전체)
  timeout_sec: i32,
  env_vars: array,       // 추가 환경 변수
  with_coverage: bool,   // 커버리지 측정 여부
  verbose: bool,         // 상세 출력
  parallel: bool         // 병렬 실행 (지원 언어만)
}

struct TestRunResult {
  passed: bool,
  exit_code: i32,
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  duration_ms: i32,
  tests_total: i32,
  tests_passed: i32,
  tests_failed: i32,
  failed_tests: array    // 실패한 테스트 이름 배열
}

// ==================== 메인 실행 ====================

fn run_tests(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 실행 및 결과 파싱"
  do
    let cmd = build_test_command(cfg)
    let start_time = now_ms()

    let output = exec_with_timeout(cmd, cfg.repo_path, cfg.timeout_sec)
    let duration = now_ms() - start_time

    match output
      Ok(out) => {
        return parse_test_output(out.stdout, out.stderr, out.exit_code, cfg.lang, duration)
      }
      Err(e) => {
        return TestRunResult {
          passed: false,
          exit_code: -1,
          stdout: "",
          stderr: "실행 실패: " + e,
          duration_ms: duration,
          tests_total: 0,
          tests_passed: 0,
          tests_failed: 0,
          failed_tests: []
        }
      }
    end
end

fn build_test_command(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "언어별 테스트 명령어 생성"
  do
    if cfg.lang == "rust"
      return build_rust_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "go"
      return build_go_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "freelang"
      return build_fl_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    // 기본: Makefile 있으면 make test
    return "make test 2>&1"
end

fn build_rust_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Rust 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "cargo test"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_go_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Go 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "go test ./..."

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -run " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    cmd = cmd + " -v 2>&1"

fn build_fl_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "fl test"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " --filter " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

// ==================== 출력 파싱 ====================

fn parse_test_output(stdout: string, stderr: string, exit_code: i32, lang: string, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 출력 파싱 (언어별)"
  do
    let combined = stdout + stderr

    if lang == "rust"
      return parse_rust_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    if lang == "go"
      return parse_go_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    if lang == "freelang"
      return parse_fl_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    // 기본: exit code만 확인
    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: stdout,
      stderr: stderr,
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: 0,
      tests_passed: 0,
      tests_failed: 0,
      failed_tests: []
    }
end

fn parse_rust_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "cargo test 출력 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out"
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // 결과 요약 줄 파싱
      if str_starts_with(line, "test result:")
        passed = parse_rust_count(line, " passed")
        failed = parse_rust_count(line, " failed")
        total = passed + failed
      end

      // 실패한 테스트 목록: "FAILED tests::test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "FAILED ")
        let test_name = str_after(line, "FAILED ")
        failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, str_trim(test_name))
      end

      // "test tests::test_name ... FAILED"
      if str_ends_with(str_trim(line), "FAILED") && str_starts_with(line, "test ")
        let test_name = str_between(line, "test ", " ...")
        if test_name != ""
          failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, test_name)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_rust_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32
  intent "Rust 요약 줄에서 특정 카운트 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; ..."
    if str_contains(line, label)
      let before_label = str_before(line, label)
      let parts = str_split_by_space(before_label)
      let last_part = arr_last_str(parts)
      return parse_int_from_str(last_part)
    end
    return 0
end

fn parse_go_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "go test -v 출력 파싱"
  do
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // "--- PASS: TestName (0.01s)"
      if str_starts_with(line, "--- PASS:")
        passed = passed + 1
        total = total + 1
      end

      // "--- FAIL: TestName (0.01s)"
      if str_starts_with(line, "--- FAIL:")
        failed = failed + 1
        total = total + 1
        let test_name = str_between(line, "--- FAIL: ", " (")
        if test_name != ""
          failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, test_name)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_fl_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 출력 파싱"
  do
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // "PASS: test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "PASS: ")
        passed = passed + 1
        total = total + 1
      end

      // "FAIL: test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "FAIL: ")
        failed = failed + 1
        total = total + 1
        let test_name = str_after(line, "FAIL: ")
        failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, str_trim(test_name))
      end

      // "Tests: 10 passed, 2 failed"
      if str_contains(line, "Tests:") && str_contains(line, "passed")
        total = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "passed") + parse_fl_summary_count(line, "failed")
        passed = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "passed")
        failed = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "failed")
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_fl_summary_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32
  intent "FreeLang 요약 줄에서 카운트 파싱"
  do
    if str_contains(line, label)
      let before = str_before(line, label)
      let trimmed = str_trim(before)
      // 마지막 공백 이후 숫자
      if str_contains(trimmed, " ")
        let last = str_after_last(trimmed, " ")
        return parse_int_from_str(last)
      end
      return parse_int_from_str(trimmed)
    end
    return 0
end

// ==================== 저장소 클론/업데이트 ====================

fn clone_repo(gogs_url: string, owner: string, repo: string, branch: string, target_path: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "저장소 클론"
  do
    let clone_url = gogs_url + "/" + owner + "/" + repo + ".git"
    let cmd = "git clone --depth=1 --branch " + branch +
              " '" + clone_url + "' '" + target_path + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("클론 실패: " + e)
    end
end

fn checkout_patch_branch(repo_path: string, branch: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "패치 브랜치 체크아웃"
  do
    let cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git checkout -b '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("체크아웃 실패: " + e)
    end
end

fn write_patched_file(repo_path: string, file_path: string, content: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "패치된 파일 로컬에 쓰기"
  do
    let full_path = repo_path + "/" + file_path
    let result = file_write(full_path, content)
    return result
end

fn commit_and_push(repo_path: string, branch: string, message: string, gogs_url: string, token: string) -> Result<string, string>
  intent "변경사항 커밋 + 원격 Push"
  do
    // 1. git add
    let add_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git add -A 2>&1"
    match exec(add_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git add 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 2. git commit
    let commit_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && " +
                     "git -c user.email='heal-agent@freelang.dev' " +
                     "-c user.name='Self-Healing Agent' " +
                     "commit -m '" + shell_escape_single(message) + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(commit_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git commit 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 3. SHA 가져오기
    let sha_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git rev-parse HEAD 2>&1"
    let sha = ""
    match exec(sha_cmd)
      Ok(s) => sha = str_trim(s)
      Err(_) => sha = "unknown"
    end

    // 4. git push
    let push_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git push origin '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(push_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git push 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    return Ok(sha)
end

// ==================== exec 헬퍼 ====================

struct ExecOutput {
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  exit_code: i32
}

fn exec_with_timeout(cmd: string, work_dir: string, timeout_sec: i32) -> Result<ExecOutput, string>
  intent "타임아웃 있는 명령 실행"
  do
    // timeout 명령으로 래핑
    let full_cmd = "cd '" + work_dir + "' && " +
                   "timeout " + int_to_str(timeout_sec) +
                   " sh -c '" + shell_escape_single(cmd) + "' 2>&1; echo \"EXIT:$?\""

    match exec(full_cmd)
      Ok(output) => {
        // "EXIT:0" 패턴으로 exit code 추출
        let exit_code = 0
        if str_contains(output, "EXIT:")
          let exit_str = str_after(output, "EXIT:")
          exit_code = parse_int_from_str(str_trim(exit_str))
        end

        let clean_output = str_before(output, "\nEXIT:")

        return Ok(ExecOutput {
          stdout: clean_output,
          stderr: "",
          exit_code: exit_code
        })
      }
      Err(e) => return Err(e)
    end
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn arr_last_str(arr: array) -> string
  intent "배열의 마지막 문자열 요소"
  do
    let total = arr_len(arr)
    if total == 0
      return ""
    end
    return arr_get(arr, total - 1)
end

fn str_split_by_space(s: string) -> array
  intent "공백으로 문자열 분할"
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t"
        if str_len(current) > 0
          result = arr_push(result, current)
          current = ""
        end
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    if str_len(current) > 0
      result = arr_push(result, current)
    end

    return result
end

fn shell_escape_single(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "'"
        result = result + "'\\''"
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

// ============================================================
// test_runner.fl - 테스트 실행 & 결과 검증 (Phase 2 강화)
// exec() 기반 - 외부 라이브러리 없음
// 추가: Python(pytest), 커버리지, 병렬 테스트, 상세 실패 리포트
// ============================================================

struct TestRunConfig {
  repo_path: string,     // 로컬 클론 경로
  lang: string,          // "rust" | "go" | "freelang" | "python"
  test_filter: string,   // 특정 테스트만 실행 (빈 문자열이면 전체)
  timeout_sec: i32,
  env_vars: array,       // 추가 환경 변수
  with_coverage: bool,   // 커버리지 측정 여부
  verbose: bool,         // 상세 출력
  parallel: bool         // 병렬 실행 (지원 언어만)
}

struct TestRunResult {
  passed: bool,
  exit_code: i32,
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  duration_ms: i32,
  tests_total: i32,
  tests_passed: i32,
  tests_failed: i32,
  failed_tests: array    // 실패한 테스트 이름 배열
}

// ==================== 메인 실행 ====================

fn run_tests(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 실행 및 결과 파싱"
  do
    let cmd = build_test_command(cfg)
    let start_time = now_ms()

    let output = exec_with_timeout(cmd, cfg.repo_path, cfg.timeout_sec)
    let duration = now_ms() - start_time

    match output
      Ok(out) => {
        return parse_test_output(out.stdout, out.stderr, out.exit_code, cfg.lang, duration)
      }
      Err(e) => {
        return TestRunResult {
          passed: false,
          exit_code: -1,
          stdout: "",
          stderr: "실행 실패: " + e,
          duration_ms: duration,
          tests_total: 0,
          tests_passed: 0,
          tests_failed: 0,
          failed_tests: []
        }
      }
    end
end

fn build_test_command(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "언어별 테스트 명령어 생성"
  do
    if cfg.lang == "rust"
      return build_rust_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "go"
      return build_go_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "freelang"
      return build_fl_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "python"
      return build_python_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "node" || cfg.lang == "javascript" || cfg.lang == "typescript"
      return build_node_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    // 기본: Makefile 있으면 make test
    return "make test 2>&1"
end

fn build_rust_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Rust 테스트 명령어 (커버리지/병렬 옵션 포함)"
  do
    if cfg.with_coverage
      // cargo llvm-cov 사용 (설치 필요)
      let cmd = "cargo llvm-cov"
      if cfg.test_filter != ""
        cmd = cmd + " --test " + cfg.test_filter
      end
      cmd = cmd + " --summary-only 2>&1"
      return cmd
    end

    let cmd = "cargo test"

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -- --test-threads=4"
    end

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " -- --nocapture"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_go_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Go 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "go test ./..."

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -run " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.with_coverage
      cmd = cmd + " -coverprofile=coverage.out"
    end

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -parallel 4"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " -v 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_fl_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "fl test"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " --filter " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " --verbose"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_python_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Python pytest 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "python3 -m pytest"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -k '" + cfg.test_filter + "'"
    end

    if cfg.with_coverage
      cmd = cmd + " --cov=. --cov-report=term-missing"
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " -v"
    end

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -n auto"  // pytest-xdist 필요
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_node_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Node.js 테스트 명령어 (Jest/Vitest 자동 감지)"
  do
    // package.json에서 테스트 스크립트 감지
    let use_jest = file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/jest.config.js") ||
                   file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/jest.config.ts")
    let use_vitest = file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/vitest.config.ts") ||
                     file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/vitest.config.js")

    let runner = "npm test"

    if use_jest
      runner = "npx jest"
      if cfg.test_filter != ""
        runner = runner + " --testNamePattern='" + cfg.test_filter + "'"
      end
      if cfg.with_coverage
        runner = runner + " --coverage"
      end
    else if use_vitest
      runner = "npx vitest run"
      if cfg.test_filter != ""
        runner = runner + " -t '" + cfg.test_filter + "'"
      end
    end

    return runner + " 2>&1"
end

// ==================== 출력 파싱 ====================

fn parse_test_output(stdout: string, stderr: string, exit_code: i32, lang: string, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 출력 파싱 (언어별)"
  do
    let combined = stdout + stderr

    if lang == "rust"
      return parse_rust_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    if lang == "go"
      return parse_go_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    if lang == "freelang"
      return parse_fl_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    // 기본: exit code만 확인
    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: stdout,
      stderr: stderr,
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: 0,
      tests_passed: 0,
      tests_failed: 0,
      failed_tests: []
    }
end

fn parse_rust_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "cargo test 출력 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out"
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // 결과 요약 줄 파싱
      if str_starts_with(line, "test result:")
        passed = parse_rust_count(line, " passed")
        failed = parse_rust_count(line, " failed")
        total = passed + failed
      end

      // 실패한 테스트 목록: "FAILED tests::test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "FAILED ")
        let test_name = str_after(line, "FAILED ")
        failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, str_trim(test_name))
      end

      // "test tests::test_name ... FAILED"
      if str_ends_with(str_trim(line), "FAILED") && str_starts_with(line, "test ")
        let test_name = str_between(line, "test ", " ...")
        if test_name != ""
          failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, test_name)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_rust_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32
  intent "Rust 요약 줄에서 특정 카운트 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; ..."
    if str_contains(line, label)
      let before_label = str_before(line, label)
      let parts = str_split_by_space(before_label)
      let last_part = arr_last_str(parts)
      return parse_int_from_str(last_part)
    end
    return 0
end

fn parse_go_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "go test -v 출력 파싱"
  do
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // "--- PASS: TestName (0.01s)"
      if str_starts_with(line, "--- PASS:")
        passed = passed + 1
        total = total + 1
      end

      // "--- FAIL: TestName (0.01s)"
      if str_starts_with(line, "--- FAIL:")
        failed = failed + 1
        total = total + 1
        let test_name = str_between(line, "--- FAIL: ", " (")
        if test_name != ""
          failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, test_name)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_fl_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 출력 파싱"
  do
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // "PASS: test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "PASS: ")
        passed = passed + 1
        total = total + 1
      end

      // "FAIL: test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "FAIL: ")
        failed = failed + 1
        total = total + 1
        let test_name = str_after(line, "FAIL: ")
        failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, str_trim(test_name))
      end

      // "Tests: 10 passed, 2 failed"
      if str_contains(line, "Tests:") && str_contains(line, "passed")
        total = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "passed") + parse_fl_summary_count(line, "failed")
        passed = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "passed")
        failed = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "failed")
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_fl_summary_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32
  intent "FreeLang 요약 줄에서 카운트 파싱"
  do
    if str_contains(line, label)
      let before = str_before(line, label)
      let trimmed = str_trim(before)
      // 마지막 공백 이후 숫자
      if str_contains(trimmed, " ")
        let last = str_after_last(trimmed, " ")
        return parse_int_from_str(last)
      end
      return parse_int_from_str(trimmed)
    end
    return 0
end

// ==================== 저장소 클론/업데이트 ====================

fn clone_repo(gogs_url: string, owner: string, repo: string, branch: string, target_path: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "저장소 클론"
  do
    let clone_url = gogs_url + "/" + owner + "/" + repo + ".git"
    let cmd = "git clone --depth=1 --branch " + branch +
              " '" + clone_url + "' '" + target_path + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("클론 실패: " + e)
    end
end

fn checkout_patch_branch(repo_path: string, branch: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "패치 브랜치 체크아웃"
  do
    let cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git checkout -b '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("체크아웃 실패: " + e)
    end
end

fn write_patched_file(repo_path: string, file_path: string, content: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "패치된 파일 로컬에 쓰기"
  do
    let full_path = repo_path + "/" + file_path
    let result = file_write(full_path, content)
    return result
end

fn commit_and_push(repo_path: string, branch: string, message: string, gogs_url: string, token: string) -> Result<string, string>
  intent "변경사항 커밋 + 원격 Push"
  do
    // 1. git add
    let add_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git add -A 2>&1"
    match exec(add_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git add 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 2. git commit
    let commit_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && " +
                     "git -c user.email='heal-agent@freelang.dev' " +
                     "-c user.name='Self-Healing Agent' " +
                     "commit -m '" + shell_escape_single(message) + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(commit_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git commit 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 3. SHA 가져오기
    let sha_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git rev-parse HEAD 2>&1"
    let sha = ""
    match exec(sha_cmd)
      Ok(s) => sha = str_trim(s)
      Err(_) => sha = "unknown"
    end

    // 4. git push
    let push_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git push origin '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(push_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git push 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    return Ok(sha)
end

// ==================== exec 헬퍼 ====================

struct ExecOutput {
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  exit_code: i32
}

fn exec_with_timeout(cmd: string, work_dir: string, timeout_sec: i32) -> Result<ExecOutput, string>
  intent "타임아웃 있는 명령 실행"
  do
    // timeout 명령으로 래핑
    let full_cmd = "cd '" + work_dir + "' && " +
                   "timeout " + int_to_str(timeout_sec) +
                   " sh -c '" + shell_escape_single(cmd) + "' 2>&1; echo \"EXIT:$?\""

    match exec(full_cmd)
      Ok(output) => {
        // "EXIT:0" 패턴으로 exit code 추출
        let exit_code = 0
        if str_contains(output, "EXIT:")
          let exit_str = str_after(output, "EXIT:")
          exit_code = parse_int_from_str(str_trim(exit_str))
        end

        let clean_output = str_before(output, "\nEXIT:")

        return Ok(ExecOutput {
          stdout: clean_output,
          stderr: "",
          exit_code: exit_code
        })
      }
      Err(e) => return Err(e)
    end
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn arr_last_str(arr: array) -> string
  intent "배열의 마지막 문자열 요소"
  do
    let total = arr_len(arr)
    if total == 0
      return ""
    end
    return arr_get(arr, total - 1)
end

fn str_split_by_space(s: string) -> array
  intent "공백으로 문자열 분할"
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t"
        if str_len(current) > 0
          result = arr_push(result, current)
          current = ""
        end
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    if str_len(current) > 0
      result = arr_push(result, current)
    end

    return result
end

fn shell_escape_single(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "'"
        result = result + "'\\''"
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

fn parse_pytest_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32
  intent "pytest 요약 줄에서 카운트 파싱"
  do
    if !str_contains(line, label)

// ============================================================
// test_runner.fl - 테스트 실행 & 결과 검증 (Phase 2 강화)
// exec() 기반 - 외부 라이브러리 없음
// 추가: Python(pytest), 커버리지, 병렬 테스트, 상세 실패 리포트
// ============================================================

struct TestRunConfig {
  repo_path: string,     // 로컬 클론 경로
  lang: string,          // "rust" | "go" | "freelang" | "python"
  test_filter: string,   // 특정 테스트만 실행 (빈 문자열이면 전체)
  timeout_sec: i32,
  env_vars: array,       // 추가 환경 변수
  with_coverage: bool,   // 커버리지 측정 여부
  verbose: bool,         // 상세 출력
  parallel: bool         // 병렬 실행 (지원 언어만)
}

struct TestRunResult {
  passed: bool,
  exit_code: i32,
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  duration_ms: i32,
  tests_total: i32,
  tests_passed: i32,
  tests_failed: i32,
  failed_tests: array    // 실패한 테스트 이름 배열
}

// ==================== 메인 실행 ====================

fn run_tests(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 실행 및 결과 파싱"
  do
    let cmd = build_test_command(cfg)
    let start_time = now_ms()

    let output = exec_with_timeout(cmd, cfg.repo_path, cfg.timeout_sec)
    let duration = now_ms() - start_time

    match output
      Ok(out) => {
        return parse_test_output(out.stdout, out.stderr, out.exit_code, cfg.lang, duration)
      }
      Err(e) => {
        return TestRunResult {
          passed: false,
          exit_code: -1,
          stdout: "",
          stderr: "실행 실패: " + e,
          duration_ms: duration,
          tests_total: 0,
          tests_passed: 0,
          tests_failed: 0,
          failed_tests: []
        }
      }
    end
end

fn build_test_command(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "언어별 테스트 명령어 생성"
  do
    if cfg.lang == "rust"
      return build_rust_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "go"
      return build_go_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "freelang"
      return build_fl_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "python"
      return build_python_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "node" || cfg.lang == "javascript" || cfg.lang == "typescript"
      return build_node_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    // 기본: Makefile 있으면 make test
    return "make test 2>&1"
end

fn build_rust_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Rust 테스트 명령어 (커버리지/병렬 옵션 포함)"
  do
    if cfg.with_coverage
      // cargo llvm-cov 사용 (설치 필요)
      let cmd = "cargo llvm-cov"
      if cfg.test_filter != ""
        cmd = cmd + " --test " + cfg.test_filter
      end
      cmd = cmd + " --summary-only 2>&1"
      return cmd
    end

    let cmd = "cargo test"

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -- --test-threads=4"
    end

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " -- --nocapture"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_go_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Go 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "go test ./..."

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -run " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.with_coverage
      cmd = cmd + " -coverprofile=coverage.out"
    end

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -parallel 4"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " -v 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_fl_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "fl test"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " --filter " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " --verbose"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_python_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Python pytest 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "python3 -m pytest"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -k '" + cfg.test_filter + "'"
    end

    if cfg.with_coverage
      cmd = cmd + " --cov=. --cov-report=term-missing"
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " -v"
    end

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -n auto"  // pytest-xdist 필요
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_node_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Node.js 테스트 명령어 (Jest/Vitest 자동 감지)"
  do
    // package.json에서 테스트 스크립트 감지
    let use_jest = file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/jest.config.js") ||
                   file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/jest.config.ts")
    let use_vitest = file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/vitest.config.ts") ||
                     file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/vitest.config.js")

    let runner = "npm test"

    if use_jest
      runner = "npx jest"
      if cfg.test_filter != ""
        runner = runner + " --testNamePattern='" + cfg.test_filter + "'"
      end
      if cfg.with_coverage
        runner = runner + " --coverage"
      end
    else if use_vitest
      runner = "npx vitest run"
      if cfg.test_filter != ""
        runner = runner + " -t '" + cfg.test_filter + "'"
      end
    end

    return runner + " 2>&1"
end

fn parse_rust_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult

fn clone_repo(gogs_url: string, owner: string, repo: string, branch: string, target_path: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "저장소 클론"
  do

fn commit_and_push(repo_path: string, branch: string, message: string, gogs_url: string, token: string) -> Result<string, string>
  intent "변경사항 커밋 + 원격 Push"
  do
    // 1. git add
    let add_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git add -A 2>&1"
    match exec(add_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git add 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 2. git commit
    let commit_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && " +
                     "git -c user.email='heal-agent@freelang.dev' " +
                     "-c user.name='Self-Healing Agent' " +
                     "commit -m '" + shell_escape_single(message) + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(commit_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git commit 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 3. SHA 가져오기
    let sha_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git rev-parse HEAD 2>&1"
    let sha = ""
    match exec(sha_cmd)
      Ok(s) => sha = str_trim(s)
      Err(_) => sha = "unknown"
    end

    // 4. git push
    let push_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git push origin '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(push_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git push 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    return Ok(sha)
end

// ==================== exec 헬퍼 ====================

struct ExecOutput {
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  exit_code: i32
}

fn exec_with_timeout(cmd: string, work_dir: string, timeout_sec: i32) -> Result<ExecOutput, string>
  intent "타임아웃 있는 명령 실행"
  do
    // timeout 명령으로 래핑
    let full_cmd = "cd '" + work_dir + "' && " +
                   "timeout " + int_to_str(timeout_sec) +
                   " sh -c '" + shell_escape_single(cmd) + "' 2>&1; echo \"EXIT:$?\""

    match exec(full_cmd)
      Ok(output) => {
        // "EXIT:0" 패턴으로 exit code 추출
        let exit_code = 0
        if str_contains(output, "EXIT:")
          let exit_str = str_after(output, "EXIT:")
          exit_code = parse_int_from_str(str_trim(exit_str))
        end

        let clean_output = str_before(output, "\nEXIT:")

        return Ok(ExecOutput {
          stdout: clean_output,
          stderr: "",
          exit_code: exit_code
        })
      }
      Err(e) => return Err(e)
    end
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn arr_last_str(arr: array) -> string
  intent "배열의 마지막 문자열 요소"
  do
    let total = arr_len(arr)
    if total == 0
      return ""
    end
    return arr_get(arr, total - 1)
end

fn str_split_by_space(s: string) -> array
  intent "공백으로 문자열 분할"
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t"
        if str_len(current) > 0
          result = arr_push(result, current)
          current = ""
        end
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    if str_len(current) > 0
      result = arr_push(result, current)
    end

    return result
end

fn shell_escape_single(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "'"
        result = result + "'\\''"
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end
