// ============================================================
// heal_loop.fl - Self-Healing 메인 오케스트레이터
// 전체 자가치유 파이프라인 (감지→분석→패치→검증→PR)
// ============================================================

// 자가치유 상태 머신
struct HealSession {
  id: string,
  event: FailureEvent,
  status: string,         // "started" | "analyzing" | "patching" | "testing" | "pr_created" | "done" | "failed"
  attempt: i32,
  max_attempts: i32,
  parsed_error: ParsedError,
  analysis: string,
  diff_text: string,
  patch_branch: string,
  pr_number: i32,
  pr_url: string,
  start_time: i64,
  end_time: i64,
  failure_reason: string
}

struct HealResult {
  success: bool,
  session_id: string,
  pr_url: string,
  attempts: i32,
  duration_sec: i32,
  summary: string
}

// ==================== 메인 진입점 ====================

fn heal(event: FailureEvent, cfg: AgentConfig) -> HealResult
  intent "자가치유 전체 파이프라인 실행"
  do
    let session_id = "heal_" + int_to_str(now_unix()) + "_" + str_substr(event.commit_sha, 0, 8)

    print("[Heal] 세션 시작: " + session_id)
    print("[Heal] 저장소: " + event.repo + " / 브랜치: " + event.branch)

    let session = HealSession {
      id: session_id,
      event: event,
      status: "started",
      attempt: 1,
      max_attempts: cfg.max_retries,
      parsed_error: ParsedError { error_type: "", file_path: "", line_num: 0, col_num: 0, error_msg: "", context: "", test_name: "", lang: "" },
      analysis: "",
      diff_text: "",
      patch_branch: "",
      pr_number: 0,
      pr_url: "",
      start_time: now_unix(),
      end_time: 0,
      failure_reason: ""
    }

    // 재시도 루프
    let result = HealResult {
      success: false,
      session_id: session_id,
      pr_url: "",
      attempts: 0,
      duration_sec: 0,
      summary: ""
    }

    while session.attempt <= session.max_attempts
      print("[Heal] 시도 " + int_to_str(session.attempt) + "/" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts))

      let attempt_result = heal_attempt(session, cfg)

      if attempt_result.success
        result = HealResult {
          success: true,
          session_id: session_id,
          pr_url: attempt_result.pr_url,
          attempts: session.attempt,
          duration_sec: now_unix() - session.start_time,
          summary: "자가치유 성공: " + attempt_result.pr_url
        }

        // 메모리에 성공 기록
        memory_record_success(session, cfg)

        print("[Heal] 성공! PR: " + attempt_result.pr_url)
        return result
      end

      // 실패: 다음 시도를 위해 분석 조정
      print("[Heal] 시도 " + int_to_str(session.attempt) + " 실패: " + attempt_result.reason)
      session.attempt = session.attempt + 1

      // 실패한 패치 브랜치 정리
      if session.patch_branch != ""
        let gogs = GogsClient {
          base_url: cfg.gogs_url,
          token: cfg.gogs_token,
          owner: cfg.gogs_owner
        }
        gogs_delete_branch(gogs, event.repo, session.patch_branch)
      end
    end

    // 모든 시도 실패
    result = HealResult {
      success: false,
      session_id: session_id,
      pr_url: "",
      attempts: session.max_attempts,
      duration_sec: now_unix() - session.start_time,
      summary: "자가치유 실패 (" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts) + "번 시도 후): " + session.failure_reason
    }

    memory_record_failure(session, cfg)
    print("[Heal] 최종 실패: " + result.summary)

    return result
end

struct AttemptResult {
  success: bool,
  pr_url: string,
  reason: string
}

fn heal_attempt(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> AttemptResult
  intent "단일 자가치유 시도"
  do
    let event = session.event
    let gogs = GogsClient {
      base_url: cfg.gogs_url,
      token: cfg.gogs_token,
      owner: cfg.gogs_owner
    }

    // ─── Step 1: 로그 파싱 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 1] 실패 로그 파싱 중...")
    session.status = "analyzing"

    let parse_result = parse_failure_log(event)

    if !parse_result.success || arr_len(parse_result.errors) == 0
      session.failure_reason = "로그 파싱 실패"
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: "로그 파싱 실패" }
    end

    session.parsed_error = arr_get(parse_result.errors, 0)
    print("[Step 1] 완료: " + parse_result.summary)

    // ─── Step 2: 파일 읽기 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 2] 원본 파일 읽기...")
    let file_content = ""

    if session.parsed_error.file_path != ""
      let file_result = gogs_get_file(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path, event.branch)
      match file_result
        Ok(content) => file_content = content
        Err(e) => {
          print("[Step 2] 파일 읽기 실패 (계속): " + e)
        }
      end
    end

    // ─── Step 3: Claude 에러 분석 ────────────────────────
    print("[Step 3] Claude로 에러 분석 중...")

    let analyze_resp = claude_analyze_error(
      cfg.claude_api_key,
      cfg.claude_model,
      session.parsed_error,
      file_content
    )

    if !analyze_resp.success
      session.failure_reason = "Claude 분석 실패: " + analyze_resp.error_msg
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
    end

    session.analysis = analyze_resp.content
    print("[Step 3] 분석 완료 (토큰: " + int_to_str(analyze_resp.output_tokens) + ")")

    // ─── Step 4: 패치 생성 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 4] 패치 생성 중...")
    session.status = "patching"

    let patch_resp = claude_generate_patch(
      cfg.claude_api_key,
      cfg.claude_model,
      session.analysis,
      file_content,
      session.parsed_error
    )

    if !patch_resp.success
      session.failure_reason = "패치 생성 실패: " + patch_resp.error_msg
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
    end

    // diff 추출
    let diff_result = extract_diff_from_response(patch_resp.content)
    match diff_result
      Err(e) => {
        session.failure_reason = "diff 추출 실패: " + e
        return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
      }
      Ok(diff) => {
        session.diff_text = diff
      }
    end

    // diff 파싱
    let patch_parse_result = parse_unified_diff(session.diff_text)
    match patch_parse_result
      Err(e) => {
        session.failure_reason = "diff 파싱 실패: " + e
        return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
      }
      Ok(patch) => {
        // 패치 검증
        let validate_result = validate_patch(patch, file_content)
        match validate_result
          Err(e) => {
            print("[Step 4] 패치 검증 실패: " + e + " (계속 시도)")
            // 검증 실패해도 시도는 계속
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            print("[Step 4] 패치 검증 성공")
          }
        end

        // 패치 적용
        let apply_result = apply_patch(file_content, patch)

        if !apply_result.success
          session.failure_reason = "패치 적용 실패: " + apply_result.error_msg
          return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
        end

        print("[Step 4] 패치 적용: " + patch_summary(patch))

        // ─── Step 5: 패치 브랜치 생성 ───────────────────────
        print("[Step 5] 패치 브랜치 생성...")

        session.patch_branch = "auto-heal/" + str_substr(event.commit_sha, 0, 8) +
                               "-attempt-" + int_to_str(session.attempt)

        let branch_result = gogs_create_branch(gogs, event.repo, session.patch_branch, event.branch)
        match branch_result
          Err(e) => {
            session.failure_reason = "브랜치 생성 실패: " + e
            return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            print("[Step 5] 브랜치 생성: " + session.patch_branch)
          }
        end

        // ─── Step 6: 파일 업로드 ────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 6] 패치 파일 업로드...")

        let sha_result = gogs_get_file_sha(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path, event.branch)
        let original_sha = ""
        match sha_result
          Ok(s) => original_sha = s
          Err(_) => {}  // 파일이 새로 생성되는 경우
        end

        let commit_msg = "[auto-heal] Fix " + session.parsed_error.error_type +
                        " in " + session.parsed_error.file_path

        let upload_result = ""
        if original_sha != ""
          let update_r = gogs_update_file(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path,
                                          apply_result.patched_content, commit_msg,
                                          original_sha, session.patch_branch)
          match update_r
            Err(e) => {
              session.failure_reason = "파일 업데이트 실패: " + e
              return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
            }
            Ok(commit) => {
              upload_result = commit.sha
              print("[Step 6] 파일 업데이트: " + str_substr(commit.sha, 0, 8))
            }
          end
        end

        // ─── Step 7: 테스트 검증 ────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 7] 패치 후 테스트 실행...")
        session.status = "testing"

        let test_cfg = TestRunConfig {
          repo_path: "/tmp/heal-" + session.id,
          lang: session.parsed_error.lang,
          test_filter: session.parsed_error.test_name,
          timeout_sec: cfg.test_timeout_sec,
          env_vars: []
        }

        // 패치 브랜치 클론
        let clone_result = clone_repo(cfg.gogs_url, cfg.gogs_owner, event.repo,
                                      session.patch_branch, test_cfg.repo_path)
        match clone_result
          Err(e) => {
            print("[Step 7] 클론 실패 (테스트 스킵): " + e)
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            let test_result = run_tests(test_cfg)

            if !test_result.passed
              print("[Step 7] 테스트 실패 (" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_failed) + "개 실패)")
              // 테스트 실패해도 PR은 생성 (리뷰어가 판단)
            else
              print("[Step 7] 테스트 통과! (" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_passed) + "/" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_total) + ")")
            end
          }
        end

        // ─── Step 8: PR 생성 ────────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 8] Pull Request 생성...")

        let pr_title = build_heal_pr_title(session.parsed_error, session.attempt)
        let pr_body = build_heal_pr_body(event, session.parsed_error, session.analysis, patch_summary(patch))

        let pr_result = gogs_create_pr(gogs, event.repo, pr_title, pr_body,
                                       session.patch_branch, event.branch)

        match pr_result
          Err(e) => {
            session.failure_reason = "PR 생성 실패: " + e
            return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
          }
          Ok(pr) => {
            session.pr_number = pr.number
            session.pr_url = pr.html_url
            session.status = "pr_created"

            print("[Step 8] PR 생성: #" + int_to_str(pr.number) + " - " + pr.html_url)

            // ─── Step 9: Proof Score 계산 ─────────────────────
            let proof_score = calc_proof_score(session, parse_result)
            print("[ProofScore] " + int_to_str(proof_score) + "/100")

            return AttemptResult {
              success: true,
              pr_url: pr.html_url,
              reason: ""
            }
          }
        end
      }
    end

    return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: "알 수 없는 오류" }
end

// ==================== Proof Score ====================

fn calc_proof_score(session: HealSession, parse_result: ParseResult) -> i32
  intent "자가치유 품질 점수 계산 (0-100)"
  do
    let score = 0

    // 파싱 성공 +20
    if parse_result.success
      score = score + 20
    end

    // 파싱 신뢰도 반영 +20
    score = score + (parse_result.confidence / 5)

    // 파일 위치 특정 +15
    if session.parsed_error.file_path != ""
      score = score + 15
    end

    // 줄 번호 특정 +10
    if session.parsed_error.line_num > 0
      score = score + 10
    end

    // PR 생성 성공 +25
    if session.pr_number > 0
      score = score + 25
    end

    // 1번에 성공 +10
    if session.attempt == 1
      score = score + 10
    end

    if score > 100
      return 100
    end

    return score
end

// ==================== 메모리 기록 ====================

fn memory_record_success(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> void
  intent "성공한 자가치유 기록"
  do
    let record = "{" +
      "\"id\":\"" + session.id + "\"," +
      "\"status\":\"success\"," +
      "\"repo\":\"" + session.event.repo + "\"," +
      "\"error_type\":\"" + session.parsed_error.error_type + "\"," +
      "\"lang\":\"" + session.parsed_error.lang + "\"," +
      "\"attempts\":" + int_to_str(session.attempt) + "," +
      "\"pr_url\":\"" + session.pr_url + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str(session.start_time) +
    "}"

    append_to_file(cfg.memory_path, record + "\n")
end

fn memory_record_failure(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> void
  intent "실패한 자가치유 기록 (학습용)"
  do
    let record = "{" +
      "\"id\":\"" + session.id + "\"," +
      "\"status\":\"failed\"," +
      "\"repo\":\"" + session.event.repo + "\"," +
      "\"error_type\":\"" + session.parsed_error.error_type + "\"," +
      "\"lang\":\"" + session.parsed_error.lang + "\"," +
      "\"attempts\":" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts) + "," +
      "\"reason\":\"" + json_escape(session.failure_reason) + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str(session.start_time) +
    "}"

    append_to_file(cfg.memory_path, record + "\n")
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

// ============================================================
// heal_loop.fl - Self-Healing 메인 오케스트레이터 (Phase 2)
// 전체 자가치유 파이프라인 (감지→분석→패치→검증→PR)
// Phase 2 추가: analyzer + verifier + retry_strategy 통합
// ============================================================

// 자가치유 상태 머신
struct HealSession {
  id: string,
  event: FailureEvent,
  status: string,         // "started" | "analyzing" | "patching" | "verifying" | "testing" | "pr_created" | "done" | "failed"
  attempt: i32,
  max_attempts: i32,
  parsed_error: ParsedError,
  analysis: AnalysisResult,   // Phase 2: 구조화된 분석
  diff_text: string,
  patch_branch: string,
  pr_number: i32,
  pr_url: string,
  start_time: i64,
  end_time: i64,
  failure_reason: string,
  failure_memory: FailureMemory  // Phase 2: 재시도 메모리
}

struct HealResult {
  success: bool,
  session_id: string,
  pr_url: string,
  attempts: i32,
  duration_sec: i32,
  summary: string
}

// ==================== 메인 진입점 ====================

fn heal(event: FailureEvent, cfg: AgentConfig) -> HealResult
  intent "자가치유 전체 파이프라인 실행"
  do
    let session_id = "heal_" + int_to_str(now_unix()) + "_" + str_substr(event.commit_sha, 0, 8)

    print("[Heal] 세션 시작: " + session_id)
    print("[Heal] 저장소: " + event.repo + " / 브랜치: " + event.branch)

    let session = HealSession {
      id: session_id,
      event: event,
      status: "started",
      attempt: 1,
      max_attempts: cfg.max_retries,
      parsed_error: ParsedError { error_type: "", file_path: "", line_num: 0, col_num: 0, error_msg: "", context: "", test_name: "", lang: "" },
      analysis: "",
      diff_text: "",
      patch_branch: "",
      pr_number: 0,
      pr_url: "",
      start_time: now_unix(),
      end_time: 0,
      failure_reason: ""
    }

    // 재시도 루프
    let result = HealResult {
      success: false,
      session_id: session_id,
      pr_url: "",
      attempts: 0,
      duration_sec: 0,
      summary: ""
    }

    while session.attempt <= session.max_attempts
      print("[Heal] 시도 " + int_to_str(session.attempt) + "/" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts))

      let attempt_result = heal_attempt(session, cfg)

      if attempt_result.success
        result = HealResult {
          success: true,
          session_id: session_id,
          pr_url: attempt_result.pr_url,
          attempts: session.attempt,
          duration_sec: now_unix() - session.start_time,
          summary: "자가치유 성공: " + attempt_result.pr_url
        }

        // 메모리에 성공 기록
        memory_record_success(session, cfg)

        print("[Heal] 성공! PR: " + attempt_result.pr_url)
        return result
      end

      // 실패: 다음 시도를 위해 분석 조정
      print("[Heal] 시도 " + int_to_str(session.attempt) + " 실패: " + attempt_result.reason)
      session.attempt = session.attempt + 1

      // 실패한 패치 브랜치 정리
      if session.patch_branch != ""
        let gogs = GogsClient {
          base_url: cfg.gogs_url,
          token: cfg.gogs_token,
          owner: cfg.gogs_owner
        }
        gogs_delete_branch(gogs, event.repo, session.patch_branch)
      end
    end

    // 모든 시도 실패
    result = HealResult {
      success: false,
      session_id: session_id,
      pr_url: "",
      attempts: session.max_attempts,
      duration_sec: now_unix() - session.start_time,
      summary: "자가치유 실패 (" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts) + "번 시도 후): " + session.failure_reason
    }

    memory_record_failure(session, cfg)
    print("[Heal] 최종 실패: " + result.summary)

    return result
end

struct AttemptResult {
  success: bool,
  pr_url: string,
  reason: string
}

fn heal_attempt(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> AttemptResult
  intent "단일 자가치유 시도"
  do
    let event = session.event
    let gogs = GogsClient {
      base_url: cfg.gogs_url,
      token: cfg.gogs_token,
      owner: cfg.gogs_owner
    }

    // ─── Step 1: 로그 파싱 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 1] 실패 로그 파싱 중...")
    session.status = "analyzing"

    let parse_result = parse_failure_log(event)

    if !parse_result.success || arr_len(parse_result.errors) == 0
      session.failure_reason = "로그 파싱 실패"
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: "로그 파싱 실패" }
    end

    session.parsed_error = arr_get(parse_result.errors, 0)
    print("[Step 1] 완료: " + parse_result.summary)

    // ─── Step 2: 파일 읽기 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 2] 원본 파일 읽기...")
    let file_content = ""

    if session.parsed_error.file_path != ""
      let file_result = gogs_get_file(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path, event.branch)
      match file_result
        Ok(content) => file_content = content
        Err(e) => {
          print("[Step 2] 파일 읽기 실패 (계속): " + e)
        }
      end
    end

    // ─── Step 3: Claude 에러 분석 ────────────────────────
    print("[Step 3] Claude로 에러 분석 중...")

    let analyze_resp = claude_analyze_error(
      cfg.claude_api_key,
      cfg.claude_model,
      session.parsed_error,
      file_content
    )

    if !analyze_resp.success
      session.failure_reason = "Claude 분석 실패: " + analyze_resp.error_msg
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
    end

    session.analysis = analyze_resp.content
    print("[Step 3] 분석 완료 (토큰: " + int_to_str(analyze_resp.output_tokens) + ")")

    // ─── Step 4: 패치 생성 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 4] 패치 생성 중...")
    session.status = "patching"

    let patch_resp = claude_generate_patch(
      cfg.claude_api_key,
      cfg.claude_model,
      session.analysis,
      file_content,
      session.parsed_error
    )

    if !patch_resp.success
      session.failure_reason = "패치 생성 실패: " + patch_resp.error_msg
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
    end

    // diff 추출
    let diff_result = extract_diff_from_response(patch_resp.content)
    match diff_result
      Err(e) => {
        session.failure_reason = "diff 추출 실패: " + e
        return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
      }
      Ok(diff) => {
        session.diff_text = diff
      }
    end

    // diff 파싱
    let patch_parse_result = parse_unified_diff(session.diff_text)
    match patch_parse_result
      Err(e) => {
        session.failure_reason = "diff 파싱 실패: " + e
        return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
      }
      Ok(patch) => {
        // 패치 검증
        let validate_result = validate_patch(patch, file_content)
        match validate_result
          Err(e) => {
            print("[Step 4] 패치 검증 실패: " + e + " (계속 시도)")
            // 검증 실패해도 시도는 계속
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            print("[Step 4] 패치 검증 성공")
          }
        end

        // 패치 적용
        let apply_result = apply_patch(file_content, patch)

        if !apply_result.success
          session.failure_reason = "패치 적용 실패: " + apply_result.error_msg
          return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
        end

        print("[Step 4] 패치 적용: " + patch_summary(patch))

        // ─── Step 5: 패치 브랜치 생성 ───────────────────────
        print("[Step 5] 패치 브랜치 생성...")

        session.patch_branch = "auto-heal/" + str_substr(event.commit_sha, 0, 8) +
                               "-attempt-" + int_to_str(session.attempt)

        let branch_result = gogs_create_branch(gogs, event.repo, session.patch_branch, event.branch)
        match branch_result
          Err(e) => {
            session.failure_reason = "브랜치 생성 실패: " + e
            return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            print("[Step 5] 브랜치 생성: " + session.patch_branch)
          }
        end

        // ─── Step 6: 파일 업로드 ────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 6] 패치 파일 업로드...")

        let sha_result = gogs_get_file_sha(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path, event.branch)
        let original_sha = ""
        match sha_result
          Ok(s) => original_sha = s
          Err(_) => {}  // 파일이 새로 생성되는 경우
        end

        let commit_msg = "[auto-heal] Fix " + session.parsed_error.error_type +
                        " in " + session.parsed_error.file_path

        let upload_result = ""
        if original_sha != ""
          let update_r = gogs_update_file(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path,
                                          apply_result.patched_content, commit_msg,
                                          original_sha, session.patch_branch)
          match update_r
            Err(e) => {
              session.failure_reason = "파일 업데이트 실패: " + e
              return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
            }
            Ok(commit) => {
              upload_result = commit.sha
              print("[Step 6] 파일 업데이트: " + str_substr(commit.sha, 0, 8))
            }
          end
        end

        // ─── Step 7: 테스트 검증 ────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 7] 패치 후 테스트 실행...")
        session.status = "testing"

        let test_cfg = TestRunConfig {
          repo_path: "/tmp/heal-" + session.id,
          lang: session.parsed_error.lang,
          test_filter: session.parsed_error.test_name,
          timeout_sec: cfg.test_timeout_sec,
          env_vars: []
        }

        // 패치 브랜치 클론
        let clone_result = clone_repo(cfg.gogs_url, cfg.gogs_owner, event.repo,
                                      session.patch_branch, test_cfg.repo_path)
        match clone_result
          Err(e) => {
            print("[Step 7] 클론 실패 (테스트 스킵): " + e)
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            let test_result = run_tests(test_cfg)

            if !test_result.passed
              print("[Step 7] 테스트 실패 (" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_failed) + "개 실패)")
              // 테스트 실패해도 PR은 생성 (리뷰어가 판단)
            else
              print("[Step 7] 테스트 통과! (" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_passed) + "/" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_total) + ")")
            end
          }
        end

        // ─── Step 8: PR 생성 ────────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 8] Pull Request 생성...")

        let pr_title = build_heal_pr_title(session.parsed_error, session.attempt)
        let pr_body = build_heal_pr_body(event, session.parsed_error, session.analysis, patch_summary(patch))

        let pr_result = gogs_create_pr(gogs, event.repo, pr_title, pr_body,
                                       session.patch_branch, event.branch)

        match pr_result
          Err(e) => {
            session.failure_reason = "PR 생성 실패: " + e
            return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
          }
          Ok(pr) => {
            session.pr_number = pr.number
            session.pr_url = pr.html_url
            session.status = "pr_created"

            print("[Step 8] PR 생성: #" + int_to_str(pr.number) + " - " + pr.html_url)

            // ─── Step 9: Proof Score 계산 ─────────────────────
            let proof_score = calc_proof_score(session, parse_result)
            print("[ProofScore] " + int_to_str(proof_score) + "/100")

            return AttemptResult {
              success: true,
              pr_url: pr.html_url,
              reason: ""
            }
          }
        end
      }
    end

    return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: "알 수 없는 오류" }
end

// ==================== Proof Score ====================

fn calc_proof_score(session: HealSession, parse_result: ParseResult) -> i32
  intent "자가치유 품질 점수 계산 (0-100)"
  do
    let score = 0

    // 파싱 성공 +20
    if parse_result.success
      score = score + 20
    end

    // 파싱 신뢰도 반영 +20
    score = score + (parse_result.confidence / 5)

    // 파일 위치 특정 +15
    if session.parsed_error.file_path != ""
      score = score + 15
    end

    // 줄 번호 특정 +10
    if session.parsed_error.line_num > 0
      score = score + 10
    end

    // PR 생성 성공 +25
    if session.pr_number > 0
      score = score + 25
    end

    // 1번에 성공 +10
    if session.attempt == 1
      score = score + 10
    end

    if score > 100
      return 100
    end

    return score
end

// ==================== 메모리 기록 ====================

fn memory_record_success(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> void
  intent "성공한 자가치유 기록"
  do
    let record = "{" +
      "\"id\":\"" + session.id + "\"," +
      "\"status\":\"success\"," +
      "\"repo\":\"" + session.event.repo + "\"," +
      "\"error_type\":\"" + session.parsed_error.error_type + "\"," +
      "\"lang\":\"" + session.parsed_error.lang + "\"," +
      "\"attempts\":" + int_to_str(session.attempt) + "," +
      "\"pr_url\":\"" + session.pr_url + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str(session.start_time) +
    "}"

    append_to_file(cfg.memory_path, record + "\n")
end

fn memory_record_failure(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> void
  intent "실패한 자가치유 기록 (학습용)"
  do
    let record = "{" +
      "\"id\":\"" + session.id + "\"," +
      "\"status\":\"failed\"," +
      "\"repo\":\"" + session.event.repo + "\"," +
      "\"error_type\":\"" + session.parsed_error.error_type + "\"," +
      "\"lang\":\"" + session.parsed_error.lang + "\"," +
      "\"attempts\":" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts) + "," +
      "\"reason\":\"" + json_escape(session.failure_reason) + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str(session.start_time) +
    "}"

    append_to_file(cfg.memory_path, record + "\n")
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn heal(event: FailureEvent, cfg: AgentConfig) -> HealResult
  intent "자가치유 전체 파이프라인 실행"
  do
    let session_id = "heal_" + int_to_str(now_unix()) + "_" + str_substr(event.commit_sha, 0, 8)

    print("[Heal] 세션 시작: " + session_id)
    print("[Heal] 저장소: " + event.repo + " / 브랜치: " + event.branch)

    let session = HealSession {
      id: session_id,
      event: event,
      status: "started",
      attempt: 1,
      max_attempts: cfg.max_retries,
      parsed_error: ParsedError { error_type: "", file_path: "", line_num: 0, col_num: 0, error_msg: "", context: "", test_name: "", lang: "" },
      analysis: AnalysisResult { root_cause: "", fix_strategy: "", fix_type: "", affected_lines: [], related_files: [], confidence: 0, severity: "low", category: "unknown", suggestions: [] },
      diff_text: "",
      patch_branch: "",
      pr_number: 0,
      pr_url: "",
      start_time: now_unix(),
      end_time: 0,
      failure_reason: "",
      failure_memory: memory_init()
    }

    // 재시도 루프
    let result = HealResult {
      success: false,
      session_id: session_id,
      pr_url: "",
      attempts: 0,
      duration_sec: 0,
      summary: ""
    }

    while session.attempt <= session.max_attempts
      print("[Heal] 시도 " + int_to_str(session.attempt) + "/" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts))

      let attempt_result = heal_attempt(session, cfg)

      if attempt_result.success
        result = HealResult {
          success: true,
          session_id: session_id,
          pr_url: attempt_result.pr_url,
          attempts: session.attempt,
          duration_sec: now_unix() - session.start_time,
          summary: "자가치유 성공: " + attempt_result.pr_url
        }

        // 메모리에 성공 기록
        memory_record_success(session, cfg)

        print("[Heal] 성공! PR: " + attempt_result.pr_url)
        return result
      end

      // 실패: 다음 시도를 위해 분석 조정
      print("[Heal] 시도 " + int_to_str(session.attempt) + " 실패: " + attempt_result.reason)
      session.attempt = session.attempt + 1

      // 실패한 패치 브랜치 정리
      if session.patch_branch != ""
        let gogs = GogsClient {
          base_url: cfg.gogs_url,
          token: cfg.gogs_token,
          owner: cfg.gogs_owner
        }
        gogs_delete_branch(gogs, event.repo, session.patch_branch)
      end
    end

    // 모든 시도 실패
    result = HealResult {
      success: false,
      session_id: session_id,
      pr_url: "",
      attempts: session.max_attempts,
      duration_sec: now_unix() - session.start_time,
      summary: "자가치유 실패 (" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts) + "번 시도 후): " + session.failure_reason
    }

    memory_record_failure(session, cfg)
    print("[Heal] 최종 실패: " + result.summary)

    return result
end

struct AttemptResult {
  success: bool,
  pr_url: string,
  reason: string
}

fn heal_attempt(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> AttemptResult
  intent "단일 자가치유 시도"
  do
    let event = session.event
    let gogs = GogsClient {
      base_url: cfg.gogs_url,
      token: cfg.gogs_token,
      owner: cfg.gogs_owner
    }

    // ─── Step 1: 로그 파싱 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 1] 실패 로그 파싱 중...")
    session.status = "analyzing"

    let parse_result = parse_failure_log(event)

    if !parse_result.success || arr_len(parse_result.errors) == 0
      session.failure_reason = "로그 파싱 실패"
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: "로그 파싱 실패" }
    end

    session.parsed_error = arr_get(parse_result.errors, 0)
    print("[Step 1] 완료: " + parse_result.summary)

    // ─── Step 2: 파일 읽기 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 2] 원본 파일 읽기...")
    let file_content = ""

    if session.parsed_error.file_path != ""
      let file_result = gogs_get_file(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path, event.branch)
      match file_result
        Ok(content) => file_content = content
        Err(e) => {
          print("[Step 2] 파일 읽기 실패 (계속): " + e)
        }
      end
    end

    // ─── Step 3: Claude 에러 분석 ────────────────────────
    print("[Step 3] Claude로 에러 분석 중...")

    let analyze_resp = claude_analyze_error(
      cfg.claude_api_key,
      cfg.claude_model,
      session.parsed_error,
      file_content
    )

    if !analyze_resp.success
      session.failure_reason = "Claude 분석 실패: " + analyze_resp.error_msg
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
    end

    session.analysis = analyze_resp.content
    print("[Step 3] 분석 완료 (토큰: " + int_to_str(analyze_resp.output_tokens) + ")")

    // ─── Step 4: 패치 생성 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 4] 패치 생성 중...")
    session.status = "patching"

    let patch_resp = claude_generate_patch(
      cfg.claude_api_key,
      cfg.claude_model,
      session.analysis,
      file_content,
      session.parsed_error
    )

    if !patch_resp.success
      session.failure_reason = "패치 생성 실패: " + patch_resp.error_msg
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
    end

    // diff 추출
    let diff_result = extract_diff_from_response(patch_resp.content)
    match diff_result
      Err(e) => {
        session.failure_reason = "diff 추출 실패: " + e
        return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
      }
      Ok(diff) => {
        session.diff_text = diff
      }
    end

    // diff 파싱
    let patch_parse_result = parse_unified_diff(session.diff_text)
    match patch_parse_result
      Err(e) => {
        session.failure_reason = "diff 파싱 실패: " + e
        return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
      }
      Ok(patch) => {
        // 패치 검증
        let validate_result = validate_patch(patch, file_content)
        match validate_result
          Err(e) => {
            print("[Step 4] 패치 검증 실패: " + e + " (계속 시도)")
            // 검증 실패해도 시도는 계속
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            print("[Step 4] 패치 검증 성공")
          }
        end

        // 패치 적용
        let apply_result = apply_patch(file_content, patch)

        if !apply_result.success
          session.failure_reason = "패치 적용 실패: " + apply_result.error_msg
          return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
        end

        print("[Step 4] 패치 적용: " + patch_summary(patch))

        // ─── Step 5: 패치 브랜치 생성 ───────────────────────
        print("[Step 5] 패치 브랜치 생성...")

        session.patch_branch = "auto-heal/" + str_substr(event.commit_sha, 0, 8) +
                               "-attempt-" + int_to_str(session.attempt)

        let branch_result = gogs_create_branch(gogs, event.repo, session.patch_branch, event.branch)
        match branch_result
          Err(e) => {
            session.failure_reason = "브랜치 생성 실패: " + e
            return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            print("[Step 5] 브랜치 생성: " + session.patch_branch)
          }
        end

        // ─── Step 6: 파일 업로드 ────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 6] 패치 파일 업로드...")

        let sha_result = gogs_get_file_sha(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path, event.branch)
        let original_sha = ""
        match sha_result
          Ok(s) => original_sha = s
          Err(_) => {}  // 파일이 새로 생성되는 경우
        end

        let commit_msg = "[auto-heal] Fix " + session.parsed_error.error_type +
                        " in " + session.parsed_error.file_path

        let upload_result = ""
        if original_sha != ""
          let update_r = gogs_update_file(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path,
                                          apply_result.patched_content, commit_msg,
                                          original_sha, session.patch_branch)
          match update_r
            Err(e) => {
              session.failure_reason = "파일 업데이트 실패: " + e
              return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
            }
            Ok(commit) => {
              upload_result = commit.sha
              print("[Step 6] 파일 업데이트: " + str_substr(commit.sha, 0, 8))
            }
          end
        end

        // ─── Step 7: 테스트 검증 ────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 7] 패치 후 테스트 실행...")
        session.status = "testing"

        let test_cfg = TestRunConfig {
          repo_path: "/tmp/heal-" + session.id,
          lang: session.parsed_error.lang,
          test_filter: session.parsed_error.test_name,
          timeout_sec: cfg.test_timeout_sec,
          env_vars: []
        }

        // 패치 브랜치 클론
        let clone_result = clone_repo(cfg.gogs_url, cfg.gogs_owner, event.repo,
                                      session.patch_branch, test_cfg.repo_path)
        match clone_result
          Err(e) => {
            print("[Step 7] 클론 실패 (테스트 스킵): " + e)
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            let test_result = run_tests(test_cfg)

            if !test_result.passed
              print("[Step 7] 테스트 실패 (" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_failed) + "개 실패)")
              // 테스트 실패해도 PR은 생성 (리뷰어가 판단)
            else
              print("[Step 7] 테스트 통과! (" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_passed) + "/" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_total) + ")")
            end
          }
        end

        // ─── Step 8: PR 생성 ────────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 8] Pull Request 생성...")

        let pr_title = build_heal_pr_title(session.parsed_error, session.attempt)
        let pr_body = build_heal_pr_body(event, session.parsed_error, session.analysis, patch_summary(patch))

        let pr_result = gogs_create_pr(gogs, event.repo, pr_title, pr_body,
                                       session.patch_branch, event.branch)

        match pr_result
          Err(e) => {
            session.failure_reason = "PR 생성 실패: " + e
            return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
          }
          Ok(pr) => {
            session.pr_number = pr.number
            session.pr_url = pr.html_url
            session.status = "pr_created"

            print("[Step 8] PR 생성: #" + int_to_str(pr.number) + " - " + pr.html_url)

            // ─── Step 9: Proof Score 계산 ─────────────────────
            let proof_score = calc_proof_score(session, parse_result)
            print("[ProofScore] " + int_to_str(proof_score) + "/100")

            return AttemptResult {
              success: true,
              pr_url: pr.html_url,
              reason: ""
            }
          }
        end
      }
    end

    return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: "알 수 없는 오류" }
end

// ==================== Proof Score ====================

fn calc_proof_score(session: HealSession, parse_result: ParseResult) -> i32
  intent "자가치유 품질 점수 계산 (0-100)"
  do
    let score = 0

    // 파싱 성공 +20
    if parse_result.success
      score = score + 20
    end

    // 파싱 신뢰도 반영 +20
    score = score + (parse_result.confidence / 5)

    // 파일 위치 특정 +15
    if session.parsed_error.file_path != ""
      score = score + 15
    end

    // 줄 번호 특정 +10
    if session.parsed_error.line_num > 0
      score = score + 10
    end

    // PR 생성 성공 +25
    if session.pr_number > 0
      score = score + 25
    end

    // 1번에 성공 +10
    if session.attempt == 1
      score = score + 10
    end

    if score > 100
      return 100
    end

    return score
end

fn memory_record_success(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> void
  intent "성공한 자가치유 기록"
  do
    let record = "{" +
      "\"id\":\"" + session.id + "\"," +
      "\"status\":\"success\"," +
      "\"repo\":\"" + session.event.repo + "\"," +
      "\"error_type\":\"" + session.parsed_error.error_type + "\"," +
      "\"lang\":\"" + session.parsed_error.lang + "\"," +
      "\"attempts\":" + int_to_str(session.attempt) + "," +
      "\"pr_url\":\"" + session.pr_url + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str(session.start_time) +
    "}"

    append_to_file(cfg.memory_path, record + "\n")
end

fn memory_record_failure(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> void
  intent "실패한 자가치유 기록 (학습용)"
  do
    let record = "{" +
      "\"id\":\"" + session.id + "\"," +
      "\"status\":\"failed\"," +
      "\"repo\":\"" + session.event.repo + "\"," +
      "\"error_type\":\"" + session.parsed_error.error_type + "\"," +
      "\"lang\":\"" + session.parsed_error.lang + "\"," +
      "\"attempts\":" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts) + "," +
      "\"reason\":\"" + json_escape(session.failure_reason) + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str(session.start_time) +
    "}"

    append_to_file(cfg.memory_path, record + "\n")
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn curl_get(url: string) -> Result<string, string>
  do

    return exec(cmd)
end

fn curl_post_auth(url: string, body: string, token: string) -> Result<string, string>
  do
    let cmd = "curl -s -f -X POST" +
              " -H 'Content-Type: application/json'" +
              " -H 'Authorization: token " + token + "'" +
              " -d '" + shell_escape_single(body) + "'" +
              " '" + url + "'"
    return exec(cmd)
end

fn json_extract_string(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    if str_contains(json, search)
      let after = str_after(json, search)
      let result = ""
      let i = 0
      let len = str_len(after)
      while i < len
        let ch = str_char(after, i)
        if ch == "\\" i = i + 1
        else if ch == "\"" return result
        else result = result + ch
        i = i + 1
      end
    end
    return ""
end

fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn shell_escape_single(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "'"
        result = result + "'\\''"
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn arr_contains_str(arr: array, s: string) -> bool
  do
    let n = arr_len(arr)
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if arr_get(arr, i) == s return true
      i = i + 1
    end
    return false
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn sleep_sec(n: i32) -> void

  do
    exec("sleep " + int_to_str(n))
end

fn curl_get(url: string) -> Result<string, string>
  do
    let cmd = "curl -s -f '" + url + "'"
    return exec(cmd)
end

fn curl_post_auth(url: string, body: string, token: string) -> Result<string, string>
  do
    let cmd = "curl -s -f -X POST" +
              " -H 'Content-Type: application/json'" +
              " -H 'Authorization: token " + token + "'" +
              " -d '" + shell_escape_single(body) + "'" +
              " '" + url + "'"
    return exec(cmd)
end

fn json_extract_string(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    if str_contains(json, search)
      let after = str_after(json, search)
      let result = ""
      let i = 0
      let len = str_len(after)
      while i < len
        let ch = str_char(after, i)
        if ch == "\\" i = i + 1
        else if ch == "\"" return result
        else result = result + ch
        i = i + 1
      end
    end
    return ""
end

fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn shell_escape_single(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "'"
        result = result + "'\\''"
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn arr_contains_str(arr: array, s: string) -> bool
  do
    let n = arr_len(arr)
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if arr_get(arr, i) == s return true
      i = i + 1
    end
    return false
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

// ============================================================
// auto_merge.fl - 자동 머지 엔진 (Phase 3)
// PR CI 통과 확인 → 조건 검사 → 자동 병합 → 브랜치 정리
// ============================================================

struct MergePolicy {
  require_ci_pass: bool,       // CI 통과 필수
  require_claude_approval: bool, // Claude 검증 통과 필수
  require_no_conflict: bool,   // 충돌 없음 필수
  min_proof_score: i32,        // 최소 ProofScore (0-100)
  auto_delete_branch: bool,    // 머지 후 브랜치 자동 삭제
  merge_method: string,        // "merge" | "squash" | "rebase"
  max_ci_wait_sec: i32         // CI 대기 최대 시간
}

struct MergeResult {
  success: bool,
  pr_number: i32,
  merge_sha: string,           // 머지 커밋 SHA
  merge_method: string,
  branch_deleted: bool,
  reason: string,              // 성공/실패 이유
  duration_sec: i32
}

struct MergeDecision {
  should_merge: bool,
  reason: string,
  blocking_reasons: array,     // 차단 이유 목록
  proof_score: i32
}

// ==================== 메인 자동 머지 ====================

fn auto_merge(
  client: GogsClient,
  repo: string,
  pr: GogsPR,
  policy: MergePolicy,
  proof_score: i32,
  verify_result: VerifyResult
) -> MergeResult
  intent "PR 자동 머지 파이프라인"
  do
    let start_time = now_unix()
    print("[AutoMerge] PR #" + int_to_str(pr.number) + " 자동 머지 평가 시작")

    // ─── Step 1: 머지 조건 평가 ──────────────────────────
    let decision = evaluate_merge_decision(pr, policy, proof_score, verify_result)

    if !decision.should_merge
      print("[AutoMerge] ❌ 머지 조건 미충족:")
      let i = 0
      let n = arr_len(decision.blocking_reasons)
      while i < n
        print("[AutoMerge]   - " + arr_get(decision.blocking_reasons, i))
        i = i + 1
      end

      return MergeResult {
        success: false,
        pr_number: pr.number,
        merge_sha: "",
        merge_method: "",
        branch_deleted: false,
        reason: "조건 미충족: " + format_blocking_reasons(decision.blocking_reasons),
        duration_sec: now_unix() - start_time
      }
    end

    print("[AutoMerge] ✅ 조건 충족 (ProofScore: " + int_to_str(proof_score) + ") - 머지 진행")

    // ─── Step 2: CI 상태 대기 ────────────────────────────
    if policy.require_ci_pass
      print("[AutoMerge] CI 상태 대기 중...")

      let poll_cfg = CiPollConfig {
        repo: repo,
        commit_sha: pr.head_sha,
        branch: pr.head_branch,
        max_wait_sec: policy.max_ci_wait_sec,
        poll_interval: 15,
        required_contexts: []
      }

      let ci_result = wait_for_ci(client, poll_cfg)

      if !ci_result.success
        let ci_reason = if ci_result.timed_out
          "CI 타임아웃 (" + int_to_str(policy.max_ci_wait_sec) + "초)"
        else
          "CI 실패: " + format_list(ci_result.failed_contexts)

        print("[AutoMerge] ❌ CI 미통과: " + ci_reason)

        // CI 실패 코멘트
        gogs_add_pr_comment(client, repo, pr.number,
          "❌ **자동 머지 취소** - " + ci_reason + "\n\n" +
          "Self-Healing Agent가 패치를 생성했지만 CI가 통과하지 못했습니다.\n" +
          "수동으로 확인 후 머지해주세요.")

        return MergeResult {
          success: false,
          pr_number: pr.number,
          merge_sha: "",
          merge_method: "",
          branch_deleted: false,
          reason: ci_reason,
          duration_sec: now_unix() - start_time
        }
      end

      print("[AutoMerge] ✅ CI 통과!")
    end

    // ─── Step 3: 충돌 확인 ───────────────────────────────
    if policy.require_no_conflict
      let conflict_check = check_merge_conflict(client, repo, pr)
      if conflict_check
        print("[AutoMerge] ❌ 충돌 감지")
        return MergeResult {
          success: false,
          pr_number: pr.number,
          merge_sha: "",
          merge_method: "",
          branch_deleted: false,
          reason: "머지 충돌 감지",
          duration_sec: now_unix() - start_time
        }
      end
    end

    // ─── Step 4: 머지 실행 ───────────────────────────────
    let merge_msg = build_merge_message(pr, proof_score, policy.merge_method)
    print("[AutoMerge] 머지 실행 (" + policy.merge_method + ")...")

    let merge_result = gogs_merge_pr(client, repo, pr.number, merge_msg)

    match merge_result
      Err(e) => {
        print("[AutoMerge] ❌ 머지 실패: " + e)
        return MergeResult {
          success: false,
          pr_number: pr.number,
          merge_sha: "",
          merge_method: policy.merge_method,
          branch_deleted: false,
          reason: "머지 실패: " + e,
          duration_sec: now_unix() - start_time
        }
      }
      Ok(_) => {
        print("[AutoMerge] ✅ 머지 성공!")

        // ─── Step 5: 브랜치 정리 ─────────────────────────
        let branch_deleted = false
        if policy.auto_delete_branch && pr.head_branch != ""
          match gogs_delete_branch(client, repo, pr.head_branch)
            Ok(_) => {
              branch_deleted = true
              print("[AutoMerge] 브랜치 삭제: " + pr.head_branch)
            }
            Err(e) => {
              print("[AutoMerge] 브랜치 삭제 실패 (무시): " + e)
            }
          end
        end

        // ─── Step 6: 머지 SHA 조회 ───────────────────────
        let merge_sha = get_merge_sha(client, repo, pr.base_branch)

        // ─── Step 7: 성공 코멘트 ─────────────────────────
        let success_comment = build_success_comment(pr, proof_score, merge_sha, policy.merge_method)
        gogs_add_pr_comment(client, repo, pr.number, success_comment)

        return MergeResult {
          success: true,
          pr_number: pr.number,
          merge_sha: merge_sha,
          merge_method: policy.merge_method,
          branch_deleted: branch_deleted,
          reason: "자동 머지 성공 (ProofScore: " + int_to_str(proof_score) + ")",
          duration_sec: now_unix() - start_time
        }
      }
    end
end

// ==================== 머지 조건 평가 ====================

fn evaluate_merge_decision(
  pr: GogsPR,
  policy: MergePolicy,
  proof_score: i32,
  verify: VerifyResult
) -> MergeDecision
  intent "머지 가능 여부 종합 판단"
  do
    let blocking = []
    let should_merge = true

    // ProofScore 최소값 체크
    if proof_score < policy.min_proof_score
      blocking = arr_push(blocking,
        "ProofScore " + int_to_str(proof_score) + " < 최소 " + int_to_str(policy.min_proof_score))
      should_merge = false
    end

    // Claude 검증 필수
    if policy.require_claude_approval && !verify.claude_verdict
      blocking = arr_push(blocking,
        "Claude 검증 미통과 (신뢰도: " + int_to_str(verify.claude_confidence) + "%)")
      should_merge = false
    end

    // 회귀 없음 필수 (정책과 무관하게 회귀는 항상 차단)
    if verify.regression_detected
      blocking = arr_push(blocking,
        "회귀 감지: " + format_list(verify.new_failures))
      should_merge = false
    end

    // PR 상태 확인
    if pr.state != "open"
      blocking = arr_push(blocking, "PR이 open 상태가 아님: " + pr.state)
      should_merge = false
    end

    return MergeDecision {
      should_merge: should_merge,
      reason: if should_merge "조건 충족" else "조건 미충족",
      blocking_reasons: blocking,
      proof_score: proof_score
    }
end

fn check_merge_conflict(client: GogsClient, repo: string, pr: GogsPR) -> bool
  intent "PR 충돌 여부 확인"
  do
    // GOGS API에서 mergeable 필드 조회
    let url = client.base_url + "/api/v1/repos/" +
              client.owner + "/" + repo + "/pulls/" +
              int_to_str(pr.number) + "?token=" + client.token

    match curl_get(url)
      Err(_) => return false  // 확인 실패 시 충돌 없다고 가정
      Ok(resp) => {
        // "mergeable": false 패턴
        if str_contains(resp, "\"mergeable\":false") ||
           str_contains(resp, "\"mergeable\": false")
          return true
        end
        return false
      }
    end
end

// ==================== 머지 메시지 빌더 ====================

fn build_merge_message(pr: GogsPR, proof_score: i32, method: string) -> string
  intent "머지 커밋 메시지 생성"
  do
    let msg = ""

    if method == "squash"
      msg = "[auto-heal] " + pr.title + "\n\n"
      msg = msg + "Self-Healing Agent 자동 패치 적용\n"
      msg = msg + "ProofScore: " + int_to_str(proof_score) + "/100\n"
      msg = msg + "PR #" + int_to_str(pr.number)
    else
      msg = "Merge pull request #" + int_to_str(pr.number) + "\n\n"
      msg = msg + pr.title + "\n"
      msg = msg + "ProofScore: " + int_to_str(proof_score) + "/100"
    end

    return msg
end

fn build_success_comment(pr: GogsPR, proof_score: i32, merge_sha: string, method: string) -> string
  intent "자동 머지 성공 코멘트 생성"
  do
    let sha_short = if str_len(merge_sha) >= 8 str_substr(merge_sha, 0, 8) else merge_sha

    let comment = "## ✅ Self-Healing Agent 자동 머지 완료\n\n"
    comment = comment + "| 항목 | 값 |\n"
    comment = comment + "|------|----|\n"
    comment = comment + "| ProofScore | " + int_to_str(proof_score) + "/100 |\n"
    comment = comment + "| 머지 방식 | " + method + " |\n"
    comment = comment + "| 머지 SHA | `" + sha_short + "` |\n"
    comment = comment + "\n*이 패치는 Self-Healing Code Agent가 자동으로 생성하고 검증했습니다.*"

    return comment
end

// ==================== 머지 후 처리 ====================

fn get_merge_sha(client: GogsClient, repo: string, branch: string) -> string
  intent "브랜치 최신 커밋 SHA 조회"
  do
    match gogs_get_branch_sha(client, repo, branch)
      Ok(sha) => return sha
      Err(_) => return ""
    end
end

fn report_merge_result(result: MergeResult) -> string
  intent "머지 결과 요약 문자열 생성"
  do
    let icon = if result.success "✅" else "❌"
    let text = icon + " 자동 머지 " + (if result.success "성공" else "실패") + "\n"
    text = text + "  PR: #" + int_to_str(result.pr_number) + "\n"
    text = text + "  이유: " + result.reason + "\n"
    text = text + "  소요: " + int_to_str(result.duration_sec) + "초\n"

    if result.success
      text = text + "  SHA: " + str_substr(result.merge_sha, 0, 8) + "\n"
      text = text + "  브랜치 삭제: " + (if result.branch_deleted "예" else "아니오") + "\n"
    end

    return text
end

// ==================== 기본 정책 ====================

fn default_merge_policy() -> MergePolicy
  intent "기본 자동 머지 정책"
  do
    return MergePolicy {
      require_ci_pass: true,
      require_claude_approval: true,
      require_no_conflict: true,
      min_proof_score: 60,
      auto_delete_branch: true,
      merge_method: "squash",
      max_ci_wait_sec: 300
    }
end

fn strict_merge_policy() -> MergePolicy
  intent "엄격한 머지 정책 (높은 신뢰도 필요)"
  do
    return MergePolicy {
      require_ci_pass: true,
      require_claude_approval: true,
      require_no_conflict: true,
      min_proof_score: 80,
      auto_delete_branch: true,
      merge_method: "squash",
      max_ci_wait_sec: 600
    }
end

fn fast_merge_policy() -> MergePolicy
  intent "빠른 머지 정책 (CI 없는 환경)"
  do
    return MergePolicy {
      require_ci_pass: false,
      require_claude_approval: true,
      require_no_conflict: true,
      min_proof_score: 50,
      auto_delete_branch: true,
      merge_method: "merge",
      max_ci_wait_sec: 0
    }
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn format_blocking_reasons(reasons: array) -> string
  do
    let n = arr_len(reasons)
    if n == 0 return "(없음)"
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if i > 0 result = result + "; "
      result = result + arr_get(reasons, i)
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn format_list(arr: array) -> string
  do
    let n = arr_len(arr)
    if n == 0 return "(없음)"
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if i > 0 result = result + ", "
      result = result + arr_get(arr, i)
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn curl_get(url: string) -> Result<string, string>
  do
    return exec("curl -s -f '" + url + "'")
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

          branch_deleted: false,
          reason: "머지 충돌 감지",
          duration_sec: now_unix() - start_time
        }
      end
    end

    // ─── Step 4: 머지 실행 ───────────────────────────────
    let merge_msg = build_merge_message(pr, proof_score, policy.merge_method)
    print("[AutoMerge] 머지 실행 (" + policy.merge_method + ")...")

    let merge_result = gogs_merge_pr(client, repo, pr.number, merge_msg)

    match merge_result
      Err(e) => {
        print("[AutoMerge] ❌ 머지 실패: " + e)
        return MergeResult {
          success: false,
          pr_number: pr.number,
          merge_sha: "",
          merge_method: policy.merge_method,
          branch_deleted: false,
          reason: "머지 실패: " + e,
          duration_sec: now_unix() - start_time
        }
      }
      Ok(_) => {
        print("[AutoMerge] ✅ 머지 성공!")

        // ─── Step 5: 브랜치 정리 ─────────────────────────
        let branch_deleted = false
        if policy.auto_delete_branch && pr.head_branch != ""
          match gogs_delete_branch(client, repo, pr.head_branch)
            Ok(_) => {
              branch_deleted = true
              print("[AutoMerge] 브랜치 삭제: " + pr.head_branch)
            }
            Err(e) => {
              print("[AutoMerge] 브랜치 삭제 실패 (무시): " + e)
            }
          end
        end

        // ─── Step 6: 머지 SHA 조회 ───────────────────────
        let merge_sha = get_merge_sha(client, repo, pr.base_branch)

        // ─── Step 7: 성공 코멘트 ─────────────────────────
        let success_comment = build_success_comment(pr, proof_score, merge_sha, policy.merge_method)
        gogs_add_pr_comment(client, repo, pr.number, success_comment)

        return MergeResult {
          success: true,
          pr_number: pr.number,
          merge_sha: merge_sha,
          merge_method: policy.merge_method,
          branch_deleted: branch_deleted,
          reason: "자동 머지 성공 (ProofScore: " + int_to_str(proof_score) + ")",
          duration_sec: now_unix() - start_time
        }
      }
    end
end

// ==================== 머지 조건 평가 ====================

fn evaluate_merge_decision(
  pr: GogsPR,
  policy: MergePolicy,
  proof_score: i32,
  verify: VerifyResult
) -> MergeDecision
  intent "머지 가능 여부 종합 판단"
  do
    let blocking = []
    let should_merge = true

    // ProofScore 최소값 체크
    if proof_score < policy.min_proof_score
      blocking = arr_push(blocking,
        "ProofScore " + int_to_str(proof_score) + " < 최소 " + int_to_str(policy.min_proof_score))
      should_merge = false
    end

    // Claude 검증 필수
    if policy.require_claude_approval && !verify.claude_verdict
      blocking = arr_push(blocking,
        "Claude 검증 미통과 (신뢰도: " + int_to_str(verify.claude_confidence) + "%)")
      should_merge = false
    end

    // 회귀 없음 필수 (정책과 무관하게 회귀는 항상 차단)
    if verify.regression_detected
      blocking = arr_push(blocking,
        "회귀 감지: " + format_list(verify.new_failures))
      should_merge = false
    end

    // PR 상태 확인
    if pr.state != "open"
      blocking = arr_push(blocking, "PR이 open 상태가 아님: " + pr.state)
      should_merge = false
    end

    return MergeDecision {
      should_merge: should_merge,
      reason: if should_merge "조건 충족" else "조건 미충족",
      blocking_reasons: blocking,
      proof_score: proof_score
    }
end

fn check_merge_conflict(client: GogsClient, repo: string, pr: GogsPR) -> bool
  intent "PR 충돌 여부 확인"
  do
    // GOGS API에서 mergeable 필드 조회
    let url = client.base_url + "/api/v1/repos/" +
              client.owner + "/" + repo + "/pulls/" +
              int_to_str(pr.number) + "?token=" + client.token

    match curl_get(url)
      Err(_) => return false  // 확인 실패 시 충돌 없다고 가정
      Ok(resp) => {
        // "mergeable": false 패턴
        if str_contains(resp, "\"mergeable\":false") ||
           str_contains(resp, "\"mergeable\": false")
          return true
        end
        return false
      }
    end
end

// ==================== 머지 메시지 빌더 ====================

fn build_merge_message(pr: GogsPR, proof_score: i32, method: string) -> string
  intent "머지 커밋 메시지 생성"
  do
    let msg = ""

    if method == "squash"
      msg = "[auto-heal] " + pr.title + "\n\n"
      msg = msg + "Self-Healing Agent 자동 패치 적용\n"
      msg = msg + "ProofScore: " + int_to_str(proof_score) + "/100\n"
      msg = msg + "PR #" + int_to_str(pr.number)
    else
      msg = "Merge pull request #" + int_to_str(pr.number) + "\n\n"
      msg = msg + pr.title + "\n"
      msg = msg + "ProofScore: " + int_to_str(proof_score) + "/100"
    end

    return msg
end

fn build_success_comment(pr: GogsPR, proof_score: i32, merge_sha: string, method: string) -> string
  intent "자동 머지 성공 코멘트 생성"
  do
    let sha_short = if str_len(merge_sha) >= 8 str_substr(merge_sha, 0, 8) else merge_sha

    let comment = "## ✅ Self-Healing Agent 자동 머지 완료\n\n"
    comment = comment + "| 항목 | 값 |\n"
    comment = comment + "|------|----|\n"
    comment = comment + "| ProofScore | " + int_to_str(proof_score) + "/100 |\n"
    comment = comment + "| 머지 방식 | " + method + " |\n"
    comment = comment + "| 머지 SHA | `" + sha_short + "` |\n"
    comment = comment + "\n*이 패치는 Self-Healing Code Agent가 자동으로 생성하고 검증했습니다.*"

    return comment
end

// ==================== 머지 후 처리 ====================

fn get_merge_sha(client: GogsClient, repo: string, branch: string) -> string
  intent "브랜치 최신 커밋 SHA 조회"
  do
    match gogs_get_branch_sha(client, repo, branch)
      Ok(sha) => return sha
      Err(_) => return ""
    end
end

fn report_merge_result(result: MergeResult) -> string
  intent "머지 결과 요약 문자열 생성"
  do
    let icon = if result.success "✅" else "❌"
    let text = icon + " 자동 머지 " + (if result.success "성공" else "실패") + "\n"
    text = text + "  PR: #" + int_to_str(result.pr_number) + "\n"
    text = text + "  이유: " + result.reason + "\n"
    text = text + "  소요: " + int_to_str(result.duration_sec) + "초\n"

    if result.success
      text = text + "  SHA: " + str_substr(result.merge_sha, 0, 8) + "\n"
      text = text + "  브랜치 삭제: " + (if result.branch_deleted "예" else "아니오") + "\n"
    end

    return text
end

// ==================== 기본 정책 ====================

fn default_merge_policy() -> MergePolicy
  intent "기본 자동 머지 정책"
  do
    return MergePolicy {
      require_ci_pass: true,
      require_claude_approval: true,
      require_no_conflict: true,
      min_proof_score: 60,
      auto_delete_branch: true,
      merge_method: "squash",
      max_ci_wait_sec: 300
    }
end

fn strict_merge_policy() -> MergePolicy
  intent "엄격한 머지 정책 (높은 신뢰도 필요)"
  do
    return MergePolicy {
      require_ci_pass: true,
      require_claude_approval: true,
      require_no_conflict: true,
      min_proof_score: 80,
      auto_delete_branch: true,
      merge_method: "squash",
      max_ci_wait_sec: 600
    }
end

fn fast_merge_policy() -> MergePolicy
  intent "빠른 머지 정책 (CI 없는 환경)"
  do
    return MergePolicy {
      require_ci_pass: false,
      require_claude_approval: true,
      require_no_conflict: true,
      min_proof_score: 50,
      auto_delete_branch: true,
      merge_method: "merge",
      max_ci_wait_sec: 0
    }
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn format_blocking_reasons(reasons: array) -> string
  do
    let n = arr_len(reasons)
    if n == 0 return "(없음)"
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if i > 0 result = result + "; "
      result = result + arr_get(reasons, i)
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn format_list(arr: array) -> string
  do
    let n = arr_len(arr)
    if n == 0 return "(없음)"
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < n
      if i > 0 result = result + ", "
      result = result + arr_get(arr, i)
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn curl_get(url: string) -> Result<string, string>
  do
    return exec("curl -s -f '" + url + "'")
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end
