   305→// ==================== 패치 검증 ====================
   306→
   307→fn validate_patch(patch: Patch, orig_content: string) -> Result<void, string>
   308→  intent "패치 적용 전 유효성 검사"
   309→  do
   310→    if arr_len(patch.hunks) == 0
   311→      return Err("헝크가 없는 빈 패치")
   312→    end
   313→
   314→    let orig_lines = str_split_lines(orig_content)
   315→    let orig_total = arr_len(orig_lines)
   316→
   317→    // 각 헝크의 원본 줄 범위 검증
   318→    let i = 0
   319→    let total = arr_len(patch.hunks)
   320→
   321→    while i < total
   322→      let hunk = arr_get(patch.hunks, i)
   323→
   324→      if hunk.orig_start < 1
   325→        return Err("헝크 시작 줄이 1보다 작습니다: " + int_to_str(hunk.orig_start))
   326→      end
   327→
   328→      let hunk_end = hunk.orig_start + hunk.orig_count - 1
   329→      if hunk_end > orig_total
   330→        return Err("헝크 범위가 파일 범위를 초과합니다 (헝크끝: " +
   331→                   int_to_str(hunk_end) + ", 파일줄수: " + int_to_str(orig_total) + ")")
   332→      end
   333→
   334→      // 컨텍스트 줄 일치 검사 (처음 1줄만)
   335→      let context_check = verify_hunk_context(hunk, orig_lines)
   336→      match context_check
   337→        Err(e) => return Err("컨텍스트 불일치: " + e)
   338→        Ok(_) => {}
   339→      end
   340→
   341→      i = i + 1
   342→    end
   343→
   344→    return Ok(void)
   345→end
   346→
   347→fn verify_hunk_context(hunk: PatchHunk, orig_lines: array) -> Result<void, string>
   348→  intent "헝크 컨텍스트 줄이 원본과 일치하는지 확인"
   349→  do
   350→    let hunk_line_idx = 0
   351→    let orig_pos = hunk.orig_start - 1  // 0-indexed
   352→    let total_hunk = arr_len(hunk.lines)
   353→
   354→    while hunk_line_idx < total_hunk
   355→      let pl = arr_get(hunk.lines, hunk_line_idx)
   356→
   357→      if pl.op == " " || pl.op == "-"
   358→        // 원본 줄과 비교
   359→        let orig_line = arr_get(orig_lines, orig_pos)
   360→        if str_trim(orig_line) != str_trim(pl.content)
   361→          return Err("줄 " + int_to_str(orig_pos + 1) +
   362→                     " 불일치: 예상='" + pl.content +
   363→                     "' 실제='" + orig_line + "'")
   364→        end
   365→        orig_pos = orig_pos + 1
   366→      end
   367→
   368→      hunk_line_idx = hunk_line_idx + 1
   369→    end
   370→
   371→    return Ok(void)
   372→end

   376→fn patch_summary(patch: Patch) -> string
   377→  intent "패치 요약 문자열 생성"
   378→  do
   379→    let total_add = 0
   380→    let total_del = 0
   381→    let i = 0
   382→    let total = arr_len(patch.hunks)
   383→
   384→    while i < total
   385→      let hunk = arr_get(patch.hunks, i)
   386→      let li = 0
   387→      let hunk_lines = hunk.lines
   388→      let llen = arr_len(hunk_lines)
   389→
   390→      while li < llen
   391→        let pl = arr_get(hunk_lines, li)
   392→        if pl.op == "+"
   393→          total_add = total_add + 1
   394→        else if pl.op == "-"
   395→          total_del = total_del + 1
   396→        end
   397→        li = li + 1
   398→      end
   399→
   400→      i = i + 1
   401→    end
   402→
   403→    return patch.file_path + ": +" + int_to_str(total_add) + " -" + int_to_str(total_del) +
   404→           " (" + int_to_str(total) + " hunk)"
   405→end

   409→fn arr_join(arr: array, sep: string) -> string
   410→  intent "문자열 배열을 구분자로 합침"
   411→  do
   412→    let result = ""
   413→    let total = arr_len(arr)
   414→    let i = 0
   415→
   416→    while i < total
   417→      if i > 0
   418→        result = result + sep
   419→      end
   420→      result = result + arr_get(arr, i)
   421→      i = i + 1
   422→    end
   423→
   424→    return result
   425→end

   427→fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
   428→  do
   429→    if n == 0 return "0"
   430→    let result = ""
   431→    let num = n
   432→    let neg = false
   433→    if num < 0
   434→      neg = true
   435→      num = 0 - num
   436→    end
   437→    while num > 0
   438→      let d = num % 10
   439→      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
   440→      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
   441→      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
   442→      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
   443→      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
   444→      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
   445→      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
   446→      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
   447→      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
   448→      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
   449→      num = num / 10
   450→    end
   451→    if neg result = "-" + result
   452→    return result
   453→end

   455→fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
   456→  do
   457→    let num = 0
   458→    let i = 0
   459→    let len = str_len(s)
   460→    while i < len
   461→      let ch = str_char(s, i)
   462→      let d = 0
   463→      if ch == "0" d = 0
   464→      else if ch == "1" d = 1
   465→      else if ch == "2" d = 2
   466→      else if ch == "3" d = 3
   467→      else if ch == "4" d = 4
   468→      else if ch == "5" d = 5
   469→      else if ch == "6" d = 6
   470→      else if ch == "7" d = 7
   471→      else if ch == "8" d = 8
   472→      else if ch == "9" d = 9
   473→      else return num
   474→      num = num * 10 + d
   475→      i = i + 1
   476→    end
   477→    return num

    85→fn extract_json_block(text: string) -> string
    86→  intent "텍스트에서 JSON 블록 추출"
    87→  do
    88→    // ```json ... ``` 형식
    89→    if str_contains(text, "```json")
    90→      let after = str_after(text, "```json\n")
    91→      if str_contains(after, "\n```")
    92→        return str_before(after, "\n```")
    93→      end
    94→      return str_before(after, "```")
    95→    end
    96→
    97→    // ``` ... ``` 형식 (json 태그 없이)
    98→    if str_contains(text, "```\n{")
    99→      let after = str_after(text, "```\n")
   100→      return str_before(after, "\n```")
   101→    end
   102→
   103→    // 직접 { } 찾기
   104→    let brace_start = str_find_char(text, "{")
   105→    if brace_start >= 0
   106→      let from_brace = str_substr(text, brace_start, str_len(text))
   107→      let brace_end = find_matching_brace(from_brace)
   108→      if brace_end > 0
   109→        return str_substr(from_brace, 0, brace_end + 1)
   110→      end
   111→    end
   112→
   113→    return ""
   114→end
   115→
   116→fn find_matching_brace(text: string) -> i32
   117→  intent "중괄호 매칭 위치 찾기 (중첩 처리)"
   118→  do
   119→    let depth = 0
   120→    let i = 0
   121→    let len = str_len(text)
   122→    let in_string = false
   123→
   124→    while i < len
   125→      let ch = str_char(text, i)
   126→
   127→      if in_string
   128→        if ch == "\\"
   129→          i = i + 2  // 이스케이프 문자 스킵
   130→          continue
   131→        end
   132→        if ch == "\""
   133→          in_string = false
   134→        end
   135→      else
   136→        if ch == "\""
   137→          in_string = true
   138→        else if ch == "{"
   139→          depth = depth + 1
   140→        else if ch == "}"
   141→          depth = depth - 1
   142→          if depth == 0
   143→            return i
   144→          end
   145→        end
   146→      end
   147→
   148→      i = i + 1
   149→    end
   150→
   151→    return -1
   152→end

   156→fn infer_severity(root_cause: string) -> string
   157→  intent "근본 원인에서 심각도 추론"
   158→  do
   159→    let lower = str_lowercase(root_cause)
   160→
   161→    if str_contains(lower, "null") || str_contains(lower, "panic") ||
   162→       str_contains(lower, "overflow") || str_contains(lower, "undefined behavior")
   163→      return "critical"
   164→    end
   165→
   166→    if str_contains(lower, "type") || str_contains(lower, "borrow") ||
   167→       str_contains(lower, "lifetime") || str_contains(lower, "ownership")
   168→      return "high"
   169→    end
   170→
   171→    if str_contains(lower, "logic") || str_contains(lower, "wrong") ||
   172→       str_contains(lower, "incorrect") || str_contains(lower, "missing")
   173→      return "medium"
   174→    end
   175→
   176→    return "low"
   177→end

   179→fn infer_category(root_cause: string, fix_strategy: string) -> string
   180→  intent "근본 원인에서 에러 카테고리 추론"
   181→  do
   182→    let combined = str_lowercase(root_cause + " " + fix_strategy)
   183→
   184→    if str_contains(combined, "type") || str_contains(combined, "mismatch") ||
   185→       str_contains(combined, "cast") || str_contains(combined, "convert")
   186→      return "type_mismatch"
   187→    end
   188→
   189→    if str_contains(combined, "null") || str_contains(combined, "none") ||
   190→       str_contains(combined, "option") || str_contains(combined, "unwrap")
   191→      return "null_deref"
   192→    end
   193→
   194→    if str_contains(combined, "borrow") || str_contains(combined, "lifetime") ||
   195→       str_contains(combined, "ownership") || str_contains(combined, "move")
   196→      return "ownership_error"
   197→    end
   198→
   199→    if str_contains(combined, "logic") || str_contains(combined, "algorithm") ||
   200→       str_contains(combined, "calculation") || str_contains(combined, "arithmetic")
   201→      return "logic_error"
   202→    end
   203→
   204→    if str_contains(combined, "missing") || str_contains(combined, "not found") ||
   205→       str_contains(combined, "undefined") || str_contains(combined, "unresolved")
   206→      return "missing_impl"
   207→    end
   208→
   209→    if str_contains(combined, "assertion") || str_contains(combined, "expect") ||
   210→       str_contains(combined, "test") || str_contains(combined, "assert")
   211→      return "assertion_failure"
   212→    end
   213→
   214→    return "unknown"
   215→end

   219→fn rank_errors(errors: array) -> array
   220→  intent "에러 배열을 심각도 + 수정 가능성으로 정렬"
   221→  do
   222→    // 단순 버블 정렬 (에러 수가 적으므로 충분)
   223→    let ranked = arr_copy(errors)
   224→    let n = arr_len(ranked)
   225→    let i = 0
   226→
   227→    while i < n - 1
   228→      let j = 0
   229→      while j < n - i - 1
   230→        let a = arr_get(ranked, j)
   231→        let b = arr_get(ranked, j + 1)
   232→
   233→        if error_priority(a) < error_priority(b)
   234→          ranked = arr_swap(ranked, j, j + 1)
   235→        end
   236→
   237→        j = j + 1
   238→      end
   239→      i = i + 1
   240→    end
   241→
   242→    return ranked
   243→end

   245→fn error_priority(err: ParsedError) -> i32
   246→  intent "단일 에러 우선순위 점수 (높을수록 먼저 처리)"
   247→  do
   248→    let score = 0
   249→
   250→    // 에러 타입별 기본 점수
   251→    if err.error_type == "compile_error"
   252→      score = 100  // 컴파일 에러 최우선
   253→    else if err.error_type == "type_error"
   254→      score = 90
   255→    else if err.error_type == "panic"
   256→      score = 80  // 런타임 panic
   257→    else if err.error_type == "test_failure"
   258→      score = 60
   259→    else
   260→      score = 40
   261→    end
   262→
   263→    // 파일 위치 있으면 +10 (수정 가능성 높음)
   264→    if err.file_path != ""
   265→      score = score + 10
   266→    end
   267→
   268→    // 줄 번호 있으면 +5
   269→    if err.line_num > 0
   270→      score = score + 5
   271→    end
   272→
   273→    // 테스트 이름 있으면 +5
   274→    if err.test_name != ""
   275→      score = score + 5
   276→    end
   277→
   278→    return score
   279→end

   308→fn detect_shared_cause(errors: array) -> string
   309→  intent "에러들의 공통 원인 탐지"
   310→  do
   311→    let n = arr_len(errors)
   312→    if n < 2
   313→      return ""
   314→    end
   315→
   316→    // 같은 파일에서 나온 에러들
   317→    let first = arr_get(errors, 0)
   318→    let all_same_file = true
   319→    let i = 1
   320→
   321→    while i < n
   322→      let err = arr_get(errors, i)
   323→      if err.file_path != first.file_path
   324→        all_same_file = false
   325→      end
   326→      i = i + 1
   327→    end
   328→
   329→    if all_same_file && first.file_path != ""
   330→      return "같은 파일에서 " + int_to_str(n) + "개 에러 발생 (" + first.file_path + ")"
   331→    end
   332→
   333→    // 같은 에러 타입
   334→    let all_same_type = true
   335→    i = 1
   336→    while i < n
   337→      let err = arr_get(errors, i)
   338→      if err.error_type != first.error_type
   339→        all_same_type = false
   340→      end
   341→      i = i + 1
   342→    end
   343→
   344→    if all_same_type
   345→      return "동일 타입의 에러 반복: " + first.error_type
   346→    end
   347→
   348→    return ""
   349→end

   351→fn build_fix_order(errors: array) -> array
   352→  intent "에러 수정 순서 결정 (줄 번호 역순 - 위에서 수정하면 줄 번호 밀림 방지)"
   353→  do
   354→    let order = []
   355→    let n = arr_len(errors)
   356→
   357→    // 컴파일 에러만 먼저 (줄 번호 역순)
   358→    let compile_errors = []
   359→    let other_errors = []
   360→    let i = 0
   361→
   362→    while i < n
   363→      let err = arr_get(errors, i)
   364→      if err.error_type == "compile_error" || err.error_type == "type_error"
   365→        compile_errors = arr_push(compile_errors, i)
   366→      else
   367→        other_errors = arr_push(other_errors, i)
   368→      end
   369→      i = i + 1
   370→    end
   371→
   372→    // 컴파일 에러 역순 (줄 번호 큰 것부터)
   373→    let sorted_compile = sort_by_line_desc(compile_errors, errors)
   374→    let j = 0
   375→    while j < arr_len(sorted_compile)
   376→      order = arr_push(order, arr_get(sorted_compile, j))
   377→      j = j + 1
   378→    end
   379→
   380→    // 나머지 에러
   381→    j = 0
   382→    while j < arr_len(other_errors)
   383→      order = arr_push(order, arr_get(other_errors, j))
   384→      j = j + 1
   385→    end
   386→
   387→    return order
   388→end

   390→fn sort_by_line_desc(indices: array, errors: array) -> array
   391→  intent "에러 인덱스 배열을 줄 번호 내림차순으로 정렬"
   392→  do
   393→    let result = arr_copy(indices)
   394→    let n = arr_len(result)
   395→
   396→    let i = 0
   397→    while i < n - 1
   398→      let j = 0
   399→      while j < n - i - 1
   400→        let ia = arr_get(result, j)
   401→        let ib = arr_get(result, j + 1)
   402→        let ea = arr_get(errors, ia)
   403→        let eb = arr_get(errors, ib)
   404→
   405→        if ea.line_num < eb.line_num
   406→          result = arr_swap(result, j, j + 1)
   407→        end
   408→
   409→        j = j + 1
   410→      end
   411→      i = i + 1
   412→    end
   413→
   414→    return result
   415→end

   417→fn estimate_hunks(errors: array) -> i32
   418→  intent "예상 패치 헝크 수 추정"
   419→  do
   420→    let n = arr_len(errors)
   421→    if n == 0
   422→      return 0
   423→    end
   424→
   425→    let hunks = 0
   426→    let i = 0
   427→
   428→    while i < n
   429→      let err = arr_get(errors, i)
   430→
   431→      if err.fix_type == "refactor"
   432→        hunks = hunks + 3   // 리팩토링은 여러 헝크
   433→      else if err.fix_type == "block_change"
   434→        hunks = hunks + 2
   435→      else
   436→        hunks = hunks + 1   // 줄 변경은 1 헝크
   437→      end
   438→
   439→      i = i + 1
   440→    end
   441→
   442→    return hunks
   443→end

   447→fn format_analysis_for_prompt(analysis: AnalysisResult) -> string
   448→  intent "분석 결과를 패치 생성 프롬프트용으로 포맷"
   449→  do
   450→    let text = "## 에러 분석 결과\n\n"
   451→    text = text + "**근본 원인**: " + analysis.root_cause + "\n\n"
   452→    text = text + "**수정 전략**: " + analysis.fix_strategy + "\n\n"

   545→fn is_test_for(test_file: string, src_file: string) -> bool

   558→fn str_dir_of(path: string) -> string

   584→fn str_before_last(s: string, delim: string) -> string
   585→  intent "마지막 구분자 이전 문자열"
   586→  do
   587→    let last_pos = -1
   588→    let i = 0
   589→    let len = str_len(s)
   590→    let dlen = str_len(delim)
   591→
   592→    while i <= len - dlen
   593→      if str_substr(s, i, i + dlen) == delim
   594→        last_pos = i
   595→      end
   596→      i = i + 1
   597→    end
   598→
   599→    if last_pos < 0
   600→      return s
   601→    end
   602→
   603→    return str_substr(s, 0, last_pos)
   604→end

   606→fn str_after_last(s: string, delim: string) -> string
   607→  intent "마지막 구분자 이후 문자열"
   608→  do
   609→    let last_pos = -1
   610→    let i = 0

   612→    let dlen = str_len(delim)

   614→    while i <= len - dlen
   615→      if str_substr(s, i, i + dlen) == delim
   616→        last_pos = i
   617→      end
   618→      i = i + 1
   619→    end
   620→
   621→    if last_pos < 0
   622→      return s
   623→    end
   624→
   625→    return str_substr(s, last_pos + dlen, len)

   690→fn json_extract_int_array(json: string, key: string) -> array
   691→  intent "JSON 정수 배열 추출: \"key\": [1, 2, 3]"
   692→  do
   693→    let result = []
   694→    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
   695→    if !str_contains(json, search)
   696→      return result
   697→    end
   698→
   699→    let after = str_after(json, search)
   700→    let trimmed = str_trim(after)
   701→
   702→    if str_char(trimmed, 0) != "["
   703→      return result
   704→    end
   705→
   706→    let inner = str_between(trimmed, "[", "]")
   707→    let parts = str_split_by_comma(inner)
   708→    let n = arr_len(parts)
   709→    let i = 0
   710→
   711→    while i < n
   712→      let part = str_trim(arr_get(parts, i))
   713→      let num = parse_int_from_str(part)
   714→      if num > 0 || part == "0"
   715→        result = arr_push(result, num)
   716→      end
   717→      i = i + 1
   718→    end
   719→
   720→    return result
   721→end

   723→fn json_extract_str_array(json: string, key: string) -> array
   724→  intent "JSON 문자열 배열 추출: \"key\": [\"a\", \"b\"]"
   725→  do
   726→    let result = []
   727→    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
   728→    if !str_contains(json, search)
   729→      return result
   730→    end
   731→
   732→    let after = str_after(json, search)
   733→    let trimmed = str_trim(after)
   734→
   735→    if str_char(trimmed, 0) != "["
   736→      return result
   737→    end
   738→
   739→    // 배열 내용 추출
   740→    let i = 1
   741→    let len = str_len(trimmed)
   742→    let current = ""
   743→    let in_str = false
   744→
   745→    while i < len
   746→      let ch = str_char(trimmed, i)
   747→
   748→      if in_str
   749→        if ch == "\\"
   750→          i = i + 1
   751→          if i < len
   752→            current = current + str_char(trimmed, i)
   753→          end
   754→        else if ch == "\""
   755→          result = arr_push(result, current)
   756→          current = ""
   757→          in_str = false
   758→        else
   759→          current = current + ch
   760→        end
   761→      else
   762→        if ch == "\""
   763→          in_str = true
   764→        else if ch == "]"
   765→          break
   766→        end
   767→      end
   768→
   769→      i = i + 1
   770→    end
   771→
   772→    return result
   773→end

   775→fn str_split_by_comma(s: string) -> array
   776→  intent "쉼표로 문자열 분할 (문자열 내 쉼표 제외)"
   777→  do
   778→    let result = []
   779→    let current = ""
   780→    let depth = 0
   781→    let in_str = false
   782→    let i = 0
   783→    let len = str_len(s)
   784→
   785→    while i < len
   786→      let ch = str_char(s, i)
   787→
   788→      if in_str
   789→        if ch == "\\"
   790→          current = current + ch
   791→          i = i + 1
   792→          if i < len
   793→            current = current + str_char(s, i)
   794→          end
   795→        else if ch == "\""
   796→          in_str = false
   797→          current = current + ch
   798→        else
   799→          current = current + ch
   800→        end
   801→      else
   802→        if ch == "\""
   803→          in_str = true
   804→          current = current + ch
   805→        else if ch == "{"
   806→          depth = depth + 1
   807→          current = current + ch
   808→        else if ch == "}"
   809→          depth = depth - 1
   810→          current = current + ch
   811→        else if ch == "," && depth == 0
   812→          result = arr_push(result, current)
   813→          current = ""
   814→        else
   815→          current = current + ch
   816→        end
   817→      end
   818→
   819→      i = i + 1
   820→    end
   821→
   822→    if str_len(str_trim(current)) > 0
   823→      result = arr_push(result, current)
   824→    end
   825→
   826→    return result
   827→end

   831→fn json_extract_string(json: string, key: string) -> string
   832→  do

   834→    if str_contains(json, search)
   835→      let after = str_after(json, search)
   836→      let result = ""
   837→      let i = 0
   838→      let len = str_len(after)
   839→      while i < len
   840→        let ch = str_char(after, i)
   841→        if ch == "\\"
   842→          i = i + 1
   843→          if i < len
   844→            let next = str_char(after, i)
   845→            if next == "n" result = result + "\n"
   846→            else if next == "t" result = result + "\t"
   847→            else result = result + next
   848→          end
   849→        else if ch == "\""
   850→          return result

   852→          result = result + ch
   853→        end

   860→fn json_extract_int(json: string, key: string) -> i32
   861→  do
   862→    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
   863→    if str_contains(json, search)
   864→      let after = str_trim(str_after(json, search))
   865→      let result = ""
   866→      let i = 0
   867→      let len = str_len(after)
   868→      while i < len
   869→        let ch = str_char(after, i)
   870→        if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
   871→           ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
   872→          result = result + ch
   873→        else
   874→          break
   875→        end
   876→        i = i + 1
   877→      end
   878→      return parse_int_from_str(result)
   879→    end
   880→    return 0
   881→end

   883→fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
   884→  do
   885→    let num = 0
   886→    let i = 0
   887→    let len = str_len(s)
   888→    while i < len
   889→      let ch = str_char(s, i)
   890→      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
   891→      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
   892→      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
   893→      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
   894→      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
   895→      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
   896→      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
   897→      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
   898→      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
   899→      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
   900→      else return num
   901→      i = i + 1
   902→    end
   903→    return num
   904→end

   906→fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
   907→  do
   908→    if n == 0 return "0"
   909→    let result = ""
   910→    let num = n
   911→    let neg = false
   912→    if num < 0
   913→      neg = true
   914→      num = 0 - num
   915→    end
   916→    while num > 0
   917→      let d = num % 10
   918→      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
   919→      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
   920→      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
   921→      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
   922→      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
   923→      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
   924→      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
   925→      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
   926→      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
   927→      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
   928→      num = num / 10
   929→    end
   930→    if neg result = "-" + result
   931→    return result
   932→end

     7→struct RetryStrategy {

    13→  expand_scope: bool,       // 수정 범위 확장
    14→  prompt_additions: string, // 추가 프롬프트 지시사항

    16→}
    17→
    18→struct FailureMemory {
    19→  failed_patches: array,    // 실패한 diff 텍스트

    21→  tried_approaches: array,  // 시도한 approach 배열

    23→}

    27→fn get_retry_strategy(attempt: i32, prev_failure: string, error: ParsedError, memory: FailureMemory) -> RetryStrategy
    28→  intent "시도 번호와 이전 실패 원인으로 최적 전략 선택"
    29→  do
    30→    if attempt == 1
    31→      return strategy_minimal(error)
    32→    end
    33→
    34→    if attempt == 2
    35→      return strategy_contextual(error, prev_failure, memory)
    36→    end
    37→
    38→    if attempt == 3
    39→      return strategy_aggressive(error, prev_failure, memory)
    40→    end
    41→
    42→    // 4회 이상: 최후 수단
    43→    return strategy_refactor(error, memory)
    44→end

// ============================================================
// perf_memory.fl - 성능 메모리 & 약점 탐지 (Phase 5: 특이점)
// heal 세션 누적 → 통계 분석 → 약점 패턴 식별
// ============================================================

struct SessionStats {
  session_id: string,
  timestamp: i64,
  repo: string,
  lang: string,
  category: string,
  confidence: i32,
  proof_score: i32,
  patch_applied: bool,
  auto_merged: bool,
  retries_used: i32,
  error_type: string    // "compile|runtime|logic|unknown"
}

struct WeaknessEntry {
  weakness_type: string,   // "low_confidence|unknown_lang|patch_fail|low_proof"
  target_file: string,     // 수정해야 할 .fl 파일
  target_fn: string,       // 수정해야 할 함수
  frequency: i32,          // 발생 횟수
  avg_impact: i32,         // 평균 ProofScore 손실
  sample_case: string      // 대표 예시
}

struct PerfReport {
  total_sessions: i32,
  success_rate: i32,       // 0-100%
  avg_proof_score: i32,
  avg_confidence: i32,
  lang_unknown_rate: i32,  // lang==unknown 비율 %
  patch_fail_rate: i32,    // 패치 실패 비율 %
  low_confidence_rate: i32,// confidence<60% 비율 %
  weaknesses: array,       // WeaknessEntry[]
  generated_at: i64
}

// ==================== 메모리 기록 ====================

fn memory_record_session(stats: SessionStats, memory_path: string) -> void
  intent "heal 세션 결과를 JSON Lines 파일에 누적 기록"
  do
    let line = session_stats_to_json(stats) + "\n"
    append_to_file(memory_path, line)
end

fn memory_record_start(session_id: string, repo: string, memory_path: string) -> void
  intent "세션 시작 기록"
  do
    let stats = SessionStats {
      session_id: session_id,
      timestamp: now_unix(),
      repo: repo,
      lang: "unknown",
      category: "unknown",
      confidence: 0,
      proof_score: 0,
      patch_applied: false,
      auto_merged: false,
      retries_used: 0,
      error_type: "unknown"
    }
    memory_record_session(stats, memory_path)
end

fn memory_record_analysis(session_id: string, lang: string, category: string,
                           confidence: i32, error_type: string, memory_path: string) -> void
  intent "분석 단계 결과 업데이트"
  do
    // 간단히 새 라인으로 추가 (나중에 병합)
    let line = "{\"event\":\"analysis\",\"session_id\":\"" + session_id +
               "\",\"lang\":\"" + lang +
               "\",\"category\":\"" + category +
               "\",\"confidence\":" + int_to_str(confidence) +
               ",\"error_type\":\"" + error_type +
               "\",\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix()) + "}\n"
    append_to_file(memory_path, line)
end

fn memory_record_result(session_id: string, proof_score: i32, patch_applied: bool,
                        auto_merged: bool, retries: i32, memory_path: string) -> void
  intent "최종 결과 기록"
  do
    let applied_str = "false"
    if patch_applied applied_str = "true"
    let merged_str = "false"
    if auto_merged merged_str = "true"

    let line = "{\"event\":\"result\",\"session_id\":\"" + session_id +
               "\",\"proof_score\":" + int_to_str(proof_score) +
               ",\"patch_applied\":" + applied_str +
               ",\"auto_merged\":" + merged_str +
               ",\"retries\":" + int_to_str(retries) +
               ",\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix()) + "}\n"
    append_to_file(memory_path, line)
end

// ==================== 성능 분석 ====================

fn perf_analyze(memory_path: string, last_n: i32) -> PerfReport
  intent "최근 N개 세션에서 약점 탐지 및 성능 보고서 생성"
  do
    let sessions = load_recent_sessions(memory_path, last_n)
    let total = arr_len(sessions)

    if total == 0
      return empty_perf_report()
    end

    // 통계 집계
    let success_count = 0
    let total_proof = 0
    let total_confidence = 0
    let lang_unknown_count = 0
    let patch_fail_count = 0
    let low_confidence_count = 0

    let i = 0
    while i < total
      let s = arr_get(sessions, i)
      if s.auto_merged success_count = success_count + 1
      total_proof = total_proof + s.proof_score
      total_confidence = total_confidence + s.confidence
      if s.lang == "unknown" lang_unknown_count = lang_unknown_count + 1
      if !s.patch_applied patch_fail_count = patch_fail_count + 1
      if s.confidence < 60 low_confidence_count = low_confidence_count + 1
      i = i + 1
    end

    let success_rate = (success_count * 100) / total
    let avg_proof = total_proof / total
    let avg_confidence = total_confidence / total
    let lang_unknown_rate = (lang_unknown_count * 100) / total
    let patch_fail_rate = (patch_fail_count * 100) / total
    let low_confidence_rate = (low_confidence_count * 100) / total

    // 약점 목록 생성
    let weaknesses = detect_weaknesses(
      lang_unknown_rate, patch_fail_rate, low_confidence_rate, avg_proof, sessions)

    return PerfReport {
      total_sessions: total,
      success_rate: success_rate,
      avg_proof_score: avg_proof,
      avg_confidence: avg_confidence,
      lang_unknown_rate: lang_unknown_rate,
      patch_fail_rate: patch_fail_rate,
      low_confidence_rate: low_confidence_rate,
      weaknesses: weaknesses,
      generated_at: now_unix()
    }
end

fn detect_weaknesses(lang_unknown_rate: i32, patch_fail_rate: i32,
                     low_confidence_rate: i32, avg_proof: i32,
                     sessions: array) -> array
  intent "임계치 초과 약점들을 WeaknessEntry 배열로 반환"
  do
    let result = []

    // 1. 언어 감지 실패 (>20%)
    if lang_unknown_rate > 20
      let w = WeaknessEntry {
        weakness_type: "unknown_lang",
        target_file: "src/log_parser.fl",
        target_fn: "detect_language",
        frequency: lang_unknown_rate,
        avg_impact: 15,
        sample_case: "CI 로그에서 언어를 감지하지 못함 (" + int_to_str(lang_unknown_rate) + "% 발생)"
      }
      result = arr_push(result, w)
    end

    // 2. 낮은 분석 신뢰도 (>30%)
    if low_confidence_rate > 30
      let w = WeaknessEntry {
        weakness_type: "low_confidence",
        target_file: "src/analyzer.fl",
        target_fn: "analyze_failure",
        frequency: low_confidence_rate,
        avg_impact: 20,
        sample_case: "에러 원인 분석 신뢰도 60% 미만 (" + int_to_str(low_confidence_rate) + "% 발생)"
      }
      result = arr_push(result, w)
    end

    // 3. 패치 적용 실패 (>25%)
    if patch_fail_rate > 25
      let w = WeaknessEntry {
        weakness_type: "patch_fail",
        target_file: "src/patch_engine.fl",
        target_fn: "apply_patch",
        frequency: patch_fail_rate,
        avg_impact: 25,
        sample_case: "unified diff 패치 적용 실패 (" + int_to_str(patch_fail_rate) + "% 발생)"
      }
      result = arr_push(result, w)
    end

    // 4. 낮은 ProofScore 평균 (<60)
    if avg_proof < 60
      let w = WeaknessEntry {
        weakness_type: "low_proof",
        target_file: "src/verifier.fl",
        target_fn: "verify_patch",
        frequency: 100 - avg_proof,
        avg_impact: 60 - avg_proof,
        sample_case: "평균 ProofScore " + int_to_str(avg_proof) + "/100 (기준: 60)"
      }
      result = arr_push(result, w)
    end

    return result
end

// ==================== 세션 로딩 ====================

fn load_recent_sessions(memory_path: string, last_n: i32) -> array
  intent "메모리 파일에서 최근 N개 완성된 세션 로드"
  do
    match file_read(memory_path)
      Err(_) => { return [] }
      Ok(content) => {
        let lines = str_split_lines(content)
        let sessions = []

        // result 이벤트만 파싱해서 SessionStats 재구성
        let i = 0
        while i < arr_len(lines)
          let line = str_trim(arr_get(lines, i))
          if line != ""
            match parse_session_line(line)
              Ok(s) => { sessions = arr_push(sessions, s) }
              Err(_) => {}
            end
          end
          i = i + 1
        end

        // 최근 N개만 반환
        let total = arr_len(sessions)
        if total <= last_n
          return sessions
        end

        let result = []
        let start = total - last_n
        let j = start
        while j < total
          result = arr_push(result, arr_get(sessions, j))
          j = j + 1
        end
        return result
      }
    end
end

fn parse_session_line(line: string) -> Result<SessionStats, string>
  intent "JSON Lines 한 줄 → SessionStats 파싱"
  do
    // event 필드 확인
    if !str_contains(line, "\"event\":\"result\"")
      return Err("not a result event")
    end

    let session_id = json_extract_str(line, "session_id")
    let proof_score = json_extract_int(line, "proof_score")
    let patch_applied = json_extract_bool(line, "patch_applied")
    let auto_merged = json_extract_bool(line, "auto_merged")
    let retries = json_extract_int(line, "retries")
    let timestamp = json_extract_int(line, "timestamp")

    return Ok(SessionStats {
      session_id: session_id,
      timestamp: timestamp,
      repo: "",
      lang: "unknown",
      category: "unknown",
      confidence: 0,
      proof_score: proof_score,
      patch_applied: patch_applied,
      auto_merged: auto_merged,
      retries_used: retries,
      error_type: "unknown"
    })
end

// ==================== 보고서 출력 ====================

fn perf_report_print(report: PerfReport) -> void
  intent "성능 보고서 출력"
  do
    print("=== 자가치유 성능 보고서 ===")
    print("총 세션: " + int_to_str(report.total_sessions))
    print("성공률: " + int_to_str(report.success_rate) + "%")
    print("평균 ProofScore: " + int_to_str(report.avg_proof_score) + "/100")
    print("평균 분석 신뢰도: " + int_to_str(report.avg_confidence) + "%")
    print("")
    print("약점 분석:")
    print("  언어 감지 실패율: " + int_to_str(report.lang_unknown_rate) + "%")
    print("  패치 적용 실패율: " + int_to_str(report.patch_fail_rate) + "%")
    print("  낮은 신뢰도 비율: " + int_to_str(report.low_confidence_rate) + "%")
    print("")

    let wn = arr_len(report.weaknesses)
    if wn == 0
      print("탐지된 약점: 없음 ✅")
    else
      print("탐지된 약점: " + int_to_str(wn) + "개")
      let i = 0
      while i < wn
        let w = arr_get(report.weaknesses, i)
        print("  [" + int_to_str(i+1) + "] " + w.weakness_type +
              " → " + w.target_file + ":" + w.target_fn)
        print("      빈도: " + int_to_str(w.frequency) + "%, 영향: -" + int_to_str(w.avg_impact))
        print("      예시: " + w.sample_case)
        i = i + 1
      end
    end
    print("===========================")
end

fn perf_report_to_json(report: PerfReport) -> string
  intent "PerfReport → JSON 문자열"
  do
    let weaknesses_json = "["
    let i = 0
    while i < arr_len(report.weaknesses)
      if i > 0 weaknesses_json = weaknesses_json + ","
      let w = arr_get(report.weaknesses, i)
      weaknesses_json = weaknesses_json + "{" +
        "\"weakness_type\":\"" + w.weakness_type + "\"," +
        "\"target_file\":\"" + w.target_file + "\"," +
        "\"target_fn\":\"" + w.target_fn + "\"," +
        "\"frequency\":" + int_to_str(w.frequency) + "," +
        "\"avg_impact\":" + int_to_str(w.avg_impact) + "," +
        "\"sample_case\":\"" + json_escape(w.sample_case) + "\"" +
        "}"
      i = i + 1
    end
    weaknesses_json = weaknesses_json + "]"

    return "{" +
      "\"total_sessions\":" + int_to_str(report.total_sessions) + "," +
      "\"success_rate\":" + int_to_str(report.success_rate) + "," +
      "\"avg_proof_score\":" + int_to_str(report.avg_proof_score) + "," +
      "\"avg_confidence\":" + int_to_str(report.avg_confidence) + "," +
      "\"lang_unknown_rate\":" + int_to_str(report.lang_unknown_rate) + "," +
      "\"patch_fail_rate\":" + int_to_str(report.patch_fail_rate) + "," +
      "\"low_confidence_rate\":" + int_to_str(report.low_confidence_rate) + "," +
      "\"weaknesses\":" + weaknesses_json + "," +
      "\"generated_at\":" + int_to_str_i64(report.generated_at) +
      "}"
end

fn empty_perf_report() -> PerfReport
  do
    return PerfReport {
      total_sessions: 0,
      success_rate: 0,
      avg_proof_score: 0,
      avg_confidence: 0,
      lang_unknown_rate: 0,
      patch_fail_rate: 0,
      low_confidence_rate: 0,
      weaknesses: [],
      generated_at: now_unix()
    }
end

fn session_stats_to_json(s: SessionStats) -> string
  do
    let applied_str = "false"
    if s.patch_applied applied_str = "true"
    let merged_str = "false"
    if s.auto_merged merged_str = "true"

    return "{" +
      "\"event\":\"session\"," +
      "\"session_id\":\"" + s.session_id + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str_i64(s.timestamp) + "," +
      "\"repo\":\"" + s.repo + "\"," +
      "\"lang\":\"" + s.lang + "\"," +
      "\"category\":\"" + s.category + "\"," +
      "\"confidence\":" + int_to_str(s.confidence) + "," +
      "\"proof_score\":" + int_to_str(s.proof_score) + "," +
      "\"patch_applied\":" + applied_str + "," +
      "\"auto_merged\":" + merged_str + "," +
      "\"retries_used\":" + int_to_str(s.retries_used) + "," +
      "\"error_type\":\"" + s.error_type + "\"" +
      "}"
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn json_extract_str(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    let end_pos = str_index_of_from(json, "\"", start)
    if end_pos < 0 return ""
    return str_substr(json, start, end_pos)
end

fn json_extract_int(json: string, key: string) -> i32
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return 0
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    // 숫자 끝까지 읽기
    let result = ""
    let i = start
    while i < str_len(json)
      let ch = str_char(json, i)
      if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
         ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
        result = result + ch
      else
        break
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return parse_int_safe(result)
end

fn json_extract_bool(json: string, key: string) -> bool
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return false
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    if start + 4 <= str_len(json)
      let val = str_substr(json, start, start + 4)
      if val == "true" return true
    end
    return false
end

fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\""
        result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\"
        result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n"
        result = result + "\\n"
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn str_contains(s: string, sub: string) -> bool
  do
    return str_index_of_str(s, sub) >= 0
end

fn str_index_of_str(s: string, sub: string) -> i32
  do
    let slen = str_len(s)
    let sublen = str_len(sub)
    if sublen > slen return -1
    let i = 0
    while i <= slen - sublen
      if str_substr(s, i, i + sublen) == sub
        return i
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn str_index_of_from(s: string, ch: string, from: i32) -> i32
  do
    let i = from
    while i < str_len(s)
      if str_char(s, i) == ch return i
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn str_split_lines(s: string) -> array
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\n"
        result = arr_push(result, current)
        current = ""
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    if current != ""
      result = arr_push(result, current)
    end
    return result
end

fn str_trim(s: string) -> string
  do
    let start = 0
    let end_pos = str_len(s)
    while start < end_pos
      let ch = str_char(s, start)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        start = start + 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    while end_pos > start
      let ch = str_char(s, end_pos - 1)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        end_pos = end_pos - 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    return str_substr(s, start, end_pos)
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn int_to_str_i64(n: i64) -> string
  do
    return int_to_str(n as i32)
end

fn parse_int_safe(s: string) -> i32
  do
    if s == "" return 0
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else break
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

// ============================================================
// perf_memory.fl - 성능 메모리 & 약점 탐지 (Phase 5: 특이점)
// heal 세션 누적 → 통계 분석 → 약점 패턴 식별
// ============================================================

struct SessionStats {
  session_id: string,
  timestamp: i64,
  repo: string,
  lang: string,
  category: string,
  confidence: i32,
  proof_score: i32,
  patch_applied: bool,
  auto_merged: bool,
  retries_used: i32,
  error_type: string    // "compile|runtime|logic|unknown"
}

struct WeaknessEntry {
  weakness_type: string,   // "low_confidence|unknown_lang|patch_fail|low_proof"
  target_file: string,     // 수정해야 할 .fl 파일
  target_fn: string,       // 수정해야 할 함수
  frequency: i32,          // 발생 횟수
  avg_impact: i32,         // 평균 ProofScore 손실
  sample_case: string      // 대표 예시
}

struct PerfReport {
  total_sessions: i32,
  success_rate: i32,       // 0-100%
  avg_proof_score: i32,
  avg_confidence: i32,
  lang_unknown_rate: i32,  // lang==unknown 비율 %
  patch_fail_rate: i32,    // 패치 실패 비율 %
  low_confidence_rate: i32,// confidence<60% 비율 %
  weaknesses: array,       // WeaknessEntry[]
  generated_at: i64
}

// ==================== 메모리 기록 ====================

fn memory_record_session(stats: SessionStats, memory_path: string) -> void
  intent "heal 세션 결과를 JSON Lines 파일에 누적 기록"
  do
    let line = session_stats_to_json(stats) + "\n"
    append_to_file(memory_path, line)
end

fn memory_record_start(session_id: string, repo: string, memory_path: string) -> void
  intent "세션 시작 기록"
  do
    let stats = SessionStats {
      session_id: session_id,
      timestamp: now_unix(),
      repo: repo,
      lang: "unknown",
      category: "unknown",
      confidence: 0,
      proof_score: 0,
      patch_applied: false,
      auto_merged: false,
      retries_used: 0,
      error_type: "unknown"
    }
    memory_record_session(stats, memory_path)
end

fn memory_record_analysis(session_id: string, lang: string, category: string,
                           confidence: i32, error_type: string, memory_path: string) -> void
  intent "분석 단계 결과 업데이트"
  do
    // 간단히 새 라인으로 추가 (나중에 병합)
    let line = "{\"event\":\"analysis\",\"session_id\":\"" + session_id +
               "\",\"lang\":\"" + lang +
               "\",\"category\":\"" + category +
               "\",\"confidence\":" + int_to_str(confidence) +
               ",\"error_type\":\"" + error_type +
               "\",\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix()) + "}\n"
    append_to_file(memory_path, line)
end

fn memory_record_result(session_id: string, proof_score: i32, patch_applied: bool,
                        auto_merged: bool, retries: i32, memory_path: string) -> void
  intent "최종 결과 기록"
  do
    let applied_str = "false"
    if patch_applied applied_str = "true"
    let merged_str = "false"
    if auto_merged merged_str = "true"

    let line = "{\"event\":\"result\",\"session_id\":\"" + session_id +
               "\",\"proof_score\":" + int_to_str(proof_score) +
               ",\"patch_applied\":" + applied_str +
               ",\"auto_merged\":" + merged_str +
               ",\"retries\":" + int_to_str(retries) +
               ",\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix()) + "}\n"
    append_to_file(memory_path, line)
end

// ==================== 성능 분석 ====================

fn perf_analyze(memory_path: string, last_n: i32) -> PerfReport
  intent "최근 N개 세션에서 약점 탐지 및 성능 보고서 생성"
  do
    let sessions = load_recent_sessions(memory_path, last_n)
    let total = arr_len(sessions)

    if total == 0
      return empty_perf_report()
    end

    // 통계 집계
    let success_count = 0
    let total_proof = 0
    let total_confidence = 0
    let lang_unknown_count = 0
    let patch_fail_count = 0
    let low_confidence_count = 0

    let i = 0
    while i < total
      let s = arr_get(sessions, i)
      if s.auto_merged success_count = success_count + 1
      total_proof = total_proof + s.proof_score
      total_confidence = total_confidence + s.confidence
      if s.lang == "unknown" lang_unknown_count = lang_unknown_count + 1
      if !s.patch_applied patch_fail_count = patch_fail_count + 1
      if s.confidence < 60 low_confidence_count = low_confidence_count + 1
      i = i + 1
    end

    let success_rate = (success_count * 100) / total
    let avg_proof = total_proof / total
    let avg_confidence = total_confidence / total
    let lang_unknown_rate = (lang_unknown_count * 100) / total
    let patch_fail_rate = (patch_fail_count * 100) / total
    let low_confidence_rate = (low_confidence_count * 100) / total

    // 약점 목록 생성
    let weaknesses = detect_weaknesses(
      lang_unknown_rate, patch_fail_rate, low_confidence_rate, avg_proof, sessions)

    return PerfReport {
      total_sessions: total,
      success_rate: success_rate,
      avg_proof_score: avg_proof,
      avg_confidence: avg_confidence,
      lang_unknown_rate: lang_unknown_rate,
      patch_fail_rate: patch_fail_rate,
      low_confidence_rate: low_confidence_rate,
      weaknesses: weaknesses,
      generated_at: now_unix()
    }
end

fn detect_weaknesses(lang_unknown_rate: i32, patch_fail_rate: i32,
                     low_confidence_rate: i32, avg_proof: i32,
                     sessions: array) -> array
  intent "임계치 초과 약점들을 WeaknessEntry 배열로 반환"
  do
    let result = []

    // 1. 언어 감지 실패 (>20%)
    if lang_unknown_rate > 20
      let w = WeaknessEntry {
        weakness_type: "unknown_lang",
        target_file: "src/log_parser.fl",
        target_fn: "detect_language",
        frequency: lang_unknown_rate,
        avg_impact: 15,
        sample_case: "CI 로그에서 언어를 감지하지 못함 (" + int_to_str(lang_unknown_rate) + "% 발생)"
      }
      result = arr_push(result, w)
    end

    // 2. 낮은 분석 신뢰도 (>30%)
    if low_confidence_rate > 30
      let w = WeaknessEntry {
        weakness_type: "low_confidence",
        target_file: "src/analyzer.fl",
        target_fn: "analyze_failure",
        frequency: low_confidence_rate,
        avg_impact: 20,
        sample_case: "에러 원인 분석 신뢰도 60% 미만 (" + int_to_str(low_confidence_rate) + "% 발생)"
      }
      result = arr_push(result, w)
    end

    // 3. 패치 적용 실패 (>25%)
    if patch_fail_rate > 25
      let w = WeaknessEntry {
        weakness_type: "patch_fail",
        target_file: "src/patch_engine.fl",
        target_fn: "apply_patch",
        frequency: patch_fail_rate,
        avg_impact: 25,
        sample_case: "unified diff 패치 적용 실패 (" + int_to_str(patch_fail_rate) + "% 발생)"
      }
      result = arr_push(result, w)
    end

    // 4. 낮은 ProofScore 평균 (<60)
    if avg_proof < 60
      let w = WeaknessEntry {
        weakness_type: "low_proof",
        target_file: "src/verifier.fl",
        target_fn: "verify_patch",
        frequency: 100 - avg_proof,
        avg_impact: 60 - avg_proof,
        sample_case: "평균 ProofScore " + int_to_str(avg_proof) + "/100 (기준: 60)"
      }
      result = arr_push(result, w)
    end

    return result
end

// ==================== 세션 로딩 ====================

fn load_recent_sessions(memory_path: string, last_n: i32) -> array
  intent "메모리 파일에서 최근 N개 완성된 세션 로드"
  do
    match file_read(memory_path)
      Err(_) => { return [] }
      Ok(content) => {
        let lines = str_split_lines(content)
        let sessions = []

        // result 이벤트만 파싱해서 SessionStats 재구성
        let i = 0
        while i < arr_len(lines)
          let line = str_trim(arr_get(lines, i))
          if line != ""
            match parse_session_line(line)
              Ok(s) => { sessions = arr_push(sessions, s) }
              Err(_) => {}
            end
          end
          i = i + 1
        end

        // 최근 N개만 반환
        let total = arr_len(sessions)
        if total <= last_n
          return sessions
        end

        let result = []
        let start = total - last_n
        let j = start
        while j < total
          result = arr_push(result, arr_get(sessions, j))
          j = j + 1
        end
        return result
      }
    end
end

fn parse_session_line(line: string) -> Result<SessionStats, string>
  intent "JSON Lines 한 줄 → SessionStats 파싱"
  do
    // event 필드 확인
    if !str_contains(line, "\"event\":\"result\"")
      return Err("not a result event")
    end

    let session_id = json_extract_str(line, "session_id")
    let proof_score = json_extract_int(line, "proof_score")
    let patch_applied = json_extract_bool(line, "patch_applied")
    let auto_merged = json_extract_bool(line, "auto_merged")
    let retries = json_extract_int(line, "retries")
    let timestamp = json_extract_int(line, "timestamp")

    return Ok(SessionStats {
      session_id: session_id,
      timestamp: timestamp,
      repo: "",
      lang: "unknown",
      category: "unknown",
      confidence: 0,
      proof_score: proof_score,
      patch_applied: patch_applied,
      auto_merged: auto_merged,
      retries_used: retries,
      error_type: "unknown"
    })
end

// ==================== 보고서 출력 ====================

fn perf_report_print(report: PerfReport) -> void
  intent "성능 보고서 출력"
  do
    print("=== 자가치유 성능 보고서 ===")
    print("총 세션: " + int_to_str(report.total_sessions))
    print("성공률: " + int_to_str(report.success_rate) + "%")
    print("평균 ProofScore: " + int_to_str(report.avg_proof_score) + "/100")
    print("평균 분석 신뢰도: " + int_to_str(report.avg_confidence) + "%")
    print("")
    print("약점 분석:")
    print("  언어 감지 실패율: " + int_to_str(report.lang_unknown_rate) + "%")
    print("  패치 적용 실패율: " + int_to_str(report.patch_fail_rate) + "%")
    print("  낮은 신뢰도 비율: " + int_to_str(report.low_confidence_rate) + "%")
    print("")

    let wn = arr_len(report.weaknesses)
    if wn == 0
      print("탐지된 약점: 없음 ✅")
    else
      print("탐지된 약점: " + int_to_str(wn) + "개")
      let i = 0
      while i < wn
        let w = arr_get(report.weaknesses, i)
        print("  [" + int_to_str(i+1) + "] " + w.weakness_type +
              " → " + w.target_file + ":" + w.target_fn)
        print("      빈도: " + int_to_str(w.frequency) + "%, 영향: -" + int_to_str(w.avg_impact))
        print("      예시: " + w.sample_case)
        i = i + 1
      end
    end
    print("===========================")
end

fn perf_report_to_json(report: PerfReport) -> string
  intent "PerfReport → JSON 문자열"
  do
    let weaknesses_json = "["
    let i = 0
    while i < arr_len(report.weaknesses)
      if i > 0 weaknesses_json = weaknesses_json + ","
      let w = arr_get(report.weaknesses, i)
      weaknesses_json = weaknesses_json + "{" +
        "\"weakness_type\":\"" + w.weakness_type + "\"," +
        "\"target_file\":\"" + w.target_file + "\"," +
        "\"target_fn\":\"" + w.target_fn + "\"," +
        "\"frequency\":" + int_to_str(w.frequency) + "," +
        "\"avg_impact\":" + int_to_str(w.avg_impact) + "," +
        "\"sample_case\":\"" + json_escape(w.sample_case) + "\"" +
        "}"
      i = i + 1
    end
    weaknesses_json = weaknesses_json + "]"

    return "{" +
      "\"total_sessions\":" + int_to_str(report.total_sessions) + "," +
      "\"success_rate\":" + int_to_str(report.success_rate) + "," +
      "\"avg_proof_score\":" + int_to_str(report.avg_proof_score) + "," +
      "\"avg_confidence\":" + int_to_str(report.avg_confidence) + "," +
      "\"lang_unknown_rate\":" + int_to_str(report.lang_unknown_rate) + "," +
      "\"patch_fail_rate\":" + int_to_str(report.patch_fail_rate) + "," +
      "\"low_confidence_rate\":" + int_to_str(report.low_confidence_rate) + "," +
      "\"weaknesses\":" + weaknesses_json + "," +
      "\"generated_at\":" + int_to_str_i64(report.generated_at) +
      "}"
end

fn empty_perf_report() -> PerfReport
  do
    return PerfReport {
      total_sessions: 0,
      success_rate: 0,
      avg_proof_score: 0,
      avg_confidence: 0,
      lang_unknown_rate: 0,
      patch_fail_rate: 0,
      low_confidence_rate: 0,
      weaknesses: [],
      generated_at: now_unix()
    }
end

fn session_stats_to_json(s: SessionStats) -> string
  do
    let applied_str = "false"
    if s.patch_applied applied_str = "true"
    let merged_str = "false"
    if s.auto_merged merged_str = "true"

    return "{" +
      "\"event\":\"session\"," +
      "\"session_id\":\"" + s.session_id + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str_i64(s.timestamp) + "," +
      "\"repo\":\"" + s.repo + "\"," +
      "\"lang\":\"" + s.lang + "\"," +
      "\"category\":\"" + s.category + "\"," +
      "\"confidence\":" + int_to_str(s.confidence) + "," +
      "\"proof_score\":" + int_to_str(s.proof_score) + "," +
      "\"patch_applied\":" + applied_str + "," +
      "\"auto_merged\":" + merged_str + "," +
      "\"retries_used\":" + int_to_str(s.retries_used) + "," +
      "\"error_type\":\"" + s.error_type + "\"" +
      "}"
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn json_extract_str(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    let end_pos = str_index_of_from(json, "\"", start)
    if end_pos < 0 return ""
    return str_substr(json, start, end_pos)
end

fn json_extract_int(json: string, key: string) -> i32
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return 0
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    // 숫자 끝까지 읽기
    let result = ""
    let i = start
    while i < str_len(json)
      let ch = str_char(json, i)
      if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
         ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
        result = result + ch
      else
        break
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return parse_int_safe(result)
end

fn json_extract_bool(json: string, key: string) -> bool
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return false
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    if start + 4 <= str_len(json)
      let val = str_substr(json, start, start + 4)
      if val == "true" return true
    end
    return false
end

fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\""
        result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\"
        result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n"
        result = result + "\\n"
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn str_contains(s: string, sub: string) -> bool
  do
    return str_index_of_str(s, sub) >= 0
end

fn str_index_of_str(s: string, sub: string) -> i32
  do
    let slen = str_len(s)
    let sublen = str_len(sub)
    if sublen > slen return -1
    let i = 0
    while i <= slen - sublen
      if str_substr(s, i, i + sublen) == sub
        return i
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn str_index_of_from(s: string, ch: string, from: i32) -> i32
  do
    let i = from
    while i < str_len(s)
      if str_char(s, i) == ch return i
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn str_split_lines(s: string) -> array
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\n"
        result = arr_push(result, current)
        current = ""
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    if current != ""
      result = arr_push(result, current)
    end
    return result
end

fn str_trim(s: string) -> string
  do
    let start = 0
    let end_pos = str_len(s)
    while start < end_pos
      let ch = str_char(s, start)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        start = start + 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    while end_pos > start
      let ch = str_char(s, end_pos - 1)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        end_pos = end_pos - 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    return str_substr(s, start, end_pos)
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn int_to_str_i64(n: i64) -> string
  do
    return int_to_str(n as i32)
end

fn parse_int_safe(s: string) -> i32
  do
    if s == "" return 0
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else break
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

// ============================================================
// evolution_engine.fl - 진화 엔진 (Phase 5: 특이점)
// 약점 분석 → Claude에게 소스 개선 요청 → diff 생성
// ============================================================

struct EvolutionRequest {
  weakness: WeaknessEntry,
  source_code: string,      // 개선할 파일의 현재 소스
  recent_failures: string,  // 최근 실패 사례 요약
  self_repo: string,        // 자기 저장소 이름
  base_dir: string          // 소스 파일 기본 경로
}

struct EvolutionResult {
  success: bool,
  weakness_type: string,
  target_file: string,
  original_code: string,
  improved_code: string,
  diff: string,
  explanation: string,
  expected_improvement: i32,   // 예상 ProofScore 향상 폭
  claude_confidence: i32
}

struct EvolutionHistory {
  evolution_id: string,
  timestamp: i64,
  weakness_type: string,
  target_file: string,
  result: string,           // "success|fail|rollback"
  proof_before: i32,
  proof_after: i32,
  version_tag: string
}

// ==================== 진화 엔진 메인 ====================

fn evolution_run(req: EvolutionRequest, api_key: string) -> EvolutionResult
  intent "약점 파일을 Claude에게 개선 요청하고 diff를 반환"
  do
    print("[Evolution] 진화 시작: " + req.weakness.weakness_type +
          " → " + req.weakness.target_file)

    // 소스 코드 읽기
    let src_path = req.base_dir + "/" + req.weakness.target_file
    let source = req.source_code
    if source == ""
      match file_read(src_path)
        Err(e) => {
          print("[Evolution] 소스 읽기 실패: " + e)
          return evolution_fail(req.weakness, "소스 파일 없음: " + e)
        }
        Ok(content) => {
          source = content
        }
      end
    end

    // Claude에게 개선 요청
    let improved = ask_claude_to_improve(
      req.weakness, source, req.recent_failures, api_key)

    if !improved.success
      return improved
    end

    // diff 생성
    let diff = generate_diff(
      req.weakness.target_file, source, improved.improved_code)

    improved.diff = diff
    return improved
end

fn ask_claude_to_improve(weakness: WeaknessEntry, source_code: string,
                          recent_failures: string, api_key: string) -> EvolutionResult
  intent "Claude API에 소스 개선 요청"
  do
    let prompt = build_evolution_prompt(weakness, source_code, recent_failures)

    let req_body = "{\"model\":\"claude-sonnet-4-6\"," +
      "\"max_tokens\":4096," +
      "\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\"," +
      "\"content\":" + json_str_encode(prompt) + "}]}"

fn extract_api_content(resp_text: string) -> string
  do
    // {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"..."}],...}
    let search = "\"text\":\""
    let pos = str_index_of_str(resp_text, search)
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    // JSON 문자열 끝 찾기 (이스케이프 처리)
    let result = ""
    let i = start
    while i < str_len(resp_text)
      let ch = str_char(resp_text, i)
      if ch == "\\"
        i = i + 1
        if i < str_len(resp_text)
          let next = str_char(resp_text, i)
          if next == "n" result = result + "\n"
          else if next == "t" result = result + "\t"
          else if next == "\"" result = result + "\""
          else if next == "\\" result = result + "\\"
          else result = result + next
        end
      else if ch == "\""
        break
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn extract_json_block(text: string) -> string
  do
    // ```json ... ``` 또는 ``` ... ``` 블록 추출
    let start_marker = "```json"
    let start = str_index_of_str(text, start_marker)
    if start < 0
      start_marker = "```"
      start = str_index_of_str(text, start_marker)
    end
    if start < 0
      // 직접 JSON 찾기
      let brace = str_index_of_str(text, "{")
      if brace >= 0 return str_substr(text, brace, str_len(text))
      return ""
    end
    let content_start = start + str_len(start_marker)
    // 첫 줄 건너뛰기 (```json 다음 줄부터)
    let nl = str_index_of_from(text, "\n", content_start)
    if nl >= 0 content_start = nl + 1
    // 끝 마커 찾기
    let end_marker = str_index_of_from(text, "```", content_start)
    if end_marker < 0 return str_substr(text, content_start, str_len(text))
    return str_substr(text, content_start, end_marker)
end

fn json_extract_str_long(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    // 긴 문자열 값 추출 (이스케이프 처리)
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    let result = ""
    let i = start
    while i < str_len(json)
      let ch = str_char(json, i)
      if ch == "\\"
        i = i + 1
        if i < str_len(json)
          let next = str_char(json, i)
          if next == "n" result = result + "\n"
          else if next == "t" result = result + "\t"
          else if next == "\"" result = result + "\""
          else if next == "\\" result = result + "\\"
          else result = result + next
        end
      else if ch == "\""
        break
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn json_extract_int_from(json: string, key: string) -> i32
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return 0
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    let result = ""
    let i = start
    while i < str_len(json)
      let ch = str_char(json, i)
      if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
         ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
        result = result + ch
      else
        break
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return parse_int_safe(result)
end

fn json_str_encode(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = "\""
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else if ch == "\r" result = result + "\\r"
      else if ch == "\t" result = result + "\\t"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    result = result + "\""
    return result
end

fn json_extract_str(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    let end_pos = str_index_of_from(json, "\"", start)
    if end_pos < 0 return ""
    return str_substr(json, start, end_pos)
end

fn str_split_lines(s: string) -> array
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\n"
        result = arr_push(result, current)
        current = ""
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    if current != "" result = arr_push(result, current)
    return result
end

fn str_trim(s: string) -> string
  do
    let start = 0
    let end_pos = str_len(s)
    while start < end_pos
      let ch = str_char(s, start)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        start = start + 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    while end_pos > start
      let ch = str_char(s, end_pos - 1)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        end_pos = end_pos - 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    return str_substr(s, start, end_pos)
end

fn str_index_of_str(s: string, sub: string) -> i32
  do
    let slen = str_len(s)
    let sublen = str_len(sub)
    if sublen > slen return -1
    let i = 0
    while i <= slen - sublen
      if str_substr(s, i, i + sublen) == sub return i
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn str_index_of_from(s: string, ch: string, from: i32) -> i32
  do
    let i = from
    while i < str_len(s)
      if str_char(s, i) == ch return i
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn int_to_str_i64(n: i64) -> string
  do
    return int_to_str(n as i32)
end

fn parse_int_safe(s: string) -> i32
  do
    if s == "" return 0
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else break
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

         orig_path + " " + impr_path + " > " + diff_path + " 2>/dev/null || true")

    let diff_content = ""
    match file_read(diff_path)
      Ok(content) => { diff_content = content }
      Err(_) => {}
    end

    exec("rm -f " + orig_path + " " + impr_path + " " + diff_path)
    return diff_content
end

// ==================== 진화 히스토리 ====================

fn evolution_record(history: EvolutionHistory, log_path: string) -> void
  intent "진화 결과를 히스토리 파일에 기록"
  do
    let line = "{" +
      "\"evolution_id\":\"" + history.evolution_id + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str_i64(history.timestamp) + "," +
      "\"weakness_type\":\"" + history.weakness_type + "\"," +
      "\"target_file\":\"" + history.target_file + "\"," +
      "\"result\":\"" + history.result + "\"," +
      "\"proof_before\":" + int_to_str(history.proof_before) + "," +
      "\"proof_after\":" + int_to_str(history.proof_after) + "," +
      "\"version_tag\":\"" + history.version_tag + "\"" +
      "}\n"
    append_to_file(log_path, line)
    print("[Evolution] 히스토리 기록: " + history.evolution_id +
          " (" + history.result + ")")
end

fn evolution_load_history(log_path: string) -> array
  intent "진화 히스토리 전체 로드"
  do
    match file_read(log_path)
      Err(_) => { return [] }
      Ok(content) => {
        let lines = str_split_lines(content)
        let result = []
        let i = 0
        while i < arr_len(lines)
          let line = str_trim(arr_get(lines, i))
          if line != ""
            result = arr_push(result, line)
          end
          i = i + 1
        end
        return result
      }
    end
end

fn evolution_print_history(log_path: string) -> void
  intent "진화 히스토리 요약 출력"
  do
    let lines = evolution_load_history(log_path)
    let total = arr_len(lines)
    print("=== 진화 히스토리 (" + int_to_str(total) + "건) ===")
    let i = 0
    while i < total
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
      let eid = json_extract_str(line, "evolution_id")
      let result = json_extract_str(line, "result")
      let wtype = json_extract_str(line, "weakness_type")
      let before = json_extract_int_from(line, "proof_before")
      let after = json_extract_int_from(line, "proof_after")
      let tag = json_extract_str(line, "version_tag")

      let icon = "⚠️"
      if result == "success" icon = "✅"
      if result == "rollback" icon = "⏪"

      print(icon + " [" + tag + "] " + wtype + " → " +
            int_to_str(before) + " → " + int_to_str(after) +
            " (evolution_id: " + eid + ")")
      i = i + 1
    end
    print("==========================")
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn evolution_fail(weakness: WeaknessEntry, reason: string) -> EvolutionResult
  do
    print("[Evolution] 실패: " + reason)
    return EvolutionResult {
      success: false,
      weakness_type: weakness.weakness_type,
      target_file: weakness.target_file,
      original_code: "",
      improved_code: "",
      diff: "",
      explanation: reason,
      expected_improvement: 0,
      claude_confidence: 0
    }
end

fn extract_api_content(resp_text: string) -> string
  do
    // {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"..."}],...}
    let search = "\"text\":\""
    let pos = str_index_of_str(resp_text, search)
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    // JSON 문자열 끝 찾기 (이스케이프 처리)
    let result = ""
    let i = start
    while i < str_len(resp_text)
      let ch = str_char(resp_text, i)
      if ch == "\\"
        i = i + 1
        if i < str_len(resp_text)
          let next = str_char(resp_text, i)
          if next == "n" result = result + "\n"
          else if next == "t" result = result + "\t"
          else if next == "\"" result = result + "\""
          else if next == "\\" result = result + "\\"
          else result = result + next
        end
      else if ch == "\""
        break
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn extract_json_block(text: string) -> string
  do
    // ```json ... ``` 또는 ``` ... ``` 블록 추출
    let start_marker = "```json"
    let start = str_index_of_str(text, start_marker)
    if start < 0
      start_marker = "```"
      start = str_index_of_str(text, start_marker)
    end
    if start < 0
      // 직접 JSON 찾기
      let brace = str_index_of_str(text, "{")
      if brace >= 0 return str_substr(text, brace, str_len(text))
      return ""
    end
    let content_start = start + str_len(start_marker)
    // 첫 줄 건너뛰기 (```json 다음 줄부터)
    let nl = str_index_of_from(text, "\n", content_start)
    if nl >= 0 content_start = nl + 1
    // 끝 마커 찾기
    let end_marker = str_index_of_from(text, "```", content_start)
    if end_marker < 0 return str_substr(text, content_start, str_len(text))
    return str_substr(text, content_start, end_marker)
end

fn json_extract_str_long(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    // 긴 문자열 값 추출 (이스케이프 처리)
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    let result = ""
    let i = start
    while i < str_len(json)
      let ch = str_char(json, i)
      if ch == "\\"
        i = i + 1
        if i < str_len(json)
          let next = str_char(json, i)
          if next == "n" result = result + "\n"
          else if next == "t" result = result + "\t"
          else if next == "\"" result = result + "\""
          else if next == "\\" result = result + "\\"
          else result = result + next
        end
      else if ch == "\""
        break
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn json_extract_int_from(json: string, key: string) -> i32
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return 0
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    let result = ""
    let i = start
    while i < str_len(json)
      let ch = str_char(json, i)
      if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
         ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
        result = result + ch
      else
        break
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return parse_int_safe(result)
end

fn json_str_encode(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = "\""
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else if ch == "\r" result = result + "\\r"
      else if ch == "\t" result = result + "\\t"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    result = result + "\""
    return result
end

fn json_extract_str(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    let end_pos = str_index_of_from(json, "\"", start)
    if end_pos < 0 return ""
    return str_substr(json, start, end_pos)
end

fn str_split_lines(s: string) -> array
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\n"
        result = arr_push(result, current)
        current = ""
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    if current != "" result = arr_push(result, current)
    return result
end

fn str_trim(s: string) -> string
  do
    let start = 0
    let end_pos = str_len(s)
    while start < end_pos
      let ch = str_char(s, start)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        start = start + 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    while end_pos > start
      let ch = str_char(s, end_pos - 1)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        end_pos = end_pos - 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    return str_substr(s, start, end_pos)
end

fn str_index_of_str(s: string, sub: string) -> i32
  do
    let slen = str_len(s)
    let sublen = str_len(sub)
    if sublen > slen return -1
    let i = 0
    while i <= slen - sublen
      if str_substr(s, i, i + sublen) == sub return i
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn str_index_of_from(s: string, ch: string, from: i32) -> i32
  do
    let i = from
    while i < str_len(s)
      if str_char(s, i) == ch return i
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn int_to_str_i64(n: i64) -> string
  do
    return int_to_str(n as i32)
end

fn parse_int_safe(s: string) -> i32
  do
    if s == "" return 0
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else break
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end
