1→// ============================================================
     2→// perf_memory.fl - 성능 메모리 & 약점 탐지 (Phase 5: 특이점)
     3→// heal 세션 누적 → 통계 분석 → 약점 패턴 식별
     4→// ============================================================
     5→
     6→struct SessionStats {
     7→  session_id: string,
     8→  timestamp: i64,
     9→  repo: string,
    10→  lang: string,
    11→  category: string,
    12→  confidence: i32,
    13→  proof_score: i32,
    14→  patch_applied: bool,
    15→  auto_merged: bool,
    16→  retries_used: i32,
    17→  error_type: string    // "compile|runtime|logic|unknown"
    18→}
    19→
    20→struct WeaknessEntry {
    21→  weakness_type: string,   // "low_confidence|unknown_lang|patch_fail|low_proof"
    22→  target_file: string,     // 수정해야 할 .fl 파일
    23→  target_fn: string,       // 수정해야 할 함수
    24→  frequency: i32,          // 발생 횟수
    25→  avg_impact: i32,         // 평균 ProofScore 손실
    26→  sample_case: string      // 대표 예시
    27→}
    28→
    29→struct PerfReport {
    30→  total_sessions: i32,
    31→  success_rate: i32,       // 0-100%
    32→  avg_proof_score: i32,
    33→  avg_confidence: i32,
    34→  lang_unknown_rate: i32,  // lang==unknown 비율 %
    35→  patch_fail_rate: i32,    // 패치 실패 비율 %
    36→  low_confidence_rate: i32,// confidence<60% 비율 %
    37→  weaknesses: array,       // WeaknessEntry[]
    38→  generated_at: i64
    39→}
    40→
    41→// ==================== 메모리 기록 ====================
    42→
    43→fn memory_record_session(stats: SessionStats, memory_path: string) -> void
    44→  intent "heal 세션 결과를 JSON Lines 파일에 누적 기록"
    45→  do
    46→    let line = session_stats_to_json(stats) + "\n"
    47→    append_to_file(memory_path, line)
    48→end
    49→
    50→fn memory_record_start(session_id: string, repo: string, memory_path: string) -> void
    51→  intent "세션 시작 기록"
    52→  do
    53→    let stats = SessionStats {
    54→      session_id: session_id,
    55→      timestamp: now_unix(),
    56→      repo: repo,
    57→      lang: "unknown",
    58→      category: "unknown",
    59→      confidence: 0,
    60→      proof_score: 0,
    61→      patch_applied: false,
    62→      auto_merged: false,
    63→      retries_used: 0,
    64→      error_type: "unknown"
    65→    }
    66→    memory_record_session(stats, memory_path)
    67→end
    68→
    69→fn memory_record_analysis(session_id: string, lang: string, category: string,
    70→                           confidence: i32, error_type: string, memory_path: string) -> void
    71→  intent "분석 단계 결과 업데이트"
    72→  do
    73→    // 간단히 새 라인으로 추가 (나중에 병합)
    74→    let line = "{\"event\":\"analysis\",\"session_id\":\"" + session_id +
    75→               "\",\"lang\":\"" + lang +
    76→               "\",\"category\":\"" + category +
    77→               "\",\"confidence\":" + int_to_str(confidence) +
    78→               ",\"error_type\":\"" + error_type +
    79→               "\",\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix()) + "}\n"
    80→    append_to_file(memory_path, line)
    81→end
    82→
    83→fn memory_record_result(session_id: string, proof_score: i32, patch_applied: bool,
    84→                        auto_merged: bool, retries: i32, memory_path: string) -> void
    85→  intent "최종 결과 기록"
    86→  do
    87→    let applied_str = "false"
    88→    if patch_applied applied_str = "true"
    89→    let merged_str = "false"
    90→    if auto_merged merged_str = "true"
    91→
    92→    let line = "{\"event\":\"result\",\"session_id\":\"" + session_id +
    93→               "\",\"proof_score\":" + int_to_str(proof_score) +
    94→               ",\"patch_applied\":" + applied_str +
    95→               ",\"auto_merged\":" + merged_str +
    96→               ",\"retries\":" + int_to_str(retries) +
    97→               ",\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix()) + "}\n"
    98→    append_to_file(memory_path, line)
    99→end
   100→
   101→// ==================== 성능 분석 ====================
   102→
   103→fn perf_analyze(memory_path: string, last_n: i32) -> PerfReport
   104→  intent "최근 N개 세션에서 약점 탐지 및 성능 보고서 생성"
   105→  do
   106→    let sessions = load_recent_sessions(memory_path, last_n)
   107→    let total = arr_len(sessions)
   108→
   109→    if total == 0
   110→      return empty_perf_report()
   111→    end
   112→
   113→    // 통계 집계
   114→    let success_count = 0
   115→    let total_proof = 0
   116→    let total_confidence = 0
   117→    let lang_unknown_count = 0
   118→    let patch_fail_count = 0
   119→    let low_confidence_count = 0
   120→
   121→    let i = 0
   122→    while i < total
   123→      let s = arr_get(sessions, i)
   124→      if s.auto_merged success_count = success_count + 1
   125→      total_proof = total_proof + s.proof_score
   126→      total_confidence = total_confidence + s.confidence
   127→      if s.lang == "unknown" lang_unknown_count = lang_unknown_count + 1
   128→      if !s.patch_applied patch_fail_count = patch_fail_count + 1
   129→      if s.confidence < 60 low_confidence_count = low_confidence_count + 1
   130→      i = i + 1
   131→    end
   132→
   133→    let success_rate = (success_count * 100) / total
   134→    let avg_proof = total_proof / total
   135→    let avg_confidence = total_confidence / total
   136→    let lang_unknown_rate = (lang_unknown_count * 100) / total
   137→    let patch_fail_rate = (patch_fail_count * 100) / total
   138→    let low_confidence_rate = (low_confidence_count * 100) / total
   139→
   140→    // 약점 목록 생성
   141→    let weaknesses = detect_weaknesses(
   142→      lang_unknown_rate, patch_fail_rate, low_confidence_rate, avg_proof, sessions)
   143→
   144→    return PerfReport {
   145→      total_sessions: total,
   146→      success_rate: success_rate,
   147→      avg_proof_score: avg_proof,
   148→      avg_confidence: avg_confidence,
   149→      lang_unknown_rate: lang_unknown_rate,
   150→      patch_fail_rate: patch_fail_rate,
   151→      low_confidence_rate: low_confidence_rate,
   152→      weaknesses: weaknesses,
   153→      generated_at: now_unix()
   154→    }
   155→end
   156→
   157→fn detect_weaknesses(lang_unknown_rate: i32, patch_fail_rate: i32,
   158→                     low_confidence_rate: i32, avg_proof: i32,
   159→                     sessions: array) -> array
   160→  intent "임계치 초과 약점들을 WeaknessEntry 배열로 반환"
   161→  do
   162→    let result = []
   163→
   164→    // 1. 언어 감지 실패 (>20%)
   165→    if lang_unknown_rate > 20
   166→      let w = WeaknessEntry {
   167→        weakness_type: "unknown_lang",
   168→        target_file: "src/log_parser.fl",
   169→        target_fn: "detect_language",
   170→        frequency: lang_unknown_rate,
   171→        avg_impact: 15,
   172→        sample_case: "CI 로그에서 언어를 감지하지 못함 (" + int_to_str(lang_unknown_rate) + "% 발생)"
   173→      }
   174→      result = arr_push(result, w)
   175→    end
   176→
   177→    // 2. 낮은 분석 신뢰도 (>30%)
   178→    if low_confidence_rate > 30
   179→      let w = WeaknessEntry {
   180→        weakness_type: "low_confidence",
   181→        target_file: "src/analyzer.fl",
   182→        target_fn: "analyze_failure",
   183→        frequency: low_confidence_rate,
   184→        avg_impact: 20,
   185→        sample_case: "에러 원인 분석 신뢰도 60% 미만 (" + int_to_str(low_confidence_rate) + "% 발생)"
   186→      }
   187→      result = arr_push(result, w)
   188→    end
   189→
   190→    // 3. 패치 적용 실패 (>25%)
   191→    if patch_fail_rate > 25
   192→      let w = WeaknessEntry {
   193→        weakness_type: "patch_fail",
   194→        target_file: "src/patch_engine.fl",
   195→        target_fn: "apply_patch",

   399→fn json_extract_str(json: string, key: string) -> string
   400→  do
   401→    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
   402→    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
   403→    if pos < 0 return ""
   404→    let start = pos + str_len(search)
   405→    let end_pos = str_index_of_from(json, "\"", start)
   406→    if end_pos < 0 return ""
   407→    return str_substr(json, start, end_pos)
   408→end

   410→fn json_extract_int(json: string, key: string) -> i32
   411→  do
   412→    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
   413→    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
   414→    if pos < 0 return 0
   415→    let start = pos + str_len(search)
   416→    // 숫자 끝까지 읽기
   417→    let result = ""
   418→    let i = start
   419→    while i < str_len(json)
   420→      let ch = str_char(json, i)
   421→      if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
   422→         ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
   423→        result = result + ch
   424→      else
   425→        break
   426→      end
   427→      i = i + 1
   428→    end
   429→    return parse_int_safe(result)
   430→end

   432→fn json_extract_bool(json: string, key: string) -> bool
   433→  do
   434→    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
   435→    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
   436→    if pos < 0 return false
   437→    let start = pos + str_len(search)
   438→    if start + 4 <= str_len(json)
   439→      let val = str_substr(json, start, start + 4)
   440→      if val == "true" return true
   441→    end
   442→    return false
   443→end

   445→fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
   446→  do
   447→    let result = ""
   448→    let i = 0
   449→    while i < str_len(s)
   450→      let ch = str_char(s, i)
   451→      if ch == "\""
   452→        result = result + "\\\""
   453→      else if ch == "\\"
   454→        result = result + "\\\\"
   455→      else if ch == "\n"
   456→        result = result + "\\n"
   457→      else
   458→        result = result + ch
   459→      end
   460→      i = i + 1
   461→    end
   462→    return result
   463→end

   470→fn str_index_of_str(s: string, sub: string) -> i32
   471→  do

   473→    let sublen = str_len(sub)
   474→    if sublen > slen return -1
   475→    let i = 0
   476→    while i <= slen - sublen
   477→      if str_substr(s, i, i + sublen) == sub
   478→        return i

   480→      i = i + 1

   482→    return -1
   483→end

   517→fn str_trim(s: string) -> string
   518→  do
   519→    let start = 0
   520→    let end_pos = str_len(s)
   521→    while start < end_pos
   522→      let ch = str_char(s, start)
   523→      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
   524→        start = start + 1
   525→      else
   526→        break
   527→      end
   528→    end
   529→    while end_pos > start
   530→      let ch = str_char(s, end_pos - 1)
   531→      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
   532→        end_pos = end_pos - 1
   533→      else
   534→        break
   535→      end
   536→    end
   537→    return str_substr(s, start, end_pos)
   538→end

   540→fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
   541→  do
   542→    if n == 0 return "0"
   543→    let result = ""
   544→    let num = n
   545→    let neg = false
   546→    if num < 0
   547→      neg = true
   548→      num = 0 - num
   549→    end
   550→    while num > 0
   551→      let d = num % 10
   552→      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
   553→      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
   554→      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
   555→      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
   556→      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
   557→      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
   558→      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
   559→      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
   560→      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
   561→      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
   562→      num = num / 10
   563→    end
   564→    if neg result = "-" + result
   565→    return result

    39→fn parse_unified_diff(diff_text: string) -> Result<Patch, string>
    40→  intent "unified diff 텍스트를 Patch 구조체로 파싱"
    41→  do
    42→    let lines = str_split_lines(diff_text)
    43→    let total = arr_len(lines)
    44→
    45→    if total < 3
    46→      return Err("diff 텍스트가 너무 짧습니다")
    47→    end
    48→
    49→    let file_path = ""
    50→    let hunks = []
    51→    let i = 0
    52→
    53→    // 헤더 파싱: "--- a/file.rs" 또는 "+++ b/file.rs"
    54→    while i < total
    55→      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
    56→
    57→      if str_starts_with(line, "+++ b/")
    58→        file_path = str_after(line, "+++ b/")
    59→        i = i + 1
    60→        break
    61→      end
    62→
    63→      if str_starts_with(line, "+++ ")
    64→        file_path = str_after(line, "+++ ")
    65→        i = i + 1
    66→        break
    67→      end
    68→
    69→      i = i + 1
    70→    end
    71→
    72→    if file_path == ""
    73→      return Err("+++ 헤더를 찾을 수 없습니다")
    74→    end
    75→
    76→    // 헝크 파싱: "@@ -42,6 +42,7 @@"
    77→    while i < total
    78→      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
    79→
    80→      if str_starts_with(line, "@@ ")
    81→        let hunk_result = parse_hunk(lines, i)
    82→        match hunk_result
    83→          Ok(hunk_pair) => {
    84→            hunks = arr_push(hunks, hunk_pair.hunk)
    85→            i = hunk_pair.next_i
    86→          }
    87→          Err(e) => return Err("헝크 파싱 에러: " + e)
    88→        end
    89→      else
    90→        i = i + 1
    91→      end
    92→    end
    93→
    94→    if arr_len(hunks) == 0
    95→      return Err("@@ 헝크를 찾을 수 없습니다")
    96→    end
    97→
    98→    return Ok(Patch {
    99→      file_path: file_path,
   100→      original_hash: "",
   101→      hunks: hunks,
   102→      description: "",
   103→      generated_by: "claude"
   104→    })

   107→struct HunkWithNext {
   108→  hunk: PatchHunk,
   109→  next_i: i32

   111→
   112→fn parse_hunk(lines: array, start: i32) -> Result<HunkWithNext, string>
   113→  intent "단일 헝크 파싱 (@@ 줄부터)"
   114→  do
   115→    let total = arr_len(lines)
   116→    let header = arr_get(lines, start)
   117→
   118→    // "@@ -42,6 +42,7 @@" 파싱
   119→    let orig_start = 0
   120→    let orig_count = 0
   121→    let new_start = 0
   122→    let new_count = 0
   123→
   124→    // -42,6 부분 추출
   125→    if str_contains(header, "-") && str_contains(header, "+")
   126→      let minus_part = str_between(header, "-", " +")
   127→      let plus_part = str_between(header, "+", " @@")
   128→
   129→      orig_start = parse_int_from_str(str_before(minus_part, ","))
   130→      orig_count = parse_int_from_str(str_after(minus_part, ","))
   131→      new_start = parse_int_from_str(str_before(plus_part, ","))
   132→      new_count = parse_int_from_str(str_after(plus_part, ","))
   133→    end
   134→
   135→    // 줄 파싱
   136→    let hunk_lines = []
   137→    let i = start + 1
   138→    let context_count = 0
   139→    let add_count = 0
   140→    let del_count = 0
   141→
   142→    while i < total
   143→      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
   144→
   145→      // 다음 헝크 또는 새 파일 헤더
   146→      if str_starts_with(line, "@@ ") || str_starts_with(line, "--- ") || str_starts_with(line, "+++ ")
   147→        break
   148→      end
   149→
   150→      // 빈 줄로 끝날 수 있음
   151→      if str_len(line) == 0
   152→        i = i + 1
   153→        break
   154→      end
   155→
   156→      let op = str_char(line, 0)
   157→      let content = ""
   158→      if str_len(line) > 1
   159→        content = str_substr(line, 1, str_len(line))
   160→      end
   161→
   162→      if op == "+"
   163→        hunk_lines = arr_push(hunk_lines, PatchLine { op: "+", content: content })
   164→        add_count = add_count + 1
   165→      else if op == "-"
   166→        hunk_lines = arr_push(hunk_lines, PatchLine { op: "-", content: content })
   167→        del_count = del_count + 1
   168→      else if op == " "
   169→        hunk_lines = arr_push(hunk_lines, PatchLine { op: " ", content: content })
   170→        context_count = context_count + 1
   171→      end
   172→
   173→      i = i + 1
   174→    end
   175→
   176→    return Ok(HunkWithNext {
   177→      hunk: PatchHunk {
   178→        orig_start: orig_start,
   179→        orig_count: orig_count,
   180→        new_start: new_start,
   181→        new_count: new_count,
   182→        lines: hunk_lines
   183→      },
   184→      next_i: i
   185→    })
   186→end

   189→
   190→fn apply_patch(file_content: string, patch: Patch) -> PatchResult
   191→  intent "파일 내용에 패치 적용"
   192→  do
   193→    let orig_lines = str_split_lines(file_content)
   194→    let result_lines = []
   195→    let src_pos = 0  // 현재 원본 줄 위치 (0-indexed)
   196→    let lines_added = 0
   197→    let lines_removed = 0
   198→
   199→    let total_hunks = arr_len(patch.hunks)
   200→    let hi = 0
   201→
   202→    while hi < total_hunks
   203→      let hunk = arr_get(patch.hunks, hi)
   204→      let hunk_start = hunk.orig_start - 1  // 0-indexed로 변환
   205→
   206→      // 헝크 전까지 원본 줄 복사
   207→      while src_pos < hunk_start
   208→        result_lines = arr_push(result_lines, arr_get(orig_lines, src_pos))
   209→        src_pos = src_pos + 1
   210→      end
   211→
   212→      // 헝크 줄 처리
   213→      let hunk_lines = hunk.lines
   214→      let total_hunk_lines = arr_len(hunk_lines)
   215→      let li = 0
   216→
   217→      while li < total_hunk_lines
   218→        let patch_line = arr_get(hunk_lines, li)
   219→
   220→        if patch_line.op == " "
   221→          // 컨텍스트: 원본 줄 유지
   222→          result_lines = arr_push(result_lines, patch_line.content)
   223→          src_pos = src_pos + 1
   224→        else if patch_line.op == "-"
   225→          // 삭제: 원본 줄 건너뜀
   226→          src_pos = src_pos + 1
   227→          lines_removed = lines_removed + 1
   228→        else if patch_line.op == "+"
   229→          // 추가: 새 줄 삽입
   230→          result_lines = arr_push(result_lines, patch_line.content)
   231→          lines_added = lines_added + 1
   232→        end
   233→
   234→        li = li + 1
   235→      end
   236→
   237→      hi = hi + 1
   238→    end
   239→
   240→    // 나머지 원본 줄 복사
   241→    let orig_total = arr_len(orig_lines)
   242→    while src_pos < orig_total
   243→      result_lines = arr_push(result_lines, arr_get(orig_lines, src_pos))
   244→      src_pos = src_pos + 1
   245→    end
   246→
   247→    // 줄 배열을 다시 문자열로
   248→    let patched_content = arr_join(result_lines, "\n")
   249→
   250→    return PatchResult {
   251→      success: true,
   252→      patched_content: patched_content,
   253→      lines_changed: lines_added + lines_removed,
   254→      lines_added: lines_added,
   255→      lines_removed: lines_removed,
   256→      error_msg: ""
   257→    }
   258→end

   262→fn extract_diff_from_response(response_text: string) -> Result<string, string>
   263→  intent "Claude 응답에서 diff 블록 추출"
   264→  do
   265→    // ```diff ... ``` 블록 찾기
   266→    if str_contains(response_text, "```diff")
   267→      let after = str_after(response_text, "```diff\n")
   268→      let diff = str_before(after, "\n```")
   269→      if str_len(diff) > 0
   270→        return Ok(diff)
   271→      end
   272→    end
   273→
   274→    // ```diff 없이 바로 --- 로 시작하는 경우
   275→    if str_contains(response_text, "--- a/") || str_contains(response_text, "--- /")
   276→      let diff_start = find_diff_start(response_text)
   277→      if diff_start >= 0
   278→        return Ok(str_substr(response_text, diff_start, str_len(response_text)))
   279→      end
   280→    end
   281→
   282→    return Err("응답에서 diff를 찾을 수 없습니다")
   283→end
   284→
   285→fn find_diff_start(text: string) -> i32
   286→  intent "텍스트에서 diff 시작 위치 찾기"
   287→  do
   288→    let lines = str_split_lines(text)
   289→    let total = arr_len(lines)
   290→    let i = 0
   291→    let pos = 0
   292→
   293→    while i < total
   294→      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
   295→      if str_starts_with(line, "--- ")
   296→        return pos
   297→      end
   298→      pos = pos + str_len(line) + 1  // +1 for newline
   299→      i = i + 1
   300→    end
   301→
   302→    return -1
   303→end

   307→fn validate_patch(patch: Patch, orig_content: string) -> Result<void, string>
   308→  intent "패치 적용 전 유효성 검사"
   309→  do
   310→    if arr_len(patch.hunks) == 0
   311→      return Err("헝크가 없는 빈 패치")
   312→    end
   313→
   314→    let orig_lines = str_split_lines(orig_content)
   315→    let orig_total = arr_len(orig_lines)
   316→
   317→    // 각 헝크의 원본 줄 범위 검증
   318→    let i = 0
   319→    let total = arr_len(patch.hunks)
   320→
   321→    while i < total
   322→      let hunk = arr_get(patch.hunks, i)
   323→
   324→      if hunk.orig_start < 1
   325→        return Err("헝크 시작 줄이 1보다 작습니다: " + int_to_str(hunk.orig_start))
   326→      end
   327→
   328→      let hunk_end = hunk.orig_start + hunk.orig_count - 1
   329→      if hunk_end > orig_total
   330→        return Err("헝크 범위가 파일 범위를 초과합니다 (헝크끝: " +
   331→                   int_to_str(hunk_end) + ", 파일줄수: " + int_to_str(orig_total) + ")")
   332→      end
   333→
   334→      // 컨텍스트 줄 일치 검사 (처음 1줄만)
   335→      let context_check = verify_hunk_context(hunk, orig_lines)
   336→      match context_check
   337→        Err(e) => return Err("컨텍스트 불일치: " + e)
   338→        Ok(_) => {}
   339→      end
   340→
   341→      i = i + 1
   342→    end
   343→
   344→    return Ok(void)
   345→end

   347→fn verify_hunk_context(hunk: PatchHunk, orig_lines: array) -> Result<void, string>
   348→  intent "헝크 컨텍스트 줄이 원본과 일치하는지 확인"
   349→  do
   350→    let hunk_line_idx = 0
   351→    let orig_pos = hunk.orig_start - 1  // 0-indexed
   352→    let total_hunk = arr_len(hunk.lines)
   353→
   354→    while hunk_line_idx < total_hunk
   355→      let pl = arr_get(hunk.lines, hunk_line_idx)
   356→
   357→      if pl.op == " " || pl.op == "-"
   358→        // 원본 줄과 비교
   359→        let orig_line = arr_get(orig_lines, orig_pos)
   360→        if str_trim(orig_line) != str_trim(pl.content)
   361→          return Err("줄 " + int_to_str(orig_pos + 1) +
   362→                     " 불일치: 예상='" + pl.content +
   363→                     "' 실제='" + orig_line + "'")
   364→        end
   365→        orig_pos = orig_pos + 1
   366→      end
   367→
   368→      hunk_line_idx = hunk_line_idx + 1
   369→    end
   370→
   371→    return Ok(void)
   372→end

   409→fn arr_join(arr: array, sep: string) -> string

   411→  do
   412→    let result = ""

   427→fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
   428→  do
   429→    if n == 0 return "0"
   430→    let result = ""
   431→    let num = n
   432→    let neg = false
   433→    if num < 0
   434→      neg = true
   435→      num = 0 - num
   436→    end
   437→    while num > 0
   438→      let d = num % 10
   439→      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
   440→      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
   441→      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
   442→      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
   443→      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
   444→      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
   445→      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
   446→      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
   447→      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
   448→      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
   449→      num = num / 10
   450→    end
   451→    if neg result = "-" + result
   452→    return result
   453→end

   455→fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
   456→  do
   457→    let num = 0
   458→    let i = 0
   459→    let len = str_len(s)
   460→    while i < len
   461→      let ch = str_char(s, i)
   462→      let d = 0
   463→      if ch == "0" d = 0
   464→      else if ch == "1" d = 1
   465→      else if ch == "2" d = 2
   466→      else if ch == "3" d = 3
   467→      else if ch == "4" d = 4
   468→      else if ch == "5" d = 5
   469→      else if ch == "6" d = 6
   470→      else if ch == "7" d = 7
   471→      else if ch == "8" d = 8
   472→      else if ch == "9" d = 9
   473→      else return num
   474→      num = num * 10 + d
   475→      i = i + 1
   476→    end
   477→    return num
   478→end

   352→struct RegressionResult {
   353→  regression_detected: bool,
   354→  new_failures: array,    // 새로 생긴 실패 테스트
   355→  fixed_tests: array,     // 수정된 테스트
   356→  net_change: i32         // 양수: 개선, 음수: 악화
   357→}
   358→
   359→fn analyze_regression(before: TestRunResult, after: TestRunResult) -> RegressionResult
   360→  intent "테스트 결과 비교 - 회귀 감지"
   361→  do
   362→    let new_failures = []
   363→    let fixed_tests = []
   364→
   365→    // 새로 생긴 실패: after에는 있지만 before에는 없는 실패
   366→    let n_after = arr_len(after.failed_tests)
   367→    let i = 0
   368→    while i < n_after
   369→      let test = arr_get(after.failed_tests, i)
   370→      if !arr_contains_str(before.failed_tests, test)
   371→        new_failures = arr_push(new_failures, test)
   372→      end
   373→      i = i + 1
   374→    end
   375→
   376→    // 수정된 테스트: before에는 있지만 after에는 없는 실패
   377→    let n_before = arr_len(before.failed_tests)
   378→    i = 0
   379→    while i < n_before
   380→      let test = arr_get(before.failed_tests, i)
   381→      if !arr_contains_str(after.failed_tests, test)
   382→        fixed_tests = arr_push(fixed_tests, test)
   383→      end
   384→      i = i + 1
   385→    end
   386→
   387→    let net_change = arr_len(fixed_tests) - arr_len(new_failures)
   388→    let regression = arr_len(new_failures) > 0
   389→
   390→    return RegressionResult {
   391→      regression_detected: regression,
   392→      new_failures: new_failures,
   393→      fixed_tests: fixed_tests,
   394→      net_change: net_change
   395→    }
   396→end

   398→fn is_target_test_fixed(test_name: string, before: TestRunResult, after: TestRunResult) -> bool
   399→  intent "대상 테스트가 수정되었는지 확인"
   400→  do
   401→    if test_name == ""
   402→      // 테스트 이름 없으면 전체 통과 여부로 판단
   403→      return after.passed
   404→    end
   405→
   406→    // before에서 실패했고 after에서 성공
   407→    let was_failing = arr_contains_str(before.failed_tests, test_name)
   408→    let now_passing = !arr_contains_str(after.failed_tests, test_name)
   409→
   410→    return was_failing && now_passing
   411→end

   413→// ==================== Claude 검증 응답 파싱 ====================
   414→
   415→struct ClaudeVerdict {
   416→  is_correct: bool,
   417→  reason: string,
   418→  confidence: i32,
   419→  potential_issues: array
   420→}
   421→
   422→fn parse_verify_json(json_text: string) -> ClaudeVerdict
   423→  intent "Claude 검증 JSON 응답 파싱"
   424→  do
   425→    let json = extract_json_block(json_text)
   426→
   427→    if str_len(json) == 0
   428→      // JSON 없으면 텍스트에서 판단
   429→      let lower = str_lowercase(json_text)
   430→      let is_correct = str_contains(lower, "correct") ||
   431→                       str_contains(lower, "올바") ||
   432→                       str_contains(lower, "수정됨")
   433→      return ClaudeVerdict {
   434→        is_correct: is_correct,
   435→        reason: str_truncate(json_text, 200),
   436→        confidence: 50,
   437→        potential_issues: []
   438→      }
   439→    end
   440→
   441→    let is_correct = false
   442→    let is_correct_str = json_extract_string(json, "is_correct")
   443→    if is_correct_str == "true" || is_correct_str == "True"
   444→      is_correct = true
   445→    end
   446→    // bool 직접 파싱
   447→    if str_contains(json, "\"is_correct\": true") || str_contains(json, "\"is_correct\":true")
   448→      is_correct = true
   449→    end
   450→
   451→    let reason = json_extract_string(json, "reason")
   452→    let confidence = json_extract_int(json, "confidence")
   453→    let issues = json_extract_str_array(json, "potential_issues")
   454→
   455→    return ClaudeVerdict {
   456→      is_correct: is_correct,
   457→      reason: reason,
   458→      confidence: confidence,
   459→      potential_issues: issues
   460→    }
   461→end
   462→
   463→fn extract_json_block(text: string) -> string
   464→  do
   465→    if str_contains(text, "```json")
   466→      let after = str_after(text, "```json\n")
   467→      if str_contains(after, "\n```")
   468→        return str_before(after, "\n```")
   469→      end
   470→    end
   471→
   472→    let i = 0
   473→    let len = str_len(text)
   474→    while i < len
   475→      if str_char(text, i) == "{"
   476→        let from = str_substr(text, i, len)
   477→        let end_pos = find_matching_brace(from)
   478→        if end_pos > 0
   479→          return str_substr(from, 0, end_pos + 1)
   480→        end
   481→      end
   482→      i = i + 1
   483→    end
   484→
   485→    return ""
   486→end
   487→
   488→fn find_matching_brace(text: string) -> i32
   489→  do
   490→    let depth = 0
   491→    let i = 0
   492→    let len = str_len(text)
   493→    let in_str = false
   494→
   495→    while i < len
   496→      let ch = str_char(text, i)
   497→      if in_str
   498→        if ch == "\\" i = i + 2 continue
   499→        if ch == "\"" in_str = false
   500→      else
   501→        if ch == "\"" in_str = true
   502→        else if ch == "{" depth = depth + 1
   503→        else if ch == "}"
   504→          depth = depth - 1
   505→          if depth == 0 return i
   506→        end
   507→      end
   508→      i = i + 1
   509→    end
   510→    return -1
   511→end

   686→fn build_verify_details(
   687→  syntax_ok: bool,
   688→  before: TestRunResult,
   689→  after: TestRunResult,
   690→  regression: RegressionResult,
   691→  claude_ok: bool,
   692→  claude_confidence: i32,
   693→  claude_issues: array
   694→) -> string
   695→  intent "상세 검증 결과 텍스트 생성"
   696→  do
   697→    let text = ""
   698→
   699→    // 테스트 변화
   700→    let passed_delta = after.tests_passed - before.tests_passed
   701→    let sign = if passed_delta >= 0 "+" else ""
   702→    text = text + "테스트 변화: " + sign + int_to_str(passed_delta) +
   703→           " (" + int_to_str(before.tests_passed) + " → " + int_to_str(after.tests_passed) + ")\n"
   704→
   705→    // 회귀
   706→    if arr_len(regression.new_failures) > 0
   707→      text = text + "새 실패: " + format_failed_list(regression.new_failures) + "\n"
   708→    end
   709→    if arr_len(regression.fixed_tests) > 0
   710→      text = text + "수정됨: " + format_test_list(regression.fixed_tests) + "\n"
   711→    end
   712→
   713→    // Claude 판단
   714→    text = text + "Claude 검증: " + int_to_str(claude_confidence) + "% 신뢰도\n"
   715→
   716→    if arr_len(claude_issues) > 0
   717→      text = text + "잠재적 문제:\n"
   718→      let i = 0
   719→      let n = arr_len(claude_issues)
   720→      while i < n
   721→        text = text + "  - " + arr_get(claude_issues, i) + "\n"
   722→        i = i + 1
   723→      end
   724→    end
   725→
   726→    return text

   729→fn format_test_list(tests: array) -> string
   730→  do
   731→    let n = arr_len(tests)
   732→    if n == 0 return "(없음)"
   733→    let result = ""

   789→fn count_occurrences(s: string, pattern: string) -> i32
   790→  do
   791→    let count = 0
   792→    let pos = 0
   793→    let plen = str_len(pattern)
   794→    let slen = str_len(s)
   795→
   796→    while pos <= slen - plen
   797→      if str_substr(s, pos, pos + plen) == pattern

   799→        pos = pos + plen
   800→      else
   801→        pos = pos + 1
   802→      end
   803→    end
   804→
   805→    return count

   819→fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
   820→  do
   821→    if n == 0 return "0"
   822→    let result = ""
   823→    let num = n
   824→    let neg = false
   825→    if num < 0
   826→      neg = true
   827→      num = 0 - num
   828→    end
   829→    while num > 0
   830→      let d = num % 10
   831→      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
   832→      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
   833→      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
   834→      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
   835→      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
   836→      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
   837→      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
   838→      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
   839→      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
   840→      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
   841→      num = num / 10
   842→    end
   843→    if neg result = "-" + result
   844→    return result
   845→end

   847→fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
   848→  do
   849→    let num = 0
   850→    let i = 0
   851→    let len = str_len(s)
   852→    while i < len
   853→      let ch = str_char(s, i)
   854→      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
   855→      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
   856→      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
   857→      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
   858→      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
   859→      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
   860→      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
   861→      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
   862→      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
   863→      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
   864→      else return num
   865→      i = i + 1
   866→    end
   867→    return num
   868→end
   869→
   870→fn json_extract_string(json: string, key: string) -> string
   871→  do
   872→    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
   873→    if str_contains(json, search)
   874→      let after = str_after(json, search)
   875→      let result = ""
   876→      let i = 0
   877→      let len = str_len(after)
   878→      while i < len
   879→        let ch = str_char(after, i)
   880→        if ch == "\\" i = i + 1
   881→        else if ch == "\"" return result
   882→        else result = result + ch
   883→        i = i + 1
   884→      end
   885→    end
   886→    return ""
   887→end
   888→
   889→fn json_extract_int(json: string, key: string) -> i32
   890→  do
   891→    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
   892→    if str_contains(json, search)
   893→      let after = str_trim(str_after(json, search))
   894→      let result = ""
   895→      let i = 0
   896→      let len = str_len(after)
   897→      while i < len
   898→        let ch = str_char(after, i)
   899→        if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
   900→           ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
   901→          result = result + ch
   902→        else break
   903→        i = i + 1
   904→      end
   905→      return parse_int_from_str(result)
   906→    end
   907→    return 0
   908→end
   909→
   910→fn json_extract_str_array(json: string, key: string) -> array
   911→  do
   912→    let result = []
   913→    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
   914→    if !str_contains(json, search) return result
   915→
   916→    let after = str_trim(str_after(json, search))
   917→    if str_len(after) == 0 || str_char(after, 0) != "[" return result
   918→
   919→    let i = 1
   920→    let len = str_len(after)
   921→    let current = ""
   922→    let in_str = false
   923→
   924→    while i < len
   925→      let ch = str_char(after, i)
   926→      if in_str
   927→        if ch == "\\" i = i + 1
   928→        else if ch == "\""
   929→          result = arr_push(result, current)
   930→          current = ""
   931→          in_str = false
   932→        else current = current + ch
   933→      else
   934→        if ch == "\"" in_str = true
   935→        else if ch == "]" break
   936→      end
   937→      i = i + 1
   938→    end
   939→
   940→    return result
   941→end

   945→    if str_len(s) <= max_len return s
   946→    return str_substr(s, 0, max_len - 3) + "..."
   947→end

// ============================================================
// compiler_verifier.fl - 실제 컴파일 검증 (Phase 6-A)
// 패치 적용 후 rustc / go build / fl 실제 컴파일 실행
// ProofScore에 +30 기여
// ============================================================

struct CompileResult {
  success: bool,
  lang: string,
  exit_code: i32,
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  duration_ms: i32,
  errors_found: array,    // CompileError[]
  warnings_found: i32
}

struct CompileError {
  file_path: string,
  line_num: i32,
  col_num: i32,
  message: string,
  error_code: string      // E0308, etc.
}

struct CompileConfig {
  lang: string,
  source_file: string,      // 컴파일할 단일 파일 (빠른 경로)
  repo_path: string,        // 전체 빌드 경로 (폴백)
  timeout_sec: i32,
  edition: string           // Rust: "2021", Go: "", FL: ""
}

// ==================== 메인 진입점 ====================

fn compiler_verify(patched_content: string, cfg: CompileConfig) -> CompileResult
  intent "패치된 소스를 실제 컴파일러로 검증"
  do
    print("[Compiler] 컴파일 검증: " + cfg.lang + " → " + cfg.source_file)

    // 임시 파일에 패치된 소스 저장
    let tmp_src = "/tmp/cv_src_" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix()) + get_ext(cfg.lang)
    file_write(tmp_src, patched_content)

    let result = CompileResult {
      success: false,
      lang: cfg.lang,
      exit_code: 1,
      stdout: "",
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: 0,
      errors_found: [],
      warnings_found: 0
    }

    if cfg.lang == "rust"
      result = compile_rust(tmp_src, cfg)
    else if cfg.lang == "go"
      result = compile_go(tmp_src, cfg)
    else if cfg.lang == "freelang" || cfg.lang == "fl"
      result = compile_fl(tmp_src, cfg)
    else
      print("[Compiler] 지원하지 않는 언어: " + cfg.lang + " (건너뜀)")
      result.success = true  // 알 수 없는 언어는 통과 처리
      result.stderr = "unsupported language: " + cfg.lang
    end

    exec("rm -f " + tmp_src)

    if result.success
      print("[Compiler] ✅ 컴파일 성공 (" + cfg.lang + ")")
    else
      print("[Compiler] ❌ 컴파일 실패: " + int_to_str(arr_len(result.errors_found)) + "개 에러")
    end

    return result
end

// ==================== Rust 컴파일 ====================

fn compile_rust(src_file: string, cfg: CompileConfig) -> CompileResult
  intent "rustc로 단일 파일 컴파일 검증"
  do
    let out_file = "/tmp/cv_rust_out_" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix())
    let err_file = "/tmp/cv_rust_err_" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix()) + ".txt"

    let edition = cfg.edition
    if edition == "" edition = "2021"

    let start_ts = now_unix()

    // 먼저 단일 파일 컴파일 시도 (라이브러리 크레이트)
    exec("timeout " + int_to_str(cfg.timeout_sec) +
         " rustc --edition " + edition +
         " --crate-type lib" +
         " -o " + out_file +
         " " + src_file +
         " > /dev/null 2> " + err_file +
         " ; echo $? > " + err_file + ".exit")

    let exit_code = read_exit_code(err_file + ".exit")
    let stderr = ""
    match file_read(err_file)
      Ok(c) => { stderr = c }
      Err(_) => {}
    end

    exec("rm -f " + out_file + " " + err_file + " " + err_file + ".exit")

    let duration = (now_unix() - start_ts) as i32 * 1000

    if exit_code == 0
      return CompileResult {
        success: true,
        lang: "rust",
        exit_code: 0,
        stdout: "",
        stderr: stderr,
        duration_ms: duration,
        errors_found: [],
        warnings_found: count_warnings(stderr)
      }
    end

    // 실패 시 repo 전체 빌드 폴백 (cargo build)
    if cfg.repo_path != ""
      return compile_rust_cargo(cfg.repo_path, src_file, cfg, stderr)
    end

    let errors = parse_rust_errors(stderr)
    return CompileResult {
      success: false,
      lang: "rust",
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: "",
      stderr: stderr,
      duration_ms: duration,
      errors_found: errors,
      warnings_found: count_warnings(stderr)
    }
end

fn compile_rust_cargo(repo_path: string, patched_src: string,
                       cfg: CompileConfig, prev_stderr: string) -> CompileResult
  intent "cargo build로 전체 빌드 (폴백)"
  do
    let tmp_dir = "/tmp/cv_cargo_" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix())
    let err_file = tmp_dir + "_err.txt"

    // 저장소 복사 후 패치된 파일 교체
    exec("cp -r " + repo_path + " " + tmp_dir + " 2>/dev/null || true")
    exec("cp " + patched_src + " " + tmp_dir + "/" + cfg.source_file + " 2>/dev/null || true")

    let start_ts = now_unix()
    exec("timeout " + int_to_str(cfg.timeout_sec) +
         " cargo build --manifest-path " + tmp_dir + "/Cargo.toml" +
         " 2> " + err_file +
         " ; echo $? > " + err_file + ".exit")

    let exit_code = read_exit_code(err_file + ".exit")
    let stderr = ""
    match file_read(err_file)
      Ok(c) => { stderr = c }
      Err(_) => {}
    end

    let duration = (now_unix() - start_ts) as i32 * 1000
    exec("rm -rf " + tmp_dir + " " + err_file + " " + err_file + ".exit")

    let errors = parse_rust_errors(stderr)
    return CompileResult {
      success: exit_code == 0,
      lang: "rust",
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: "",
      stderr: stderr,
      duration_ms: duration,
      errors_found: errors,
      warnings_found: count_warnings(stderr)
    }
end

// ==================== Go 컴파일 ====================

fn compile_go(src_file: string, cfg: CompileConfig) -> CompileResult
  intent "go vet + go build로 Go 파일 검증"
  do
    let tmp_dir = "/tmp/cv_go_" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix())
    let err_file = tmp_dir + "_err.txt"

    exec("mkdir -p " + tmp_dir)
    exec("cp " + src_file + " " + tmp_dir + "/main.go 2>/dev/null || true")

    // go.mod 없으면 생성
    let gomod = "module cvcheck\ngo 1.21\n"

fn read_exit_code(path: string) -> i32

      }

fn get_ext(lang: string) -> string
  do
    if lang == "rust" return ".rs"
    if lang == "go" return ".go"
    if lang == "freelang" || lang == "fl" return ".fl"
    return ".txt"
end

fn extract_rust_error_code(line: string) -> string
  do
    let pos = str_index_of_str(line, "error[")
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + 6
    let end_p = str_index_of_from(line, "]", start)
    if end_p < 0 return ""
    return str_substr(line, start, end_p)
end

fn extract_file_from_location(loc: string) -> string
  do
    let colon = str_index_of_str(loc, ":")
    if colon < 0 return loc
    return str_substr(loc, 0, colon)
end

fn extract_line_from_location(loc: string) -> i32
  do
    let first_colon = str_index_of_str(loc, ":")
    if first_colon < 0 return 0
    let second_colon = str_index_of_from(loc, ":", first_colon + 1)
    if second_colon < 0 return 0
    return parse_int_safe(str_substr(loc, first_colon + 1, second_colon))
end

fn extract_go_file(line: string) -> string
  do
    let pos = str_index_of_str(line, ".go:")
    if pos < 0 return ""
    return str_substr(line, 0, pos + 3)
end

fn extract_go_line(line: string) -> i32
  do
    let pos = str_index_of_str(line, ".go:")
    if pos < 0 return 0
    let start = pos + 4
    let colon = str_index_of_from(line, ":", start)
    if colon < 0
      return parse_int_safe(str_substr(line, start, str_len(line)))
    end
    return parse_int_safe(str_substr(line, start, colon))
end

fn str_starts_with(s: string, prefix: string) -> bool
  do
    if str_len(s) < str_len(prefix) return false
    return str_substr(s, 0, str_len(prefix)) == prefix
end

fn str_contains(s: string, sub: string) -> bool
  do
    return str_index_of_str(s, sub) >= 0
end

fn str_index_of_str(s: string, sub: string) -> i32
  do
    let slen = str_len(s)
    let sublen = str_len(sub)
    if sublen > slen return -1
    let i = 0
    while i <= slen - sublen
      if str_substr(s, i, i + sublen) == sub return i
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn str_index_of_from(s: string, ch: string, from: i32) -> i32
  do
    let i = from
    while i < str_len(s)
      if str_char(s, i) == ch return i
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn str_split_lines(s: string) -> array
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\n"
        result = arr_push(result, current)
        current = ""
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    if current != "" result = arr_push(result, current)
    return result
end

fn str_trim(s: string) -> string
  do
    let start = 0
    let end_pos = str_len(s)
    while start < end_pos
      let ch = str_char(s, start)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        start = start + 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    while end_pos > start
      let ch = str_char(s, end_pos - 1)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        end_pos = end_pos - 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    return str_substr(s, start, end_pos)
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn int_to_str_i64(n: i64) -> string
  do
    return int_to_str(n as i32)
end

fn parse_int_safe(s: string) -> i32
  do
    if s == "" return 0
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else break
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

      if str_contains(line, ".go:") && str_len(line) > 5
        let err = CompileError {
          file_path: extract_go_file(line),
          line_num: extract_go_line(line),
          col_num: 0,
          message: line,
          error_code: ""
        }
        result = arr_push(result, err)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn parse_fl_errors(stderr: string) -> array
  do
    let result = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(stderr)
    let i = 0
    while i < arr_len(lines)
      let line = str_trim(arr_get(lines, i))
      if str_starts_with(line, "Error:") || str_starts_with(line, "error:")
        let err = CompileError {
          file_path: "",
          line_num: 0,
          col_num: 0,
          message: line,
          error_code: ""
        }
        result = arr_push(result, err)
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn count_warnings(stderr: string) -> i32
  do
    let count = 0
    let lines = str_split_lines(stderr)
    let i = 0
    while i < arr_len(lines)
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)
      if str_starts_with(str_trim(line), "warning:")
        count = count + 1
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return count
end

// ==================== ProofScore 기여 ====================

fn compiler_proof_score(result: CompileResult) -> i32
  intent "컴파일 검증 결과 → ProofScore 기여 (+30 최대)"
  do
    if !result.success
      return 0
    end

    let score = 30
    // 경고가 많으면 소폭 감점
    if result.warnings_found > 5
      score = score - 5
    end
    if result.warnings_found > 10
      score = score - 5
    end

    return score
end

fn compiler_verify_summary(result: CompileResult) -> string
  do
    if result.success
      let msg = "✅ " + result.lang + " 컴파일 성공"
      if result.warnings_found > 0
        msg = msg + " (경고 " + int_to_str(result.warnings_found) + "개)"
      end
      msg = msg + " [" + int_to_str(result.duration_ms) + "ms]"
      return msg
    end

    let msg = "❌ " + result.lang + " 컴파일 실패 (" +
              int_to_str(arr_len(result.errors_found)) + "개 에러)"
    if arr_len(result.errors_found) > 0
      let first = arr_get(result.errors_found, 0)
      msg = msg + ": " + str_substr(first.message, 0, 80)
    end
    return msg
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn read_exit_code(path: string) -> i32
  do
    match file_read(path)
      Err(_) => { return 1 }
      Ok(content) => {
        return parse_int_safe(str_trim(content))
      }
    end
end

fn get_ext(lang: string) -> string
  do
    if lang == "rust" return ".rs"
    if lang == "go" return ".go"
    if lang == "freelang" || lang == "fl" return ".fl"
    return ".txt"
end

fn extract_rust_error_code(line: string) -> string
  do
    let pos = str_index_of_str(line, "error[")
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + 6
    let end_p = str_index_of_from(line, "]", start)
    if end_p < 0 return ""
    return str_substr(line, start, end_p)
end

fn extract_file_from_location(loc: string) -> string
  do
    let colon = str_index_of_str(loc, ":")
    if colon < 0 return loc
    return str_substr(loc, 0, colon)
end

fn extract_line_from_location(loc: string) -> i32
  do
    let first_colon = str_index_of_str(loc, ":")
    if first_colon < 0 return 0
    let second_colon = str_index_of_from(loc, ":", first_colon + 1)
    if second_colon < 0 return 0
    return parse_int_safe(str_substr(loc, first_colon + 1, second_colon))
end

fn extract_go_file(line: string) -> string
  do
    let pos = str_index_of_str(line, ".go:")
    if pos < 0 return ""
    return str_substr(line, 0, pos + 3)
end

fn extract_go_line(line: string) -> i32
  do
    let pos = str_index_of_str(line, ".go:")
    if pos < 0 return 0
    let start = pos + 4
    let colon = str_index_of_from(line, ":", start)
    if colon < 0
      return parse_int_safe(str_substr(line, start, str_len(line)))
    end
    return parse_int_safe(str_substr(line, start, colon))
end

fn str_starts_with(s: string, prefix: string) -> bool
  do
    if str_len(s) < str_len(prefix) return false
    return str_substr(s, 0, str_len(prefix)) == prefix
end

fn str_contains(s: string, sub: string) -> bool
  do
    return str_index_of_str(s, sub) >= 0
end

fn str_index_of_str(s: string, sub: string) -> i32
  do
    let slen = str_len(s)
    let sublen = str_len(sub)
    if sublen > slen return -1
    let i = 0
    while i <= slen - sublen
      if str_substr(s, i, i + sublen) == sub return i
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn str_index_of_from(s: string, ch: string, from: i32) -> i32
  do
    let i = from
    while i < str_len(s)
      if str_char(s, i) == ch return i
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn str_split_lines(s: string) -> array
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\n"
        result = arr_push(result, current)
        current = ""
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    if current != "" result = arr_push(result, current)
    return result
end

fn str_trim(s: string) -> string
  do
    let start = 0
    let end_pos = str_len(s)
    while start < end_pos
      let ch = str_char(s, start)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        start = start + 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    while end_pos > start
      let ch = str_char(s, end_pos - 1)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        end_pos = end_pos - 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    return str_substr(s, start, end_pos)
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn int_to_str_i64(n: i64) -> string
  do
    return int_to_str(n as i32)
end

fn parse_int_safe(s: string) -> i32
  do
    if s == "" return 0
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else break
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

// ============================================================
// test_generator.fl - 테스트 자동 생성 (Phase 6-B)
// Claude가 버그 재현 테스트 코드를 자동 생성
// 생성된 테스트로 패치 전/후 검증
// ============================================================

struct GeneratedTest {
  test_id: string,
  lang: string,
  test_code: string,          // 생성된 테스트 코드
  test_file_name: string,     // 저장할 파일명
  expected_result: string,    // "pass" | "fail_before_fix"
  bug_reproduces: bool,       // 패치 전에 이 테스트가 실패해야 함
  description: string
}

struct TestGenRequest {
  lang: string,
  buggy_code: string,
  fixed_code: string,
  ci_failure_log: string,
  root_cause: string,
  fix_description: string
}

struct TestGenResult {
  success: bool,
  tests: array,               // GeneratedTest[]
  total_generated: i32,
  compile_ok: bool,
  run_results: array,         // TestRunOutcome[]
  proof_contribution: i32     // ProofScore 기여 (최대 +20)
}

struct TestRunOutcome {
  test_id: string,
  phase: string,              // "before" | "after"
  passed: bool,
  output: string,
  exit_code: i32
}

// ==================== 테스트 생성 메인 ====================

fn test_generate(req: TestGenRequest, api_key: string) -> TestGenResult
  intent "Claude에게 버그 재현 테스트 생성 요청 + 실행 검증"
  do
    print("[TestGen] 테스트 자동 생성 시작: " + req.lang)

    // Claude에게 테스트 생성 요청
    let generated = ask_claude_generate_tests(req, api_key)

    if arr_len(generated) == 0
      return TestGenResult {
        success: false,
        tests: [],
        total_generated: 0,
        compile_ok: false,
        run_results: [],
        proof_contribution: 0
      }
    end

    print("[TestGen] " + int_to_str(arr_len(generated)) + "개 테스트 생성됨")

    // 생성된 테스트 실행 검증
    let run_results = run_generated_tests(generated, req)
    let proof = calculate_test_proof(run_results, arr_len(generated))

    return TestGenResult {
      success: true,
      tests: generated,
      total_generated: arr_len(generated),
      compile_ok: true,
      run_results: run_results,
      proof_contribution: proof
    }
end

fn ask_claude_generate_tests(req: TestGenRequest, api_key: string) -> array
  intent "Claude API에 테스트 생성 요청"
  do
    let prompt = build_testgen_prompt(req)

    let req_body = "{\"model\":\"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001\"," +
      "\"max_tokens\":3000," +
      "\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\"," +
      "\"content\":" + json_str_encode(prompt) + "}]}"

    let temp_req = "/tmp/tg_req_" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix()) + ".json"
    let temp_resp = "/tmp/tg_resp_" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix()) + ".json"

    file_write(temp_req, req_body)
    exec("curl -s -X POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages" +
         " -H 'x-api-key: " + api_key + "'" +
         " -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01'" +
         " -H 'content-type: application/json'" +
         " -d @" + temp_req + " > " + temp_resp)

    let result = []
    match file_read(temp_resp)
      Ok(resp) => {
        let text = extract_api_content(resp)
        result = parse_test_response(text, req.lang)
      }
      Err(_) => {}
    end

    exec("rm -f " + temp_req + " " + temp_resp)
    return result
end

fn build_testgen_prompt(req: TestGenRequest) -> string
  do
    let prompt = "You are a test generation expert. Generate tests that:\n"
    prompt = prompt + "1. FAIL with the buggy code (reproduce the bug)\n"
    prompt = prompt + "2. PASS with the fixed code (verify the fix)\n\n"

    prompt = prompt + "## Bug Information\n"
    prompt = prompt + "Language: " + req.lang + "\n"
    prompt = prompt + "Root Cause: " + req.root_cause + "\n"
    prompt = prompt + "Fix: " + req.fix_description + "\n\n"

    prompt = prompt + "## CI Failure Log\n```\n" + req.ci_failure_log + "\n```\n\n"

    prompt = prompt + "## Buggy Code\n```\n" + req.buggy_code + "\n```\n\n"

    prompt = prompt + "## Fixed Code\n```\n" + req.fixed_code + "\n```\n\n"

    if req.lang == "rust"
      prompt = prompt + "## Output Format\n"
      prompt = prompt + "Generate 2-3 Rust tests using #[test]. Output JSON:\n"
      prompt = prompt + "{\n  \"tests\": [\n"
      prompt = prompt + "    {\"name\": \"test_bug_reproduced\", \"code\": \"#[test]\\nfn test_xxx() {...}\", \"description\": \"...\"}\n"
      prompt = prompt + "  ]\n}\n"
    else if req.lang == "go"
      prompt = prompt + "## Output Format\n"
      prompt = prompt + "Generate 2-3 Go tests using func TestXxx(t *testing.T). Output JSON:\n"
      prompt = prompt + "{\n  \"tests\": [\n"
      prompt = prompt + "    {\"name\": \"TestBugReproduced\", \"code\": \"func TestXxx(t *testing.T) {...}\", \"description\": \"...\"}\n"
      prompt = prompt + "  ]\n}\n"
    else
      prompt = prompt + "## Output Format\n"
      prompt = prompt + "Generate 2-3 tests. Output JSON:\n"
      prompt = prompt + "{\n  \"tests\": [\n"
      prompt = prompt + "    {\"name\": \"test_bug\", \"code\": \"...\", \"description\": \"...\"}\n"
      prompt = prompt + "  ]\n}\n"
    end

    return prompt
end

fn parse_test_response(text: string, lang: string) -> array
  intent "Claude 응답에서 테스트 JSON 파싱"
  do
    let result = []

    // JSON 블록 추출
    let json_text = extract_json_block(text)
    if json_text == ""
      json_text = text
    end

    // tests 배열 추출
    let tests_start = str_index_of_str(json_text, "\"tests\"")
    if tests_start < 0 return result

    // 간단 파싱: 각 테스트 객체 순회
    let arr_start = str_index_of_from(json_text, "[", tests_start)
    if arr_start < 0 return result

    let i = arr_start + 1
    let test_num = 0
    while i < str_len(json_text) && test_num < 5
      let obj_start = str_index_of_from(json_text, "{", i)
      if obj_start < 0 break

      let obj_end = find_json_object_end(json_text, obj_start)
      if obj_end < 0 break

      let obj = str_substr(json_text, obj_start, obj_end + 1)
      let name = json_extract_str(obj, "name")
      let code = json_extract_str_long(obj, "code")
      let desc = json_extract_str_long(obj, "description")

      if name != "" && code != ""
        let test = GeneratedTest {
          test_id: "gen_" + int_to_str(test_num),
          lang: lang,
          test_code: code,
          test_file_name: "gen_test_" + int_to_str(test_num) + get_test_ext(lang),
          expected_result: "fail_before_fix",
          bug_reproduces: true,
          description: desc
        }
        result = arr_push(result, test)
        test_num = test_num + 1
      end

      i = obj_end + 1
    end

    return result
end

// ==================== 테스트 실행 ====================

fn run_generated_tests(tests: array, req: TestGenRequest) -> array
  intent "생성된 테스트를 버그 코드와 수정 코드에서 실행"
  do
    let outcomes = []
    let i = 0
    while i < arr_len(tests)
      let t = arr_get(tests, i)

      // 패치 전 실행 (실패해야 정상)
      let before = run_single_test(t, req.buggy_code, "before", req.lang)
      outcomes = arr_push(outcomes, before)

      // 패치 후 실행 (통과해야 정상)
      let after = run_single_test(t, req.fixed_code, "after", req.lang)
      outcomes = arr_push(outcomes, after)

      let status = "?"
      if !before.passed && after.passed
        status = "✅ 완벽 (버그 재현 + 수정 확인)"
      else if !before.passed && !after.passed
        status = "⚠️  수정 후도 실패"
      else if before.passed
        status = "⚠️  버그 재현 안 됨"
      end

      print("[TestGen] 테스트 " + t.test_id + ": " + status)
      i = i + 1
    end
    return outcomes
end

fn run_single_test(t: GeneratedTest, source_code: string,
                    phase: string, lang: string) -> TestRunOutcome
  intent "단일 테스트 실행 (버그 전/후)"
  do
    let tmp_dir = "/tmp/tg_run_" + t.test_id + "_" + phase + "_" + int_to_str_i64(now_unix())
    let out_file = tmp_dir + "_out.txt"

    exec("mkdir -p " + tmp_dir)

    let exit_code = 1
    let output = ""

    if lang == "rust"
      exit_code = run_rust_test(tmp_dir, source_code, t.test_code, out_file)
    else if lang == "go"
      exit_code = run_go_test(tmp_dir, source_code, t.test_code, out_file)
    else
      // 지원하지 않는 언어: 패스 처리
      exit_code = 0
    end

    match file_read(out_file)
      Ok(c) => { output = c }
      Err(_) => {}
    end

    exec("rm -rf " + tmp_dir + " " + out_file)

    return TestRunOutcome {
      test_id: t.test_id,
      phase: phase,
      passed: exit_code == 0,
      output: str_substr(output, 0, 500),
      exit_code: exit_code
    }
end

fn run_rust_test(tmp_dir: string, src: string,
                  test_code: string, out_file: string) -> i32
  do
    // 소스 + 테스트 코드 합치기
    let combined = src + "\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    " +
                   test_code + "\n}\n"
    let src_file = tmp_dir + "/lib.rs"
    file_write(src_file, combined)

    exec("cd " + tmp_dir + " && " +
         "rustc --test -o " + tmp_dir + "/test_bin " + src_file +
         " > " + out_file + " 2>&1" +
         " && " + tmp_dir + "/test_bin >> " + out_file + " 2>&1" +
         " ; echo $? > " + out_file + ".exit")

    return read_exit_code(out_file + ".exit")
end

fn run_go_test(tmp_dir: string, src: string,
                test_code: string, out_file: string) -> i32
  do
    let main_file = tmp_dir + "/main.go"
    let test_file = tmp_dir + "/main_test.go"

    // 소스 파일 패키지 확인
    let src_with_pkg = src
    if !str_contains(src, "package ")
      src_with_pkg = "package main\n\n" + src
    end

    file_write(main_file, src_with_pkg)
    file_write(test_file, "package main\n\nimport \"testing\"\n\n" + test_code)
    file_write(tmp_dir + "/go.mod", "module gentest\ngo 1.21\n")

    exec("cd " + tmp_dir + " && go test ./... " +
         "> " + out_file + " 2>&1 ; echo $? > " + out_file + ".exit")

    return read_exit_code(out_file + ".exit")
end

// ==================== ProofScore 계산 ====================

fn calculate_test_proof(outcomes: array, total_tests: i32) -> i32
  intent "테스트 결과 → ProofScore 기여 (최대 +20)"
  do
    if total_tests == 0 return 0

    let perfect_count = 0   // before=fail, after=pass
    let i = 0
    while i < arr_len(outcomes) - 1
      let before = arr_get(outcomes, i)
      let after = arr_get(outcomes, i + 1)
      if before.phase == "before" && after.phase == "after"
        if !before.passed && after.passed
          perfect_count = perfect_count + 1
        end
      end
      i = i + 2
    end

    return (perfect_count * 20) / total_tests
end

// ==================== 테스트 저장 ====================

fn test_save(t: GeneratedTest, dir: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "생성된 테스트를 파일로 저장"
  do
    let path = dir + "/" + t.test_file_name
    match file_write(path, t.test_code)
      Err(e) => return Err("저장 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {
        print("[TestGen] 저장: " + path)
        return Ok(void)
      }
    end
end

fn testgen_result_print(result: TestGenResult) -> void
  do
    print("=== 테스트 자동 생성 결과 ===")
    print("생성 수: " + int_to_str(result.total_generated))
    print("ProofScore 기여: +" + int_to_str(result.proof_contribution))
    let i = 0
    while i < arr_len(result.run_results) - 1
      let before = arr_get(result.run_results, i)
      let after = arr_get(result.run_results, i + 1)
      if before.phase == "before" && after.phase == "after"
        let icon = "⚠️"
        if !before.passed && after.passed icon = "✅"
        print(icon + " [" + before.test_id + "] before=" +
              bool_to_str(!before.passed) + " fail / after=" +
              bool_to_str(after.passed) + " pass")
      end
      i = i + 2
    end
    print("============================")
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn get_test_ext(lang: string) -> string
  do
    if lang == "rust" return "_test.rs"
    if lang == "go" return "_test.go"
    return "_test.fl"
end

fn bool_to_str(b: bool) -> string
  do
    if b return "true"
    return "false"
end

fn read_exit_code(path: string) -> i32
  do
    match file_read(path)
      Err(_) => { return 1 }
      Ok(c) => { return parse_int_safe(str_trim(c)) }
    end
end

fn extract_api_content(resp_text: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"text\":\""
    let pos = str_index_of_str(resp_text, search)
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    let result = ""
    let i = start
    while i < str_len(resp_text)
      let ch = str_char(resp_text, i)
      if ch == "\\"
        i = i + 1
        if i < str_len(resp_text)
          let next = str_char(resp_text, i)
          if next == "n" result = result + "\n"
          else if next == "t" result = result + "\t"
          else if next == "\"" result = result + "\""
          else if next == "\\" result = result + "\\"
          else result = result + next
        end
      else if ch == "\""
        break
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn extract_json_block(text: string) -> string
  do
    let start_marker = "```json"
    let start = str_index_of_str(text, start_marker)
    if start < 0
      start_marker = "```"
      start = str_index_of_str(text, start_marker)
    end
    if start < 0
      let brace = str_index_of_str(text, "{")
      if brace >= 0 return str_substr(text, brace, str_len(text))
      return ""
    end
    let content_start = start + str_len(start_marker)
    let nl = str_index_of_from(text, "\n", content_start)
    if nl >= 0 content_start = nl + 1
    let end_marker = str_index_of_from(text, "```", content_start)
    if end_marker < 0 return str_substr(text, content_start, str_len(text))
    return str_substr(text, content_start, end_marker)
end

fn find_json_object_end(json: string, start: i32) -> i32
  do
    let depth = 0
    let i = start
    let in_string = false
    while i < str_len(json)
      let ch = str_char(json, i)
      if ch == "\\" && in_string
        i = i + 2
        continue
      end
      if ch == "\""
        in_string = !in_string
      else if !in_string
        if ch == "{" depth = depth + 1
        else if ch == "}"
          depth = depth - 1
          if depth == 0 return i
        end
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn json_extract_str(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    let end_pos = str_index_of_from(json, "\"", start)
    if end_pos < 0 return ""
    return str_substr(json, start, end_pos)
end

fn json_extract_str_long(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    let pos = str_index_of_str(json, search)
    if pos < 0 return ""
    let start = pos + str_len(search)
    let result = ""
    let i = start
    while i < str_len(json)
      let ch = str_char(json, i)
      if ch == "\\"
        i = i + 1
        if i < str_len(json)
          let next = str_char(json, i)
          if next == "n" result = result + "\n"
          else if next == "t" result = result + "\t"
          else if next == "\"" result = result + "\""
          else if next == "\\" result = result + "\\"
          else result = result + next
        end
      else if ch == "\""
        break
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn json_str_encode(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = "\""
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else if ch == "\r" result = result + "\\r"
      else if ch == "\t" result = result + "\\t"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    result = result + "\""
    return result
end

fn str_contains(s: string, sub: string) -> bool
  do
    return str_index_of_str(s, sub) >= 0
end

fn str_index_of_str(s: string, sub: string) -> i32
  do
    let slen = str_len(s)
    let sublen = str_len(sub)
    if sublen > slen return -1
    let i = 0
    while i <= slen - sublen
      if str_substr(s, i, i + sublen) == sub return i
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn str_index_of_from(s: string, ch: string, from: i32) -> i32
  do
    let i = from
    while i < str_len(s)
      if str_char(s, i) == ch return i
      i = i + 1
    end
    return -1
end

fn str_trim(s: string) -> string
  do
    let start = 0
    let end_pos = str_len(s)
    while start < end_pos
      let ch = str_char(s, start)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        start = start + 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    while end_pos > start
      let ch = str_char(s, end_pos - 1)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t" || ch == "\n" || ch == "\r"
        end_pos = end_pos - 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    return str_substr(s, start, end_pos)
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn int_to_str_i64(n: i64) -> string
  do
    return int_to_str(n as i32)
end

fn parse_int_safe(s: string) -> i32
  do
    if s == "" return 0
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    while i < str_len(s)
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else break
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end
